15.25.s:
.. iṃdradyumna uvāca .. ..
kathayasva muniśreṣṭha kiṃcitkautūhalaṃ mama ..
puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ pāpaghnaṃ tīrthaṃ tu vada vistarāt .. 1 ..
15.25.d:
.. इंद्रद्युम्न उवाच .. ..
कथयस्व मुनिश्रेष्ठ किंचित्कौतूहलं मम ..
पुण्यं पवित्रं पापघ्नं तीर्थं तु वद विस्तरात् .. 1 ..
15.25.m: Indradyumna said: / “Tell me, O best of sages—I have some curiosity. / Speak in detail of the sacred ford that is auspicious, pure, and destroyer of sin.” // 1

15.25.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
mathurā dvārakā'yodhyā kalikāle purītrayam ..
dharmārthakāmadaṃ bhūpa mokṣadaṃ harivallabham .. 2 ..
15.25.d:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
मथुरा द्वारकाऽयोध्या कलिकाले पुरीत्रयम् ..
धर्मार्थकामदं भूप मोक्षदं हरिवल्लभम् .. 2 ..
15.25.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / “Mathurā, Dvārakā, and Ayodhyā—in the Kali age, these three cities / grant dharma, wealth, and desire, O king, and grant liberation, being dear to Hari. // 2

15.25.s:
madhurāyāṃ tu kāliṃdī gomatī kṛṣṇasannidhau ..
ayodhyāyāṃ tu sarayūrmuktidā sevitā sadā .. 3 ..
15.25.d:
मधुरायां तु कालिंदी गोमती कृष्णसन्निधौ ..
अयोध्यायां तु सरयूर्मुक्तिदा सेविता सदा .. 3 ..
15.25.m: In Mathurā there is the Kālindī; the Gomatī is in the presence of Kṛṣṇa; / and in Ayodhyā, the Sarayū gives liberation when always resorted to. // 3

15.25.s:
drāravatyāmayodhyāyāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ śubhapradam ..
mathurāyāṃ hariṃ viṣṇuṃ smṛtvā muktimavāpnuyāt .. 4 ..
15.25.d:
द्रारवत्यामयोध्यायां कृष्णं रामं शुभप्रदम् ..
मथुरायां हरिं विष्णुं स्मृत्वा मुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् .. 4 ..
15.25.m: In Dvāravatī and Ayodhyā, by remembering Kṛṣṇa and Rāma who bestow auspiciousness, / and in Mathurā by remembering Hari Viṣṇu, one attains liberation. // 4

15.25.s:
dhanyā sā mathurā loke yatra jāto hariḥ svayam ..
dvārakā saphalā loke krīḍitaṃ yatra viṣṇunā .. 5 ..
15.25.d:
धन्या सा मथुरा लोके यत्र जातो हरिः स्वयम् ..
द्वारका सफला लोके क्रीडितं यत्र विष्णुना .. 5 ..
15.25.m: Blessed is that Mathurā in the world, where Hari was born in person; / fruitful is Dvārakā in the world, where Viṣṇu sported; // 5

15.25.s:
dhanyānāmapi sā pūjyā ayodhyā sarvakāmadā ..
yā svayaṃ rāmadevena pālitā dharmabuddhinā .. 6 ..
15.25.d:
धन्यानामपि सा पूज्या अयोध्या सर्वकामदा ..
या स्वयं रामदेवेन पालिता धर्मबुद्धिना .. 6 ..
15.25.m: and worshipful even among the blessed is Ayodhyā, granting all desires, / which was protected by Lord Rāma himself with righteous intent. // 6

15.25.s:
yaddadāti phalaṃ kāśī sevitā kalpasaṃkhyayā ..
kalā dadāti mathurā vāsareṇāpi tatphalam .. 7 ..
15.25.d:
यद्ददाति फलं काशी सेविता कल्पसंख्यया ..
कला ददाति मथुरा वासरेणापि तत्फलम् .. 7 ..
15.25.m: Whatever fruit Kāśī yields when attended for a multitude of kalpas, / Mathurā yields even a fraction of that fruit in a single day. // 7

15.25.s:
manvaṃtarasahasre tu prayāge yatphalaṃ bhavet ..
nimiṣārddhena vasatāṃ dvārakāyāṃ tu tatphalam .. 8 ..
15.25.d:
मन्वंतरसहस्रे तु प्रयागे यत्फलं भवेत् ..
निमिषार्द्धेन वसतां द्वारकायां तु तत्फलम् .. 8 ..
15.25.m: Whatever fruit there may be at Prayāga in a thousand manvantaras, / that fruit is obtained in half an instant by those dwelling in Dvārakā. // 8

15.25.s:
prabhāse ca kurukṣetre yatphalaṃ vatsaraiḥ śataiḥ ..
vasatāṃ nimiṣārddhena hyayodhyāyāṃ ca tadbhavet .. 9 ..
15.25.d:
प्रभासे च कुरुक्षेत्रे यत्फलं वत्सरैः शतैः ..
वसतां निमिषार्द्धेन ह्ययोध्यायां च तद्भवेत् .. 9 ..
15.25.m: Whatever fruit is attained at Prabhāsa and Kurukṣetra in hundreds of years, / that indeed is attained in half an instant by those dwelling in Ayodhyā. // 9

15.25.s:
ayodhyādhipatiṃ rāmaṃ mathurāyāṃ tu keśavam ..
dvārakāvāsinaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ cāpi durllabham .. 7.4.25.10 ..
15.25.d:
अयोध्याधिपतिं रामं मथुरायां तु केशवम् ..
द्वारकावासिनं कृष्णं कीर्तनं चापि दुर्ल्लभम् .. 7.4.25.10 ..
15.25.m: To chant of Rāma, the lord of Ayodhyā, Keśava in Mathurā, / and Kṛṣṇa dwelling in Dvārakā, is exceedingly rare. // 10

15.25.s:
mathurākīrtanenāpi śravaṇāddvārakāpuraḥ ..
ayodhyādarśanenāpi triśuddhaṃ ca padaṃ vrajet.. 11 ..
15.25.d:
मथुराकीर्तनेनापि श्रवणाद्द्वारकापुरः ..
अयोध्यादर्शनेनापि त्रिशुद्धं च पदं व्रजेत्.. 11 ..
15.25.m: By the praise of Mathurā, from hearing about the city of Dvārakā, / and by the darśana of Ayodhyā, one attains the thrice-purified state. // 11

15.25.s:
kṛṣṇaṃ svayaṃbhuvaṃ devaṃ dvārakā tridivopamā ..
śrutā cāpyathavā dṛṣṭā kurute janmasaṃkṣayam .. 12 ..
15.25.d:
कृष्णं स्वयंभुवं देवं द्वारका त्रिदिवोपमा ..
श्रुता चाप्यथवा दृष्टा कुरुते जन्मसंक्षयम् .. 12 ..
15.25.m: Regarding the self-manifest god Kṛṣṇa, Dvārakā is comparable to heaven; / heard of or seen, it puts an end to rebirth. // 12

15.25.s:
śrutābhilikhitā dṛṣṭā hyayodhyā mathurāpurī ..
pāpaṃ harati kalpotthaṃ dvārakā ca tṛtīyakā .. 13 ..
15.25.d:
श्रुताभिलिखिता दृष्टा ह्ययोध्या मथुरापुरी ..
पापं हरति कल्पोत्थं द्वारका च तृतीयका .. 13 ..
15.25.m: Heard of, written down, or seen, Ayodhyā and the city of Mathurā, / as well as the third, Dvārakā, take away the sin born of an entire kalpa.” // 13

15.25.s:
kṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ hariṃ devaṃ viśrāṃtaṃ ca kalau smṛtam ..
dvādaśyāṃ jāgare rātrāvaśvamedhāyutaṃ phalam .. 14 ..
15.25.d:
कृष्णं विष्णुं हरिं देवं विश्रांतं च कलौ स्मृतम् ..
द्वादश्यां जागरे रात्रावश्वमेधायुतं फलम् .. 14 ..
15.25.m: The god Kṛṣṇa, Viṣṇu, Hari, when remembered as resting in the Kali age, / [brings] the fruit of ten thousand horse sacrifices during a night-vigil on the twelfth lunar day.

15.25.s:
bālakrīḍanakaṃ sthānaṃ ye smaraṃti dinedine ..
svarṇaśailapadaṃ nṛṇāṃ jāyate rājasattama .. 15 ..
15.25.d:
बालक्रीडनकं स्थानं ये स्मरंति दिनेदिने ..
स्वर्णशैलपदं नृणां जायते राजसत्तम .. 15 ..
15.25.m: Those who remember day after day the place where he played as a boy, / attain the realm of the Golden Mountain, O best of kings.

15.25.s:
dhanyāste mānavā loke kalikāle narottama..
plavanaṃ siṃdhutoyena gomatyāṃ yairnaraiḥ kṛtam .. 16 ..
15.25.d:
धन्यास्ते मानवा लोके कलिकाले नरोत्तम..
प्लवनं सिंधुतोयेन गोमत्यां यैर्नरैः कृतम् .. 16 ..
15.25.m: Blessed are those mortals in the world in the Kali age, O best of men, / by which men bathing has been performed in the Gomatī with ocean water.

15.25.s:
paścimāśāṃ naraḥ snātvā kṛtvā vai karasaṃpuṭam ..
dvārakāṃ ye smariṣyaṃti teṣāṃ koṭiguṇaṃ phalam .. 17 ..
15.25.d:
पश्चिमाशां नरः स्नात्वा कृत्वा वै करसंपुटम् ..
द्वारकां ये स्मरिष्यंति तेषां कोटिगुणं फलम् .. 17 ..
15.25.m: The man who, having bathed, facing the western quarter with cupped hands, / shall remember Dvārakā—for them the fruit is multiplied ten-millionfold.

15.25.s:
manasā cintayedyo vai kalau dvāravatīṃ purīm ..
kapilā'yutapuṇyaṃ ca labhate helayā naraḥ .. 18 ..
15.25.d:
मनसा चिन्तयेद्यो वै कलौ द्वारवतीं पुरीम् ..
कपिलाऽयुतपुण्यं च लभते हेलया नरः .. 18 ..
15.25.m: Whoever indeed contemplates in his mind the city of Dvāravatī in the Kali age, / that man effortlessly attains the merit of [gifting] ten thousand kapilā cows.

15.25.s:
gaṃgāsāgarajaṃ puṇyaṃ gaṃgādvārabhavaṃ tathā ..
kalau dvāravatīṃ gatvā prāpnoti manujādhipa .. 19 ..
15.25.d:
गंगासागरजं पुण्यं गंगाद्वारभवं तथा ..
कलौ द्वारवतीं गत्वा प्राप्नोति मनुजाधिप .. 19 ..
15.25.m: The merit arising at Gaṅgāsāgara and that born at Gaṅgādvāra— / having gone to Dvāravatī in the Kali age, he attains it, O lord of men.

15.25.s:
saptakalpasmaro bhūpa mārkaṇḍeyaḥ smarāmyaham ..
samānā vā'dhikā vāpi dvāravatyā na kāpi pūḥ ..7.4.25.20..
15.25.d:
सप्तकल्पस्मरो भूप मार्कण्डेयः स्मराम्यहम् ..
समाना वाऽधिका वापि द्वारवत्या न कापि पूः ..7.4.25.20..
15.25.m: O king, I, Mārkaṇḍeya, who remember seven cosmic ages, recall / that no city at all is equal or superior to Dvāravatī. 7.4.25.20.

15.25.s:
durvāsasā samo dhanyo nāsti nāpyadhiko nṛpa ..
bhāṣābaṃdhaṃ yena kṛtvā dvārakāyāṃ dhṛto hariḥ .. 21 ..
15.25.d:
दुर्वाससा समो धन्यो नास्ति नाप्यधिको नृप ..
भाषाबंधं येन कृत्वा द्वारकायां धृतो हरिः .. 21 ..
15.25.m: There is no one equal to Durvāsas in fortune, nor anyone superior, O king, / by whom, having made a verbal pact, Hari was kept in Dvārakā.

15.25.s:
mā kāśīṃ mā kurukṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ mā ca puṣkaram ..
dvārakāṃ gaccha rājarṣe paśya kṛṣṇamukhaṃ śubham .. 22 ..
15.25.d:
मा काशीं मा कुरुक्षेत्रं प्रभासं मा च पुष्करम् ..
द्वारकां गच्छ राजर्षे पश्य कृष्णमुखं शुभम् .. 22 ..
15.25.m: Do not [go to] Kāśī, do not [go to] Kurukṣetra, Prabhāsa, or Puṣkara; / go to Dvārakā, royal seer, and behold the auspicious face of Kṛṣṇa.

15.25.s:
aśvamedhasahasraṃ tu rājasūyaśataṃ kalau ..
padepade ca labhate dvārakāṃ yāti yo naraḥ .. 23 ..
15.25.d:
अश्वमेधसहस्रं तु राजसूयशतं कलौ ..
पदेपदे च लभते द्वारकां याति यो नरः .. 23 ..
15.25.m: A thousand horse sacrifices and a hundred royal consecrations in the Kali age / at every step does that man obtain who journeys to Dvārakā.

15.25.s:
saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ teṣāṃ kalau nṛpavarottama .. ye
ṣāṃ na skhalitaṃ cittaṃ dvārakāṃ prati gacchatām .. 24 ..
15.25.d:
सफलं जीवितं तेषां कलौ नृपवरोत्तम .. ये
षां न स्खलितं चित्तं द्वारकां प्रति गच्छताम् .. 24 ..
15.25.m: Fruitful is their life in the Kali age, O best of excellent kings, / whose mind does not waver as they journey toward Dvārakā.

15.25.s:
mātā ca putriṇī tena pitā caiva pitāmahāḥ ..
piṃḍadānaṃ kṛtaṃ yena gomatyāṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau .. 25 ..
15.25.d:
माता च पुत्रिणी तेन पिता चैव पितामहाः ..
पिंडदानं कृतं येन गोमत्यां कृष्णसन्निधौ .. 25 ..
15.25.m: His mother has truly borne a son, as have his father and grandfathers, / by whom the offering of the ancestral ball of rice has been made in the Gomatī in the presence of Kṛṣṇa.

15.25.s:
gopīcandanamudrāṃ tu kṛtvā bhramati bhūtale ..
so'pi deśo bhavetpūtaḥ ki punaryatra saṃsthitam .. 26 ..
15.25.d:
गोपीचन्दनमुद्रां तु कृत्वा भ्रमति भूतले ..
सोऽपि देशो भवेत्पूतः कि पुनर्यत्र संस्थितम् .. 26 ..
15.25.m: Having applied the mark of gopīcandana clay, if one roams upon the surface of the earth, / even that region becomes purified—how much more the place where he stays!

15.25.s:
dvārakāyāṃ samudbhūtāṃ tulasīṃ kṛṣṇasevitām ..
nityaṃ bibharti śirasā sa bhavettridaśādhipaḥ.. 27 ..
15.25.d:
द्वारकायां समुद्भूतां तुलसीं कृष्णसेविताम् ..
नित्यं बिभर्ति शिरसा स भवेत्त्रिदशाधिपः.. 27 ..
15.25.m: The tulasī grown in Dvārakā, served by Kṛṣṇa, / whoever constantly bears on his head becomes a lord of the gods.

15.25.s: daityārerbhagavattithiśca vijayā nīraṃ ca gagodbhavaṃ nityaṃkāśipurī tathaiva tulasī dhātrīphalaṃ vallabham..28..
15.25.d: दैत्यारेर्भगवत्तिथिश्च विजया नीरं च गगोद्भवं नित्यंकाशिपुरी तथैव तुलसी धात्रीफलं वल्लभम्..28..
15.25.m: The lunar day of the Lord, the enemy of demons; the Vijayā day; water born from the Gaṅgā; / constantly the city of Kāśī; likewise tulasī, and the myrobalan fruit are dear [to Hari].

15.25.s: śāstraṃ bhāgavataṃ tathā ca dayitaṃ rāmāyaṇaṃ dvārakā puṇyaṃ mālatisambhavaṃ sudayitaṃ gītaṃ kṛtaṃ jāgaram .. 29 ..
15.25.d: शास्त्रं भागवतं तथा च दयितं रामायणं द्वारका पुण्यं मालतिसम्भवं सुदयितं गीतं कृतं जागरम् .. 29 ..
15.25.m: Likewise the scripture Bhāgavata is dear, and the Rāmāyaṇa; Dvārakā, / the merit born of the mālatī flower is exceedingly dear, [as are] song and an observed vigil.

15.25.s:
gṛhe yasya sadā tiṣṭhedgopīcandanamṛttikā ..
dvārakā tiṣṭhate tatra kṛṣṇena sahitā kalau .. 7.4.25.30 ..
15.25.d:
गृहे यस्य सदा तिष्ठेद्गोपीचन्दनमृत्तिका ..
द्वारका तिष्ठते तत्र कृष्णेन सहिता कलौ .. 7.4.25.30 ..
15.25.m: In whose house the gopīcandana clay constantly remains, / there Dvārakā abides along with Kṛṣṇa in the Kali age. 7.4.25.30.

15.25.s:
kṛtaghno vā'tha goghno'pi haitukaḥ kṛtsnapāpakṛt ..
gopīcandanasaṃparkātpūto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt .. 31 ..
15.25.d:
कृतघ्नो वाऽथ गोघ्नोऽपि हैतुकः कृत्स्नपापकृत् ..
गोपीचन्दनसंपर्कात्पूतो भवति तत्क्षणात् .. 31 ..
15.25.m: Whether an ungrateful person, or a cow-killer, a skeptic, or one who commits all sins, / from contact with gopīcandana he becomes purified that very moment.

15.25.s:
gopīcandanakhaṃḍaṃ tu yo dadātīha vaiṣṇave ..
kulamekottaraṃ tena śataṃ tāritameva vā .. 32 ..
15.25.d:
गोपीचन्दनखंडं तु यो ददातीह वैष्णवे ..
कुलमेकोत्तरं तेन शतं तारितमेव वा .. 32 ..
15.25.m: Whoever gives a piece of gopīcandana to a Vaiṣṇava in this world, / by him one hundred and one generations of his lineage are indeed delivered.

15.25.s:
dvārakāsambhavā bhūpa tulasī yasya maṃdire ..
tasya vaivasvato nityaṃ bibheti saha kiṃkaraiḥ .. .. 33 ..
15.25.d:
द्वारकासम्भवा भूप तुलसी यस्य मंदिरे ..
तस्य वैवस्वतो नित्यं बिभेति सह किंकरैः .. .. 33 ..
15.25.m: In whose house there is tulasī born in Dvārakā, O king, / of him Yama, the son of Vivasvat, is constantly afraid along with his servants.

15.25.s:
dvārakāsaṃbhavā mṛtsnā tulasīkṛṣṇakīrtanam ..
kratukoṭiśataṃ puṇyaṃ kathitaṃ vyāsasūnunā .. 34 ..
15.25.d:
द्वारकासंभवा मृत्स्ना तुलसीकृष्णकीर्तनम् ..
क्रतुकोटिशतं पुण्यं कथितं व्याससूनुना .. 34 ..
15.25.m: The clay born of Dvārakā, tulasī, and the praise of Kṛṣṇa— / the merit of a hundred ten-million sacrifices has been declared by the son of Vyāsa.

15.25.s:
āloḍya sarvaśāstrāṇi purāṇāni punaḥpunaḥ ..
mayā dṛṣṭā mahīpāla na dvārakāsamā purī .. 35 ..
15.25.d:
आलोड्य सर्वशास्त्राणि पुराणानि पुनःपुनः ..
मया दृष्टा महीपाल न द्वारकासमा पुरी .. 35 ..
15.25.m: Having churned all the scriptures and Purāṇas again and again, / I have seen, O protector of the earth, no city equal to Dvārakā.

15.25.s:
dvārakāgamanaṃ yena kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇasya kīrtanam ..
snātaṃ tīrthasahasraistu teneṣṭaṃ kratukoṭibhiḥ ..36..
15.25.d:
द्वारकागमनं येन कृतं कृष्णस्य कीर्तनम् ..
स्नातं तीर्थसहस्रैस्तु तेनेष्टं क्रतुकोटिभिः ..36..
15.25.m: By whom a journey to Dvārakā has been made and the praise of Kṛṣṇa sung, / by him bathing has been performed in thousands of sacred fords, and sacrifices offered with tens of millions of rites.

15.25.s:
idriyāṇāṃ tu damanaṃ kiṃ kariṣyati dehinām ..
sāṃkhyamadhyayanaṃ cāpi dvārakāṃ gacchate na cet ..37..
15.25.d:
इद्रियाणां तु दमनं किं करिष्यति देहिनाम् ..
सांख्यमध्ययनं चापि द्वारकां गच्छते न चेत् ..37..
15.25.m: What will control of the senses do for embodied beings, / or Sāṃkhya and scriptural study, if one does not go to Dvārakā?

15.25.s:
paśavaste na sandeho gardabhena samā janāḥ ..
dṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇamukhaṃ yairna gatvā dvāravatīṃ purīm .. 38 ..
15.25.d:
पशवस्ते न सन्देहो गर्दभेन समा जनाः ..
दृष्टं कृष्णमुखं यैर्न गत्वा द्वारवतीं पुरीम् .. 38 ..
15.25.m: They are beasts, without doubt—people equal to a donkey, / by whom the face of Kṛṣṇa has not been seen after going to the city of Dvāravatī.

15.25.s:
kṛtakṛtyāstu te dhanyā dvādaśyāṃ jāgare hareḥ ..
kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ bhaktyā nṛtyamānā muhurmuhuḥ ..39..
15.25.d:
कृतकृत्यास्तु ते धन्या द्वादश्यां जागरे हरेः ..
कृत्वा जागरणं भक्त्या नृत्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः ..39..
15.25.m: Those who have accomplished their duty are fortunate, who on the twelfth lunar day during Hari's vigil, / having kept vigil with devotion, dance repeatedly.

15.25.s:
kṛṣṇālayaṃ tu yo gatvā gomatyāṃ piṃḍapātanam ..
karoti śaktyā dānaṃ ca muktāstasya pitāmahāḥ ..7.4.25.40..
15.25.d:
कृष्णालयं तु यो गत्वा गोमत्यां पिंडपातनम् ..
करोति शक्त्या दानं च मुक्तास्तस्य पितामहाः ..7.4.25.40..
15.25.m: He who, having gone to the abode of Kṛṣṇa, offers the ancestral ball of rice in the Gomatī / and gives gifts according to his ability—his ancestors are liberated. 7.4.25.40.

15.25.s:
pretatvaṃ ca piśā catvaṃ na bhavettasya dehinaḥ ..
janmajanmani rājeṃdra yo gato dvārakāṃ purīm .. 41 ..
15.25.d:
प्रेतत्वं च पिशा चत्वं न भवेत्तस्य देहिनः ..
जन्मजन्मनि राजेंद्र यो गतो द्वारकां पुरीम् .. 41 ..
15.25.m: The condition of a ghost or the state of a piśāca will not happen to that embodied soul / in birth after birth, O king of kings, who has gone to the city of Dvārakā.

15.25.s:
anaśanena yatpuṇyaṃ prayāge tyajatastanum ..
dvādaśyāṃ nimiṣārddhena tatphalaṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau .. 42 ..
15.25.d:
अनशनेन यत्पुण्यं प्रयागे त्यजतस्तनुम् ..
द्वादश्यां निमिषार्द्धेन तत्फलं कृष्णसन्निधौ .. 42 ..
15.25.m: Whatever merit belongs to one abandoning his body by fasting at Prayāga, / that fruit is obtained in half a twinkling of an eye in the presence of Kṛṣṇa on the twelfth lunar day.

15.25.s:
sūryagrahe gavāṃ koṭiṃ dattvā yatphalamāpnuyāt ..
tatphalaṃ kalikāle tu dvāravatyāṃ dinedine .. 43 ..
15.25.d:
सूर्यग्रहे गवां कोटिं दत्त्वा यत्फलमाप्नुयात् ..
तत्फलं कलिकाले तु द्वारवत्यां दिनेदिने .. 43 ..
15.25.m: Whatever fruit one may obtain by giving ten million cows during a solar eclipse, / that fruit [is obtained] day after day in Dvāravatī in the Kali age.

15.25.s:
koṭibhāraṃ suvarṇasya grahaṇe caṃdrasūryayoḥ ..
dattvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ kṛṣṇadarśane .. 44 ..
15.25.d:
कोटिभारं सुवर्णस्य ग्रहणे चंद्रसूर्ययोः ..
दत्त्वा यत्फलमाप्नोति तत्फलं कृष्णदर्शने .. 44 ..
15.25.m: The fruit one obtains by giving ten million bhāras of gold during an eclipse of the moon or the sun, / that fruit [is obtained] upon seeing Kṛṣṇa.

15.25.s:
dolāsaṃsthaṃ ca ye kṛṣṇaṃ paśyaṃti madhumādhave ..
teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca mātāmahapitāmahāḥ .. 45 ..
15.25.d:
दोलासंस्थं च ये कृष्णं पश्यंति मधुमाधवे ..
तेषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च मातामहपितामहाः .. 45 ..
15.25.m: And those who behold Kṛṣṇa placed on a swing in the months of Madhu and Mādhava, / their sons, grandsons, maternal grandfathers, and paternal grandfathers,

15.25.s:
śvaśurādyāḥ sabhṛtyāśca paśavaśca narottama ..
krīḍaṃti viṣṇunā sārddhaṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 46 ..
15.25.d:
श्वशुराद्याः सभृत्याश्च पशवश्च नरोत्तम ..
क्रीडंति विष्णुना सार्द्धं यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 46 ..
15.25.m: in-laws and others, along with servants and beasts, O best of men, / sport with Viṣṇu until the universal dissolution of creatures.

15.25.s:
yā kāciddvādaśī bhūpa jāyate kṛṣṇasannidhau ..
paśyāmi nāṃtaraṃ kiñcitkalikāle viśeṣataḥ .. 47 ..
15.25.d:
या काचिद्द्वादशी भूप जायते कृष्णसन्निधौ ..
पश्यामि नांतरं किञ्चित्कलिकाले विशेषतः .. 47 ..
15.25.m: Whatever twelfth lunar day occurs in the presence of Kṛṣṇa, O king, / I see no difference [between them], especially in the Kali age.

15.25.s:
kṛṣṇasya sannidhau nityaṃ vāsarā dvādaśīsamāḥ ..
yugādibhiḥ samāḥ sarve nityaṃ kṛṣṇasya sannidhau..48..
15.25.d:
कृष्णस्य सन्निधौ नित्यं वासरा द्वादशीसमाः ..
युगादिभिः समाः सर्वे नित्यं कृष्णस्य सन्निधौ..48..
15.25.m: In the presence of Kṛṣṇa, all days are constantly equal to the twelfth lunar day; / all days are equal to the beginnings of cosmic ages in the presence of Kṛṣṇa.

15.25.s:
kalau dvāravatī sevyā jñātvā puṇyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
ṣaṭapuryaścaiva sulabhā durllabhā dvārakā kalau..49..
15.25.d:
कलौ द्वारवती सेव्या ज्ञात्वा पुण्यं विशेषतः ..
षटपुर्यश्चैव सुलभा दुर्ल्लभा द्वारका कलौ..49..
15.25.m: Dvāravatī should be resorted to in the Kali age, knowing its special merit; / the six other cities are easily attained, but Dvārakā is difficult to reach in the Kali age.

15.25.s:
smaraṇātkīrtanādyasmādbhuktimuktī sadā nṛṇām ..
durvāsasā tu ṛṣiṇā rakṣitā tiṣṭhate purī..7.4.25.50..
15.25.d:
स्मरणात्कीर्तनाद्यस्माद्भुक्तिमुक्ती सदा नृणाम् ..
दुर्वाससा तु ऋषिणा रक्षिता तिष्ठते पुरी..7.4.25.50..
15.25.m: Because from remembering and praising it worldly enjoyment and liberation always come to mortals, / the city stands protected by the seer Durvāsas. 7.4.25.50.

15.25.s:
kalau na śakyate gaṃtuṃ vinā kṛṣṇaprasādataḥ ..
kṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ kartuṃ yānti rudrādayaḥ surāḥ..51..
15.25.d:
कलौ न शक्यते गंतुं विना कृष्णप्रसादतः ..
कृष्णस्य दर्शनं कर्तुं यान्ति रुद्रादयः सुराः..51..
15.25.m: In the Kali age it is not possible to go [there] without the grace of Kṛṣṇa; / Rudra and the other gods go to have darśana of Kṛṣṇa.

15.25.s:
trikālaṃ jagatīnātha rukmiṇīdarśanāya ca ..
saphalā bhāratī tasya kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti yā vadet..52..
15.25.d:
त्रिकालं जगतीनाथ रुक्मिणीदर्शनाय च ..
सफला भारती तस्य कृष्णकृष्णेति या वदेत्..52..
15.25.m: At the three junctures of the day, O lord of the earth, to behold Rukmiṇī, / fruitful is the speech of him who utters, 'Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa!'

15.25.s:
dvārakā yāyinaṃ dṛṣṭvā gāyaṃti divisaṃsthitāḥ ..
narakātpitaro muktāḥ pracalaṃti hasaṃti ca ..53..
15.25.d:
द्वारका यायिनं दृष्ट्वा गायंति दिविसंस्थिताः ..
नरकात्पितरो मुक्ताः प्रचलंति हसंति च ..53..
15.25.m: Seeing one who is going to Dvārakā, those residing in heaven sing; / the ancestors, liberated from hell, set forth and laugh [with joy].

15.25.s:
gopyaṃ yatpātakaṃ puṃsāṃ gomatī tadvyapohati ..
smaraṇātkīrttanādvāpi kiṃ punaḥ plavane kṛte .. 54 ..
15.25.d:
गोप्यं यत्पातकं पुंसां गोमती तद्व्यपोहति ..
स्मरणात्कीर्त्तनाद्वापि किं पुनः प्लवने कृते .. 54 ..
15.25.m: Whatever secret sin belongs to men, the Gomatī removes it / from remembrance or from praise; how much more when a bath is taken?

15.25.s:
rukmiṇīsahitaṃ devaṃ śaṃkhoddhāre ca śaṃkhinam ..
piṃḍārake caturbāhuṃ dṛṣṭvā'nyaiḥ kiṃ kariṣyati ..55..
15.25.d:
रुक्मिणीसहितं देवं शंखोद्धारे च शंखिनम् ..
पिंडारके चतुर्बाहुं दृष्ट्वाऽन्यैः किं करिष्यति ..55..
15.25.m: Having seen the god with Rukmiṇī, and at Śaṅkhoddhāra holding the conch, / and at Piṇḍāraka having four arms, what will one do with others?

15.25.s:
rukmiṇī devakīputraścakratīrthaṃ ca gomatī ..
gopīnāṃ caṃdanaṃ loke tulasī durlabhā kalau .. 56 ..
15.25.d:
रुक्मिणी देवकीपुत्रश्चक्रतीर्थं च गोमती ..
गोपीनां चंदनं लोके तुलसी दुर्लभा कलौ .. 56 ..
15.25.m: Rukmiṇī, the son of Devakī, Cakratīrtha, the Gomatī, / the clay of the gopīs, and tulasī are rare in the world in the Kali age. 56.

15.25.s:
durlabhāste sutā jñeyā dharaṇīpāpanāśakāḥ ..
gayāṃ gatvā tu ye piṃḍaṃ dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam ..
kariṣyaṃti kalau prāpte vaṃjulīsamupoṣaṇam .. 57 ..
15.25.d:
दुर्लभास्ते सुता ज्ञेया धरणीपापनाशकाः ..
गयां गत्वा तु ये पिंडं द्वारकां कृष्णदर्शनम् ..
करिष्यंति कलौ प्राप्ते वंजुलीसमुपोषणम् .. 57 ..
15.25.m: Rare are such sons to be found, destroyers of the earth's sins, / who, having gone to Gayā, will offer the rice ball, [or] visit Dvārakā to have the darśana of Kṛṣṇa, / or observe the fast on the Vañjulī [day] when the Kali age has arrived. // 57

15.25.s:
samaṃ puṇyaphalaṃ teṣāṃ vaṃjulī dvārakā samā ..
yena nyūnā nādhikā'pi kathitaṃ viṣṇunā svayam .. 58 ..
15.25.d:
समं पुण्यफलं तेषां वंजुली द्वारका समा ..
येन न्यूना नाधिकाऽपि कथितं विष्णुना स्वयम् .. 58 ..
15.25.m: Equal is their fruit of merit; Vañjulī is equal to Dvārakā. / Neither less nor more has it been declared by Viṣṇu himself. // 58

15.25.s:
vaṃjulī cādhikāṃ rājañchṛṇu vakṣyāmi kāraṇam..
dvādaśyāmupavāsena dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇena tu ..
prāpyate helayā caiva tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam .. 59 ..
15.25.d:
वंजुली चाधिकां राजञ्छृणु वक्ष्यामि कारणम्..
द्वादश्यामुपवासेन द्वादश्यां पारणेन तु ..
प्राप्यते हेलया चैव तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् .. 59 ..
15.25.m: And Vañjulī is even greater, O King; hear, I will tell the reason: / by fasting on the twelfth [lunar day] and breaking the fast on the twelfth, / that highest abode of Viṣṇu is attained with ease. // 59

15.25.s:
gṛheṣu vasatāṃ tīrthaṃ gṛheṣu vasatāṃ tapaḥ ..
gṛheṣu vasatāṃ mokṣo vaṃjulīsamupoṣaṇāt .. 7.4.25.60 ..
15.25.d:
गृहेषु वसतां तीर्थं गृहेषु वसतां तपः ..
गृहेषु वसतां मोक्षो वंजुलीसमुपोषणात् .. 7.4.25.60 ..
15.25.m: For those residing in their homes, it is a sacred ford; for those residing in their homes, it is austerity; / for those residing in their homes, liberation comes from fasting on Vañjulī. // 60

15.25.s:
vaṃjulī dvārakā gaṃgā gayā goviṃdakīrttanam ..
gomatī gokulaṃ gītā durllabhaṃ gopicandanam .. 61 ..
15.25.d:
वंजुली द्वारका गंगा गया गोविंदकीर्त्तनम् ..
गोमती गोकुलं गीता दुर्ल्लभं गोपिचन्दनम् .. 61 ..
15.25.m: Vañjulī, Dvārakā, the Gaṅgā, Gayā, chanting the name of Govinda, / the Gomatī, Gokula, the Gītā, and gopī-candana are difficult to attain. // 61

15.25.s:
etacchṛṇoti yo bhaktyā kṛtvā manasi keśavam ..
aśvamedhasahasrasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 62 ..
15.25.d:
एतच्छृणोति यो भक्त्या कृत्वा मनसि केशवम् ..
अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य फलमाप्नोति मानवः .. 62 ..
15.25.m: The man who hears this with devotion, keeping Keśava in mind, / obtains the fruit of a thousand horse sacrifices. // 62

15.25.s:
śroṣyaṃti jāgare ye vai māhātmyaṃ keśavasya ca ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ padaṃ yāsyaṃti vaiṣṇavam .. .. 63 ..
15.25.d:
श्रोष्यंति जागरे ये वै माहात्म्यं केशवस्य च ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्ताः पदं यास्यंति वैष्णवम् .. .. 63 ..
15.25.m: Those who hear the māhātmya of Keśava during the night vigil / shall be freed from all sins and go to the abode of Viṣṇu. // 63

15.25.s:
paṭhiṣyaṃti narā nityaṃ ye vai śropyaṃti bhaktitaḥ ..
tulāpuruṣadānasya phalaṃ te prāpnuvaṃti hi.. 64..
15.25.d:
पठिष्यंति नरा नित्यं ये वै श्रोप्यंति भक्तितः ..
तुलापुरुषदानस्य फलं ते प्राप्नुवंति हि.. 64..
15.25.m: Those men who recite it daily or listen with devotion / certainly obtain the fruit of giving a gift equal to one's own weight. // 64

15.25.s:
kṛṣṇajāgaraṇe dānaṃ yaccālpamapi dīyate ..
sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ jñeyamityāhuḥ kavayo nṛpa .. 65 ..
15.25.d:
कृष्णजागरणे दानं यच्चाल्पमपि दीयते ..
सर्वं कोटिगुणं ज्ञेयमित्याहुः कवयो नृप .. 65 ..
15.25.m: Whatever gift, even a small one, is given during a night vigil for Kṛṣṇa, / all that is to be known as multiplied ten-millionfold; so the wise declare, O King. // 65

15.25.s:
mānakūṭaṃ tulākūṭaṃ kanyāhayagavāṃ krayāt ..
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti dvādaśyāṃ jāgare kṛte .. 66 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye vaṃjulīdvārakāgaṃgāgayāgovindagomatīgokula gītāgopīcandanamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 25 ..
15.25.d:
मानकूटं तुलाकूटं कन्याहयगवां क्रयात् ..
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति द्वादश्यां जागरे कृते .. 66 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये वंजुलीद्वारकागंगागयागोविन्दगोमतीगोकुल गीतागोपीचन्दनमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चविंशतितमोऽध्यायः .. 25 ..
15.25.m:
False measurement, false balance, and [sins] from the sale of a maiden, a horse, or cows— / all that vanishes when a night vigil is kept on the twelfth [lunar day]. // 66
Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter, named 'Description of the māhātmya of Vañjulī, Dvārakā, the Gaṅgā, Gayā, Govinda, the Gomatī, Gokula, the Gītā, and Gopī-candana', in the Dvārakā-māhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] of the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. // 25

15.26.s:
.. śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
prahlādaṃ sarvadharmajñaṃ vedaśāstrārthapāragam ..
vaiṣṇavāgamatattvajñaṃ bhagavadbhaktitatparam .. 1 ..
15.26.d:
.. श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
प्रह्लादं सर्वधर्मज्ञं वेदशास्त्रार्थपारगम् ..
वैष्णवागमतत्त्वज्ञं भगवद्भक्तितत्परम् .. 1 ..
15.26.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / To Prahlāda, knower of all duties, who has crossed to the farther shore of the meaning of the Vedas and treatises, / who knows the truth of the Vaiṣṇava scriptures, and is devoted to bhakti for the Lord, // 1

15.26.s:
sukhāsīnaṃ mahāprājñamṛṣayo draṣṭumāgatāḥ ..
sarvaśāstrārthatattvajñāḥ svadharmapratipālakāḥ .. .. 2 ..
15.26.d:
सुखासीनं महाप्राज्ञमृषयो द्रष्टुमागताः ..
सर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञाः स्वधर्मप्रतिपालकाः .. .. 2 ..
15.26.m: seated at ease, the greatly wise one, the seers came to see, / they who know the essential truth of all scriptures, protectors of their own duty. // 2

15.26.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
vinā jñānādvinā dhyānādvinā cendriyanigrahāt ..
anāyāsena yenaitatprāpyate paramaṃ padam .. 3 ..
15.26.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
विना ज्ञानाद्विना ध्यानाद्विना चेन्द्रियनिग्रहात् ..
अनायासेन येनैतत्प्राप्यते परमं पदम् .. 3 ..
15.26.m: The seers said: / Without knowledge, without meditation, and without restraint of the senses, / by what means may this supreme state be attained effortlessly? // 3

15.26.s:
saṃkṣepātkathaya snehāddṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalodayam ..
dharmānmanujaśārdūla brūhi sarvānaśeṣataḥ .. 4 ..
15.26.d:
संक्षेपात्कथय स्नेहाद्दृष्टादृष्टफलोदयम् ..
धर्मान्मनुजशार्दूल ब्रूहि सर्वानशेषतः .. 4 ..
15.26.m: Tell us in brief, out of affection, that which brings about visible and invisible fruits; / speak completely and without remainder of all duties, O tiger among men! // 4

15.26.s:
ityukto'sau mahābhāgo nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ..
kathayāmāsa saṃkṣepātsarvalokahitodyataḥ .. 5 ..
15.26.d:
इत्युक्तोऽसौ महाभागो नारायणपरायणः ..
कथयामास संक्षेपात्सर्वलोकहितोद्यतः .. 5 ..
15.26.m: Thus addressed, the illustrious one, devoted to Nārāyaṇa, / intent on the welfare of all the worlds, spoke in brief. // 5

15.26.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi guhyādguhyataraṃ mahat ..
yasya saṃśravaṇādeva sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet .. .. 6 ..
15.26.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
श्रूयतामभिधास्यामि गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं महत् ..
यस्य संश्रवणादेव सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत् .. .. 6 ..
15.26.m: The venerable Prahlāda said: / Listen, I will declare the great secret more secret than any secret, / simply by hearing which the destruction of all sins takes place. // 6

15.26.s:
aṣṭādaśapurāṇānāṃ sārātsārataraṃ ca yat ..
tadahaṃ kathayiṣyāmi bhuktimuktiphalapradam .. 7 ..
15.26.d:
अष्टादशपुराणानां सारात्सारतरं च यत् ..
तदहं कथयिष्यामि भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम् .. 7 ..
15.26.m: That which is the essence of essences of the eighteen Purāṇas, / bestowing the fruit of worldly enjoyment and liberation, that I will tell. // 7

15.26.s:
sukhāsīnaṃ mahādevaṃ jagataḥ kāraṇaṃ param ..
papraccha ṣaṇmukho bhaktyā sarvalokahitodyataḥ .. 8 ..
15.26.d:
सुखासीनं महादेवं जगतः कारणं परम् ..
पप्रच्छ षण्मुखो भक्त्या सर्वलोकहितोद्यतः .. 8 ..
15.26.m: To Mahādeva, seated comfortably, the supreme cause of the world, / the six-faced [Skanda] asked with devotion, intent on the welfare of all the worlds. // 8

15.26.s:
.. skanda uvāca .. ..
bhagavansarvalokānāṃ duḥkhasaṃsārabheṣajam ..
kathayasva prasādena sukhopāyaṃ vimuktaye .. 9 ..
15.26.d:
.. स्कन्द उवाच .. ..
भगवन्सर्वलोकानां दुःखसंसारभेषजम् ..
कथयस्व प्रसादेन सुखोपायं विमुक्तये .. 9 ..
15.26.m: Skanda said: / O Blessed One, remedy for the sorrowful cycle of worldly existence for all the worlds, / please declare, by your grace, an easy means to liberation. // 9

15.26.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
caturvidhaṃ tu yatpāpaṃ koṭijanmārjitaṃ kalau ..
jāgare vaiṣṇavaṃ śāstraṃ vācayitvā vyapohati ..7.4.26.10..
15.26.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
चतुर्विधं तु यत्पापं कोटिजन्मार्जितं कलौ ..
जागरे वैष्णवं शास्त्रं वाचयित्वा व्यपोहति ..7.4.26.10..
15.26.m: Īśvara said: / The fourfold sin acquired over ten million lifetimes in the Kali age, / one removes by having a Vaiṣṇava treatise recited during the night vigil. // 10

15.26.s:
vaiṣṇavasya tu śāstrasya yo vaktā jāgare hareḥ ..
madbhaktaṃ taṃ vijānīyādvipannastvanyathā bhavet .. 11 ..
15.26.d:
वैष्णवस्य तु शास्त्रस्य यो वक्ता जागरे हरेः ..
मद्भक्तं तं विजानीयाद्विपन्नस्त्वन्यथा भवेत् .. 11 ..
15.26.m: The reciter of a Vaiṣṇava treatise during the night vigil of Hari, / him one should know to be my devotee; otherwise he would be ruined. // 11

15.26.s:
harijāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ madbhaktena vijānatā ..
anyathā pāpino jñeyā ye dviṣanti janārddanam .. 12 ..
15.26.d:
हरिजागरणं कार्यं मद्भक्तेन विजानता ..
अन्यथा पापिनो ज्ञेया ये द्विषन्ति जनार्द्दनम् .. 12 ..
15.26.m: A night vigil for Hari should be kept by one who knows, who is my devotee; / otherwise they are to be known as sinners who hate Janārdana. // 12

15.26.s:
jāgaraṃ ye ca kurvaṃti gāyaṃti harivāsare ..
agniṣṭomaphalaṃ teṣāṃ nimiṣārddhena ṣaṇmukha..13..
15.26.d:
जागरं ये च कुर्वंति गायंति हरिवासरे ..
अग्निष्टोमफलं तेषां निमिषार्द्धेन षण्मुख..13..
15.26.m: And those who keep vigil and sing on Hari's day, / theirs is the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice in half a moment, O six-faced one! // 13

15.26.s:
jāgare paśyatāṃ viṣṇormukhaṃ rātrau muhurmuhuḥ ..
yeṣāṃ hṛṣyaṃti romāṇi rātrau jāgaraṇe hareḥ ..
kulāni divi tāvaṃti vasaṃti harisannidhau .. 14 ..
15.26.d:
जागरे पश्यतां विष्णोर्मुखं रात्रौ मुहुर्मुहुः ..
येषां हृष्यंति रोमाणि रात्रौ जागरणे हरेः ..
कुलानि दिवि तावंति वसंति हरिसन्निधौ .. 14 ..
15.26.m: For those beholding Viṣṇu's face again and again at night during the vigil, / whose body hairs bristle with joy in the night vigil for Hari, / that many [generations of] families dwell in heaven in the presence of Hari. // 14

15.26.s:
yamasya pathi nirmuktā janāḥ pāpaśatairvṛtāḥ..
gītaśāstravinodena dvādaśījāgarānvitāḥ .. 15 ..
15.26.d:
यमस्य पथि निर्मुक्ता जनाः पापशतैर्वृताः..
गीतशास्त्रविनोदेन द्वादशीजागरान्विताः .. 15 ..
15.26.m: People surrounded by hundreds of sins are freed from the path of Yama / when engaged in the twelfth-day vigil with the diversion of songs and treatises. // 15

15.26.s:
suprabhātā niśā teṣāṃ dhanyāḥ sukṛtino narāḥ ..
prāṇātyayena muhyaṃti yaiḥ kṛtaṃ jāgaraṃ hareḥ ..16..
15.26.d:
सुप्रभाता निशा तेषां धन्याः सुकृतिनो नराः ..
प्राणात्ययेन मुह्यंति यैः कृतं जागरं हरेः ..16..
15.26.m: Fortunate is the dawn of their night; blessed and virtuous are those men; / they do not faint at the loss of life, by whom Hari's vigil has been kept. // 16

15.26.s:
putriṇaste narā loke dhaninaḥ khyātapauruṣāḥ ..
yeṣāṃ vaṃśodbhavāḥ putrāḥ kurvaṃti harijāgaram ..17..
15.26.d:
पुत्रिणस्ते नरा लोके धनिनः ख्यातपौरुषाः ..
येषां वंशोद्भवाः पुत्राः कुर्वंति हरिजागरम् ..17..
15.26.m: Those men in the world have sons, are wealthy, and are renowned for prowess, / whose sons born in their lineage observe Hari's night vigil. // 17

15.26.s:
iṣṭaṃ makhaiḥ kṛtaṃ dānaṃ dattaṃ piṃḍaṃ gayāśire ..
snātaṃ nityaṃ prayāge tu yaiḥ kṛtaṃ jāgaraṃ hareḥ .. 18 ..
15.26.d:
इष्टं मखैः कृतं दानं दत्तं पिंडं गयाशिरे ..
स्नातं नित्यं प्रयागे तु यैः कृतं जागरं हरेः .. 18 ..
15.26.m: Sacrifices have been offered, gifts have been given, the rice ball has been offered at Gayāśiras, / daily ritual ablution has been performed at Prayāga by those by whom Hari's night vigil has been kept. // 18

15.26.s:
dayitā viṣṇubhaktāśca nityaṃ mama ṣaḍānana ..
kurvaṃti vāsaraṃ viṣṇoryasmājjāgaraṇaṃ hitam ..19 ..
15.26.d:
दयिता विष्णुभक्ताश्च नित्यं मम षडानन ..
कुर्वंति वासरं विष्णोर्यस्माज्जागरणं हितम् ..19 ..
15.26.m: And the devotees of Viṣṇu are always dear to me, O six-faced one, / because they observe the day of Viṣṇu, since the night vigil is beneficial. // 19

15.26.s:
śrutvā harṣaṃ na cāpnoti jāgaraṃ na karoti yaḥ ..
prakaṭīkaroti tannūnaṃ jananyā durviceṣṭitam .. 7.4.26.20 ..
15.26.d:
श्रुत्वा हर्षं न चाप्नोति जागरं न करोति यः ..
प्रकटीकरोति तन्नूनं जनन्या दुर्विचेष्टितम् .. 7.4.26.20 ..
15.26.m: He who hears and does not experience joy, and does not perform the night vigil, / surely makes evident the bad conduct of his mother. // 20

15.26.s:
saṃprāpya vāsaraṃ viṣṇorna yeṣāṃ jāgaro hareḥ ..
vyarthaṃ gataṃ ca tatpuṇyaṃ teṣāṃ varṣaśatodbhavam .. 21 ..
15.26.d:
संप्राप्य वासरं विष्णोर्न येषां जागरो हरेः ..
व्यर्थं गतं च तत्पुण्यं तेषां वर्षशतोद्भवम् .. 21 ..
15.26.m: For those who do not observe Hari's vigil on reaching the day of Viṣṇu, / that merit of theirs produced over a hundred years has gone in vain. // 21

15.26.s:
putro vā putraputro vā dauhitro duhitā'pi vā .. .
kariṣyati kule'smākaṃ kalau jāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ .. 22 ..
15.26.d:
पुत्रो वा पुत्रपुत्रो वा दौहित्रो दुहिताऽपि वा .. .
करिष्यति कुलेऽस्माकं कलौ जागरणं हरेः .. 22 ..
15.26.m: 'Will a son, or a grandson, or a daughter's son, or even a daughter / perform the night vigil of Hari in our family during the Kali age?' // 22

15.26.s:
pātyamānāḥ prajalpaṃti pitaro yamakiṃkaraiḥ ..
muktirbhaviṣyatyasmākaṃ narakājjāgare kṛte ..23.. .
15.26.d:
पात्यमानाः प्रजल्पंति पितरो यमकिंकरैः ..
मुक्तिर्भविष्यत्यस्माकं नरकाज्जागरे कृते ..23.. .
15.26.m: Being cast down, the ancestors lament with Yama's servants: / 'Our liberation from hell will happen when the night vigil is performed. // 23

15.26.s:
nānyathā jāyate'smākaṃ muktiryajñaśatairapi ..
vinā jāgaraṇenaiva naralokātkathaṃcana ..
tasmājjāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ pitṝṇāṃ hitamicchatā .. 24 ..
15.26.d:
नान्यथा जायतेऽस्माकं मुक्तिर्यज्ञशतैरपि ..
विना जागरणेनैव नरलोकात्कथंचन ..
तस्माज्जागरणं कार्यं पितॄणां हितमिच्छता .. 24 ..
15.26.m: Otherwise our liberation does not arise, even through hundreds of sacrifices, / from the mortal world without the night vigil in any way; / therefore, a night vigil must be performed by one who desires the welfare of the ancestors.' // 24

15.26.s:
bhaktirbhāgavatānāṃ ca goviṃdasyāpi kīrtanam ..
na dehagrahaṇaṃ tasmātpunarloke bhaviṣyati .. 25 ..
15.26.d:
भक्तिर्भागवतानां च गोविंदस्यापि कीर्तनम् ..
न देहग्रहणं तस्मात्पुनर्लोके भविष्यति .. 25 ..
15.26.m: Devotion to the devotees of the Lord and the praise of Govinda: / from this there will be no taking on of a body again in the world. // 25

15.26.s:
jāgaraṃ kurute yaśca saṃgame vijayādine ..
punarddehaprajananaṃ dagdhaṃ tenā''tmanā svayam .. 26 ..
15.26.d:
जागरं कुरुते यश्च संगमे विजयादिने ..
पुनर्द्देहप्रजननं दग्धं तेना'ऽत्मना स्वयम् .. 26 ..
15.26.m: And he who keeps a night vigil at the confluence on the day called Vijayā, / by him has rebirth in a body been burned away by himself. // 26

15.26.s:
trispṛśā vāsaraṃ yena kṛtaṃ jāgaraṇānvitam ..
keśavasya śarīre tu sa līno nātra saṃśayaḥ ..27 ..
15.26.d:
त्रिस्पृशा वासरं येन कृतं जागरणान्वितम् ..
केशवस्य शरीरे तु स लीनो नात्र संशयः ..27 ..
15.26.m: By whom the day of Trispṛśā is observed together with a night vigil, / he is merged into the body of Keśava, there is no doubt here. // 27

15.26.s:
unmīlinī kṛtā yena rātrau jāgaraṇānvitā ..
prabhavaṃti na pāpāni sthūlasūkṣmāṇi tasya tu .. 28 ..
15.26.d:
उन्मीलिनी कृता येन रात्रौ जागरणान्विता ..
प्रभवंति न पापानि स्थूलसूक्ष्माणि तस्य तु .. 28 ..
15.26.m: By whom the Unmīlinī is observed accompanied by a night vigil at night, / sins, coarse or subtle, do not prevail over him. // 28

15.26.s:
satālavādyasaṃyuktaṃ saṃgītaṃ jāgaraṃ hareḥ ..
yaḥ kārayati devasya dvādaśyāṃ dānasaṃyutam .. 29 ..
15.26.d:
सतालवाद्यसंयुक्तं संगीतं जागरं हरेः ..
यः कारयति देवस्य द्वादश्यां दानसंयुतम् .. 29 ..
15.26.m: One who causes a night vigil for Hari to be performed with singing accompanied by rhythm and instruments, / for the god on the twelfth [day], together with gifts, // 29

15.26.s:
tasya puṇyaṃ pravakṣyāmi mahābhāgavatasya hi ..
tilaprasthahasraṃ tu sahiraṇyaṃ dvijātaye ..
dattvā yatphalamāpnoti hyayane ravisaṃkrame .. 7.4.26.30 ..
15.26.d:
तस्य पुण्यं प्रवक्ष्यामि महाभागवतस्य हि ..
तिलप्रस्थहस्रं तु सहिरण्यं द्विजातये ..
दत्त्वा यत्फलमाप्नोति ह्ययने रविसंक्रमे .. 7.4.26.30 ..
15.26.m: I shall declare the merit of that great devotee of the Lord. / What fruit one obtains by giving a thousand prasthas of sesame seeds with gold to a twice-born on a solstice, during the transit of the sun,

15.26.s:
hemabhāraśataṃ nityaṃ savatsaṃ kapilāyutam ..
prekṣaṇīyapradānena tatphalaṃ prāpnuyātkalau .. 31 ..
15.26.d:
हेमभारशतं नित्यं सवत्सं कपिलायुतम् ..
प्रेक्षणीयप्रदानेन तत्फलं प्राप्नुयात्कलौ .. 31 ..
15.26.m: or [by giving] a hundred bhāras of gold, always along with ten thousand brown cows with their calves— / that very fruit one obtains in the Kali age by offering a dramatic performance.

15.26.s:
yaḥ punarvāsare putra divyairṛṣikṛtaiḥ stavaiḥ ..
toṣayetpadmanābhaṃ vai vaidikairviṣṇusāmabhiḥ .. 32 ..
15.26.d:
यः पुनर्वासरे पुत्र दिव्यैरृषिकृतैः स्तवैः ..
तोषयेत्पद्मनाभं वै वैदिकैर्विष्णुसामभिः .. 32 ..
15.26.m: Moreover, O son, on [that] day, he who should please the Lotus-navelled one / with celestial praises composed by seers, with Vedic chants of the Sāmaveda addressed to Viṣṇu,

15.26.s:
ṛgyajuḥsāmasambhūtaivaiṣṇavaiścaiva putraka ..
saṃskṛtaiḥ prākṛtaiḥ stotrairanyaiśca vividhaistathā .. 33 ..
15.26.d:
ऋग्यजुःसामसम्भूतैवैष्णवैश्चैव पुत्रक ..
संस्कृतैः प्राकृतैः स्तोत्रैरन्यैश्च विविधैस्तथा .. 33 ..
15.26.m: with chants arisen from the Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāma Vedas, and with Vaiṣṇava [hymns], O my son, / with praises in Sanskrit and Prakrit, and likewise with various others—

15.26.s:
prītiṃ karoti deveśo dvādaśyāṃ jāgare sthitaḥ ..
śṛṇu puṇyaṃ samāsena yadgītaṃ brahmaṇā mama .. 34 ..
15.26.d:
प्रीतिं करोति देवेशो द्वादश्यां जागरे स्थितः ..
शृणु पुण्यं समासेन यद्गीतं ब्रह्मणा मम .. 34 ..
15.26.m: the Lord of the gods feels delight [toward him], remaining awake during the vigil on the twelfth day. / Hear briefly the merit as it was sung to me by Brahmā:

15.26.s:
triḥsaptakṛtvo dharaṇīṃ triguṇīkṛtya ṣaṇmukha ..
dattvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ .. 35 ..
15.26.d:
त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो धरणीं त्रिगुणीकृत्य षण्मुख ..
दत्त्वा यत्फलमाप्नोति तत्फलं प्राप्नुयान्नरः .. 35 ..
15.26.m: O six-faced one, the fruit that a man attains by giving the earth three times seven times, / after making it three times [as great], that very fruit he attains.

15.26.s:
gavāṃ śatasahasreṇa savatsenāpi yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ prāpnuyānmarttyaḥ stotrairyastoṣayeddharim .. 36 ..
15.26.d:
गवां शतसहस्रेण सवत्सेनापि यत्फलम् ..
तत्फलं प्राप्नुयान्मर्त्त्यः स्तोत्रैर्यस्तोषयेद्धरिम् .. 36 ..
15.26.m: Whatever fruit [comes] through a hundred thousand cows along with their calves, / that fruit a mortal obtains who pleases Hari with praises.

15.26.s:
vaidikī daśaguṇā prītiryāmenaikena jāgare ..
evaṃ phalānusāreṇa kāryyaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ .. 37 ..
15.26.d:
वैदिकी दशगुणा प्रीतिर्यामेनैकेन जागरे ..
एवं फलानुसारेण कार्य्यं जागरणं हरेः .. 37 ..
15.26.m: Vedic [praise brings] tenfold delight during a single watch in the vigil; / in this manner, according to the fruits, the keeping of the vigil of Hari should be performed.

15.26.s:
yaḥ punaḥ paṭhate rātrau gītāṃ nāmasahasrakam ..
dvādaśyāṃ purato viṣṇorveṣṇavānāṃ samīpataḥ .. 38 ..
15.26.d:
यः पुनः पठते रात्रौ गीतां नामसहस्रकम् ..
द्वादश्यां पुरतो विष्णोर्वेष्णवानां समीपतः .. 38 ..
15.26.m: Moreover, he who recites the Gītā [and] the Thousand Names at night / on the twelfth day in the presence of Viṣṇu, near Vaiṣṇavas,

15.26.s:
puṇyaṃ bhāgavataṃ skāṃdapurāṇaṃ dayitaṃ hareḥ ..
mādhuraṃ bālacaritaṃ gopīnāṃ caritaṃ tathā .. 39 ..
15.26.d:
पुण्यं भागवतं स्कांदपुराणं दयितं हरेः ..
माधुरं बालचरितं गोपीनां चरितं तथा .. 39 ..
15.26.m: the holy Bhāgavata, the Skandapurāṇa dear to Hari, / the sweet deeds of his childhood, and likewise the deeds of the cowherd women—

15.26.s:
etānpaṭhati rātrau yaḥ pūjayitvā tu keśavam ..
na vedmyahaṃ phalaṃ vatsa yadi jñāsyati keśavaḥ .. 7.4.26.40 ..
15.26.d:
एतान्पठति रात्रौ यः पूजयित्वा तु केशवम् ..
न वेद्म्यहं फलं वत्स यदि ज्ञास्यति केशवः .. 7.4.26.40 ..
15.26.m: he who recites these at night having worshipped Keśava: / O dear child, I do not know the fruit, [though] perhaps Keśava knows it!

15.26.s:
dīpaṃ prajvālayedrātrau yaḥ stavairharijāgare ..
na cāstaṃ gacchate tasya puṇyaṃ kalpaśatairapi .. 41 ..
15.26.d:
दीपं प्रज्वालयेद्रात्रौ यः स्तवैर्हरिजागरे ..
न चास्तं गच्छते तस्य पुण्यं कल्पशतैरपि .. 41 ..
15.26.m: He who kindles a lamp at night during the vigil of Hari with praises, / his merit does not set even after hundreds of kalpas.

15.26.s:
maṃjarīsahitaiḥ patraistulasīsambhavairharim ..
jāgare pūjayedbhaktyā nāsti tasya punarbhavaḥ .. 42 ..
15.26.d:
मंजरीसहितैः पत्रैस्तुलसीसम्भवैर्हरिम् ..
जागरे पूजयेद्भक्त्या नास्ति तस्य पुनर्भवः .. 42 ..
15.26.m: He who worships Hari with devotion during the vigil with leaves / accompanied by flower-spikes born of the tulasī plant, there is no rebirth for him.

15.26.s:
snānaṃ vilepanaṃ pūjā dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca saṃstavam ..
naivedyaṃ ca satāṃbūlaṃ jāgare dattamakṣayam ..43..
15.26.d:
स्नानं विलेपनं पूजा धूपं दीपं च संस्तवम् ..
नैवेद्यं च सतांबूलं जागरे दत्तमक्षयम् ..43..
15.26.m: A ritual ablution, anointment, worship, incense, a lamp, and a song of praise, / and food-offering with betel-nut given during the vigil are imperishable.

15.26.s:
dhyātumicchati ṣaḍvaktraṃ yo māṃ bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ..
sa karotu mahābhaktyā dvādaśyāṃ jāgaraṃ hareḥ .. 44 ..
15.26.d:
ध्यातुमिच्छति षड्वक्त्रं यो मां भक्तिपरायणः ..
स करोतु महाभक्त्या द्वादश्यां जागरं हरेः .. 44 ..
15.26.m: Whoever, dedicated to devotion, desires to meditate upon me, the six-faced one, / let him perform the vigil of Hari on the twelfth day with great devotion.

15.26.s:
vāsare vāsudevasya sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ ..
dehamāśritya tiṣṭhaṃti ye prakurvaṃti jāgaram .. 45 ..
15.26.d:
वासरे वासुदेवस्य सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः ..
देहमाश्रित्य तिष्ठंति ये प्रकुर्वंति जागरम् .. 45 ..
15.26.m: On the day of Vāsudeva, all the gods together with Indra / stay taking shelter in the bodies of those who perform the vigil.

15.26.s:
jāgarevāsudevasya mahābhāratakīrtanam ..
ye kurvaṃti gatiṃ yāṃti yogināṃ te na saṃśayaḥ .. 46 ..
15.26.d:
जागरेवासुदेवस्य महाभारतकीर्तनम् ..
ये कुर्वंति गतिं यांति योगिनां ते न संशयः .. 46 ..
15.26.m: Those who perform the recitation of the Mahābhārata during the vigil of Vāsudeva / attain the goal of the yogins—there is no doubt about this.

15.26.s:
caritaṃ rāmadevasya ye vadhaṃ rāvaṇasya ca ..
paṭhaṃti jāgare viṣṇoste yāṃti paramāṃ gatima .. 47
15.26.d:
चरितं रामदेवस्य ये वधं रावणस्य च ..
पठंति जागरे विष्णोस्ते यांति परमां गतिम .. 47
15.26.m: Those who read the deeds of the divine Rāma and the slaying of Rāvaṇa / during the vigil of Viṣṇu, go to the supreme state.

15.26.s:
adhītya caturo vedānkṛtvā caivārcanaṃ hareḥ ..
snātvā ca sarvatīrtheṣu jāgare tatphalaṃ hareḥ .. 49 ..
rathānāmayutairyattu sahasrairvaravāraṇaiḥ .. lakṣeṇāśvavarāṇāṃ tu tatphalaṃ jāgare hareḥ .. 49 ..
15.26.d:
अधीत्य चतुरो वेदान्कृत्वा चैवार्चनं हरेः ..
स्नात्वा च सर्वतीर्थेषु जागरे तत्फलं हरेः .. 49 ..
रथानामयुतैर्यत्तु सहस्रैर्वरवारणैः .. लक्षेणाश्ववराणां तु तत्फलं जागरे हरेः .. 49 ..
15.26.m:
Studying the four Vedas and performing the worship of Hari, / and bathing at all sacred fords: that fruit [comes] in the vigil of Hari.
Whatever [fruit comes] through ten thousand chariots, thousands of excellent elephants, / and through a hundred thousand excellent horses—that fruit is in the vigil of Hari.

15.26.s:
dhānyaśailasahasraistu tulāpuruṣako ṭibhiḥ ..
yatphalaṃ munibhiḥ proktaṃ tatphalaṃ jāgare hareḥ .. 7.4.26.50 ..
15.26.d:
धान्यशैलसहस्रैस्तु तुलापुरुषको टिभिः ..
यत्फलं मुनिभिः प्रोक्तं तत्फलं जागरे हरेः .. 7.4.26.50 ..
15.26.m: Whatever fruit has been spoken of by the sages through thousands of grain-mountains / and through crores of gifts of one's weight in gold—that fruit is in the vigil of Hari.

15.26.s:
kanyākoṭipradānaṃ ca svarṇabhāraśataṃ tathā ..
dattaṃ ratnāyutaśataṃ yaiḥ kṛto jāgaro hareḥ .. 51 ..
15.26.d:
कन्याकोटिप्रदानं च स्वर्णभारशतं तथा ..
दत्तं रत्नायुतशतं यैः कृतो जागरो हरेः .. 51 ..
15.26.m: The gift of a crore of maidens, and likewise a hundred bhāras of gold, / [and] a million gems are as though given by those by whom the vigil of Hari has been kept.

15.26.s:
aṣṭādaśapurāṇaistu paṭhitairyatphalaṃ bhavet ..
tatphalaṃ śatasāhasraṃ kṛte jāgaraṇe hareḥ .. 52 ..
15.26.d:
अष्टादशपुराणैस्तु पठितैर्यत्फलं भवेत् ..
तत्फलं शतसाहस्रं कृते जागरणे हरेः .. 52 ..
15.26.m: Whatever fruit would arise from reciting the eighteen Purāṇas, / that fruit [is increased] a hundred thousand times when the vigil of Hari is performed.

15.26.s:
manvādi paṭhatāṃ śāstraṃ yatphalaṃ hi dvijanmanaḥ ..
adhikaṃ phalamāpnoti kurvāṇo jāgaraṃ hareḥ .. 53 ..
15.26.d:
मन्वादि पठतां शास्त्रं यत्फलं हि द्विजन्मनः ..
अधिकं फलमाप्नोति कुर्वाणो जागरं हरेः .. 53 ..
15.26.m: Whatever fruit is attained by a twice-born reading the treatises of Manu and others, / he who keeps the vigil of Hari obtains a greater fruit.

15.26.s:
durbhikṣe cānnadātṝṇāṃ puṃsāṃ bhavati yatphalam ..
saṃnyāsināṃ sahasraistu yatphalaṃ bhojitaiḥ kalau ..
phalaṃ tatsamavāpnoti kurvatāṃ jāgaraṃ hareḥ .. 54 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvādaśījāgaraṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 26 ..
15.26.d:
दुर्भिक्षे चान्नदातॄणां पुंसां भवति यत्फलम् ..
संन्यासिनां सहस्रैस्तु यत्फलं भोजितैः कलौ ..
फलं तत्समवाप्नोति कुर्वतां जागरं हरेः .. 54 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये द्वादशीजागरणमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षड्विंशतितमोऽध्यायः .. 26 ..
15.26.m:
Whatever fruit belongs to men who are givers of food in a famine, / and whatever fruit [comes] by feeding thousands of renunciants in the Kali age, / that fruit is obtained by those keeping the vigil of Hari.
Thus ends the twenty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Vigil on the Twelfth Day', in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, in the fourth [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [book] in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

15.27.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
sthitvā dvādaśijāgare kratu same duḥkhāpahe puṇyade ramyaṃ bhāgavataṃ śṛṇoti puruṣaḥ kṛtvā hareḥ pūjanam ..
puṇyaṃ vājimakhasya koṭiguṇitaṃ saṃprāpya bhaktottamaśchittvā pāśasamūha pakṣanicayaṃ prāpnoti kṛṣṇālayam .. 1 ..
15.27.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
स्थित्वा द्वादशिजागरे क्रतु समे दुःखापहे पुण्यदे रम्यं भागवतं शृणोति पुरुषः कृत्वा हरेः पूजनम् ..
पुण्यं वाजिमखस्य कोटिगुणितं संप्राप्य भक्तोत्तमश्छित्त्वा पाशसमूह पक्षनिचयं प्राप्नोति कृष्णालयम् .. 1 ..
15.27.m: Īśvara said: / Remaining in the vigil on the twelfth day, which equals a sacrificial rite, dispels sorrow, and grants merit, a person hears the delightful Bhāgavata after performing the worship of Hari; / obtaining merit ten million times that of a horse sacrifice, the best among devotees breaks the mass of bonds and wings [of transmigration] and reaches the abode of Kṛṣṇa.

15.27.s:
hatyāpāpasamūhakoṭinicayairgurvaṃganā- koṭibhiḥsteyairlakṣaguṇairgurorvadhakaraiḥ saṃveṣṭito yadyapi ..
śrutvā bhāgavataṃ chinatti sakalaṃ kṛtvā harerjāgaraṃ muktiṃ yāti narendra nirmalavapurbhittvā ravermaṃḍalam .. 2 ..
15.27.d:
हत्यापापसमूहकोटिनिचयैर्गुर्वंगना- कोटिभिःस्तेयैर्लक्षगुणैर्गुरोर्वधकरैः संवेष्टितो यद्यपि ..
श्रुत्वा भागवतं छिनत्ति सकलं कृत्वा हरेर्जागरं मुक्तिं याति नरेन्द्र निर्मलवपुर्भित्त्वा रवेर्मंडलम् .. 2 ..
15.27.m: Even if surrounded by hundreds of millions of piles of murder sins, by [sins with] tens of millions of wives of the guru, / and by thefts multiplied a hundred thousand times that cause the destruction of a guru, / hearing the Bhāgavata, he severs all [of them] after keeping the vigil of Hari, and goes to liberation, O king, with a pure body, piercing through the disc of the sun.

15.27.s:
ekādaśī dvādaśisaṃpraviṣṭā kṛtā nabhasye śravaṇena yuktā ..
viśeṣataḥ somasutena saṃgame karoti muktiṃ prapitāmahānām .. 3 ..
15.27.d:
एकादशी द्वादशिसंप्रविष्टा कृता नभस्ये श्रवणेन युक्ता ..
विशेषतः सोमसुतेन संगमे करोति मुक्तिं प्रपितामहानाम् .. 3 ..
15.27.m: An eleventh day that extends into the twelfth, observed in the month of Bhādrapada along with the asterism Śravaṇa, / especially during a conjunction with Mercury, effects the liberation of one's great-grandfathers.

15.27.s:
yaddīyate dvādaśivāsare śubhe viṣṇuṃ samuddiśya tathā pitṝṇām ..
paryyāptamiṣṭhaiḥ kratutīrthadānairbhaktyā pradattaṃ khalu merutulyam .. 4 ..
15.27.d:
यद्दीयते द्वादशिवासरे शुभे विष्णुं समुद्दिश्य तथा पितॄणाम् ..
पर्य्याप्तमिष्ठैः क्रतुतीर्थदानैर्भक्त्या प्रदत्तं खलु मेरुतुल्यम् .. 4 ..
15.27.m: Whatever is given on the auspicious twelfth day with intention toward Viṣṇu and likewise toward the ancestors, / [even that which is] sufficient through desired sacrifices, sacred fords, and gifts, when given with devotion, is indeed equal to Mount Meru.

15.27.s:
mahānadīṃ prāpya dinaṃ ca viṣṇostoyāṃjaliṃ yastupitṝndadāti ..
śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tena samāḥ sahasraṃ yacchanti kāmānpitaraḥ sutṛptāḥ ..5..
15.27.d:
महानदीं प्राप्य दिनं च विष्णोस्तोयांजलिं यस्तुपितॄन्ददाति ..
श्राद्धं कृतं तेन समाः सहस्रं यच्छन्ति कामान्पितरः सुतृप्ताः ..5..
15.27.m: He who reaches a great river on the day of Viṣṇu and offers a handful of water to the ancestors, / by him a funeral ritual has been performed for a thousand years; the well-satisfied ancestors grant his desires.

15.27.s:
śaraṇāgatānāṃ paripālanena hyannapradānena śṛṇuṣva putra ..
ṛṇapradāne dvijadevatānāṃ tadvai phalaṃ jāgaraṇen viṣṇoḥ .. 6 ..
15.27.d:
शरणागतानां परिपालनेन ह्यन्नप्रदानेन शृणुष्व पुत्र ..
ऋणप्रदाने द्विजदेवतानां तद्वै फलं जागरणेन् विष्णोः .. 6 ..
15.27.m: Listen, O son: by protecting those who have come for refuge, by the gift of food, / and by paying the debts of brahmins and deities, that fruit indeed [comes] through the vigil of Viṣṇu.

15.27.s:
yaḥ svarṇadhenuṃ madhunīradhenuṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ raupyasuvarṇameru ..
brahmāṃḍadānaṃ pradadāti yāti sa vai phalaṃ jāgaraṇena viṣṇoḥ .. 7 ..
15.27.d:
यः स्वर्णधेनुं मधुनीरधेनुं कृष्णाजिनं रौप्यसुवर्णमेरु ..
ब्रह्मांडदानं प्रददाति याति स वै फलं जागरणेन विष्णोः .. 7 ..
15.27.m: He who gives a golden cow, a cow made of honey and ghee, a black-antelope skin, a mountain of silver and gold, / and the gift of a cosmic egg, attains the very fruit of the vigil of Viṣṇu.

15.27.s:
satyena śaucena damena yatphalaṃ kṣamādayādānabalena ṣaṇmukha ..
daśāśvamedhairbahudakṣiṇaiśca teṣāṃ phalaṃ jāgaraṇena viṣṇoḥ .. 8 ..
15.27.d:
सत्येन शौचेन दमेन यत्फलं क्षमादयादानबलेन षण्मुख ..
दशाश्वमेधैर्बहुदक्षिणैश्च तेषां फलं जागरणेन विष्णोः .. 8 ..
15.27.m: Whatever fruit is attained through truth, purity, self-restraint, forbearance, compassion, and the power of giving, O six-faced one, / and through ten horse sacrifices with abundant sacrificial gifts, that is the fruit of the vigil of Viṣṇu.

15.27.s:
snānena yatprāpya nadīṃ vīraṣṭhāṃ yatpiṃḍadānena piturgayāyām ..
yaddhemadānātkurujāṃgale ca tatsyātphalaṃ jāgaraṇena viṣṇoḥ .. 9 ..
15.27.d:
स्नानेन यत्प्राप्य नदीं वीरष्ठां यत्पिंडदानेन पितुर्गयायाम् ..
यद्धेमदानात्कुरुजांगले च तत्स्यात्फलं जागरणेन विष्णोः .. 9 ..
15.27.m: Whatever [is attained] by bathing upon reaching an auspicious river, whatever by giving a rice ball to the father at Gayā, / and whatever from the gift of gold in Kurujāṅgala—that fruit will be obtained through the vigil of Viṣṇu.

15.27.s:
hatyāyutānāṃ yadi saṃcitānisteyāni rukmasya tathāmitāni ..
nihaṃtyanekāni purākṛtāni śrījāgare ye prapaṭhaṃti gītam .. 7.4.27.10 ..
15.27.d:
हत्यायुतानां यदि संचितानिस्तेयानि रुक्मस्य तथामितानि ..
निहंत्यनेकानि पुराकृतानि श्रीजागरे ये प्रपठंति गीतम् .. 7.4.27.10 ..
15.27.m: If tens of thousands of murders have been accumulated, and likewise boundless thefts of gold, / those who recite songs during the glorious vigil destroy many of them performed in the past.

15.27.s:
mārgaṃ na te saurapurasya dūtānvanāṃtaraṃ ṣaṇmukha kiṃcidanyat ..
svapne na paśyaṃti ca te manuṣyā yeṣāṃ gatā jāgaraṇena nidrā .. 11 ..
15.27.d:
मार्गं न ते सौरपुरस्य दूतान्वनांतरं षण्मुख किंचिदन्यत् ..
स्वप्ने न पश्यंति च ते मनुष्या येषां गता जागरणेन निद्रा .. 11 ..
15.27.m: Neither the path nor the messengers of the city of Yama, nor another forest, O six-faced one, nor anything else / do those men see even in a dream whose sleep has departed through the vigil.

15.27.s:
kāṣāyavastraiśca jaṭābharaiśca pūrtāgnihotraiḥ kimu cānya mantraiḥ ..
dharmārthakāmavaramokṣakarīṃ ca bhadrāmekāṃ bhajasva kalikālavināśinīṃ ca .. 12 ..
15.27.d:
काषायवस्त्रैश्च जटाभरैश्च पूर्ताग्निहोत्रैः किमु चान्य मन्त्रैः ..
धर्मार्थकामवरमोक्षकरीं च भद्रामेकां भजस्व कलिकालविनाशिनीं च .. 12 ..
15.27.m: What is the use of ochre robes and matted locks, of public works and agnihotra offerings, or of other mantras? / Devote yourself to that single auspicious [observance] which grants dharma, wealth, pleasure, and supreme liberation, and destroys the Kali age! 12

15.27.s:
ityuktapūrvaṃ kila nāradena śreyorthabuddhyā vinatāsutāya ..
kṛṣṇātparaṃ nānyadihāsti daivaṃ vrataṃ tadahnaḥ paramaṃ na kiṃcit .. 13 ..
15.27.d:
इत्युक्तपूर्वं किल नारदेन श्रेयोर्थबुद्ध्या विनतासुताय ..
कृष्णात्परं नान्यदिहास्ति दैवं व्रतं तदह्नः परमं न किंचित् .. 13 ..
15.27.m: This was formerly spoken by Nārada, out of concern for his welfare, to the son of Vinatā: / 'There is no deity in this world superior to Kṛṣṇa, and no vow superior to [the fast on] his day.' 13

15.27.s:
bhobhoḥ surāḥ śṛṇuta nārada ityavocadbhobhoḥ khagendraṛṣisiddhamunīndrasaṃghāḥ ..
utkṣipya bāhumatha bhaktajanena coktaṃ naikādaśīvratasamaṃ vratamasti kiṃcit.. 14 ..
15.27.d:
भोभोः सुराः शृणुत नारद इत्यवोचद्भोभोः खगेन्द्रऋषिसिद्धमुनीन्द्रसंघाः ..
उत्क्षिप्य बाहुमथ भक्तजनेन चोक्तं नैकादशीव्रतसमं व्रतमस्ति किंचित्.. 14 ..
15.27.m: 'Listen, O gods!' Nārada said, 'Listen, O king of birds, O hosts of seers, perfected beings, and great sages!' / Then, raising his arm, he declared to the devotee: 'There is no vow equal to the vow of Ekādaśī!' 14

15.27.s:
pakṣīndra pāpapuruṣā na hariṃ bhajaṃti tadbhaktiśāstraniratā na kalau bhavaṃti ..
kurvaṃti mūḍhamanaso daśamīvimiśrāmekādaśīṃ śubhadinaṃ ca parityajaṃti .. 15 ..
15.27.d:
पक्षीन्द्र पापपुरुषा न हरिं भजंति तद्भक्तिशास्त्रनिरता न कलौ भवंति ..
कुर्वंति मूढमनसो दशमीविमिश्रामेकादशीं शुभदिनं च परित्यजंति .. 15 ..
15.27.m: O lord of birds, sinful men do not worship Hari; they do not devote themselves to the scriptures of devotion to him in the Kali age. / Foolish in mind, they observe an Ekādaśī overlapping with the tenth day, and abandon the auspicious day. 15

15.27.s:
ārttaḥ sadā caiva sadā ca rogī pāpī sadā caiva sadā ca duḥkhī ..
sadā kulaghno'tha sadā ca nārakī viddhaṃ murārerdinamāśrayettu yaḥ .. 16 ..
15.27.d:
आर्त्तः सदा चैव सदा च रोगी पापी सदा चैव सदा च दुःखी ..
सदा कुलघ्नोऽथ सदा च नारकी विद्धं मुरारेर्दिनमाश्रयेत्तु यः .. 16 ..
15.27.m: Afflicted always, diseased always, sinful always, and sorrowful always, / a destroyer of his family always, and an inhabitant of hell always is he who resorts to the overlapping day of Murāri. 16

15.27.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyā saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvādaśījāgaraṇasya sarvatovareṇyatvavarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 27 ..
15.27.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहिताया सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये द्वादशीजागरणस्य सर्वतोवरेण्यत्ववर्णनंनाम सप्तविंशतितमोऽध्यायः .. 27 ..
15.27.m: Thus ends the twenty-seventh chapter, entitled 'Description of the Supreme Superiority of the Dvādaśī Vigil', in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [part] in the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [division] in the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skandapurāṇa. 27

15.28.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ viṣṇoryathānyāyaṃ nareśvara ..
pitṝnyacchati puṇyaṃ ca tataḥ kiṃ kurute yamaḥ .. 1 ..
15.28.d:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
कृत्वा जागरणं विष्णोर्यथान्यायं नरेश्वर ..
पितॄन्यच्छति पुण्यं च ततः किं कुरुते यमः .. 1 ..
15.28.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having kept the vigil of Viṣṇu according to rule, O ruler of men, / one offers the merit to the ancestors; what then can Yama do? 1

15.28.s:
bhukto vā yadi vā'bhuktaḥ svaccho vā'svaccha eva vā ..
vimuktiḥ kathitā tatra harijāgaraṇānnṛṇām ..2..
15.28.d:
भुक्तो वा यदि वाऽभुक्तः स्वच्छो वाऽस्वच्छ एव वा ..
विमुक्तिः कथिता तत्र हरिजागरणान्नृणाम् ..2..
15.28.m: Whether one has eaten or not eaten, whether pure or impure, / complete liberation is proclaimed for men from keeping the vigil of Hari. 2

15.28.s:
asnāto vā naraḥ snāto jāgare samupasthite ..
sarvatīrthāpluto jñeyastaṃ dṛṣṭvā divamāvrajet .. 3 ..
15.28.d:
अस्नातो वा नरः स्नातो जागरे समुपस्थिते ..
सर्वतीर्थाप्लुतो ज्ञेयस्तं दृष्ट्वा दिवमाव्रजेत् .. 3 ..
15.28.m: Whether unbathed or bathed, when the vigil arrives, / a man should be regarded as bathed in all sacred fords; having seen him, one attains heaven. 3

15.28.s:
śvapacā jāgaraṃ kṛtvā padaṃ nirvāṇamāgatāḥ ..
kiṃ punarvarṇasaṃbhūtāḥ sadācāraparāstathā .. 4 ..
15.28.d:
श्वपचा जागरं कृत्वा पदं निर्वाणमागताः ..
किं पुनर्वर्णसंभूताः सदाचारपरास्तथा .. 4 ..
15.28.m: Outcastes, having kept the vigil, have attained the state of nirvāṇa; / what then of those born in the [higher] classes who are devoted to right conduct? 4

15.28.s:
yuvatīnādamākarṇya yathā nidrā na jāyate ..
jāgare caivameva syāttatkathānāṃ ca kīrtane .. 5 ..
15.28.d:
युवतीनादमाकर्ण्य यथा निद्रा न जायते ..
जागरे चैवमेव स्यात्तत्कथानां च कीर्तने .. 5 ..
15.28.m: Just as sleep does not come when hearing the sound of young women, / even so it should be during the vigil and while glorifying his stories. 5

15.28.s:
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṃganāgamaḥ ..
utkallanaṃ manaḥpāpaṃ śodhayedviṣṇu jāgaraḥ .. 6 ..
15.28.d:
ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वंगनागमः ..
उत्कल्लनं मनःपापं शोधयेद्विष्णु जागरः .. 6 ..
15.28.m: Killing a brahmin, drinking liquor, stealing, violating the guru's wife, / arrogance, and mental sin—the vigil of Viṣṇu purifies them all. 6

15.28.s: vimuktiḥ kāmukasyoktā kiṃ punarvīkṣatāṃ harim .. 7 ..
15.28.d: विमुक्तिः कामुकस्योक्ता किं पुनर्वीक्षतां हरिम् .. 7 ..
15.28.m: Liberation is declared even for a lustful man; what then for those who behold Hari? 7

15.28.s:
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karaṇairyadupārjitam..
anyairnimiṣamātreṇa vyapohati na saṃśayaḥ .. 8 ..
15.28.d:
वाचिकं मानसं पापं करणैर्यदुपार्जितम्..
अन्यैर्निमिषमात्रेण व्यपोहति न संशयः .. 8 ..
15.28.m: Vocal sin, mental sin, and that which is incurred through the organs [of action] / and by others, it destroys in a mere instant; there is no doubt. 8

15.28.s:
goṣṭhyāṃ samāgatā ye tu teṣāṃ pāpaṃ kutaḥ smṛtam ..
mātṛpūjā gayāśrāddhaṃ sutīrthagamanaṃ tathā ..
jāgarasya nṛṇāṃ rājansamāni kavayo viduḥ .. 9 ..
15.28.d:
गोष्ठ्यां समागता ये तु तेषां पापं कुतः स्मृतम् ..
मातृपूजा गयाश्राद्धं सुतीर्थगमनं तथा ..
जागरस्य नृणां राजन्समानि कवयो विदुः .. 9 ..
15.28.m: As for those who gather in the assembly, whence could there be any sin for them? / Honoring mother, performing the śrāddha at Gayā, and visiting sacred fords— / poets know these to be equal to men's vigil, O king. 9

15.28.s:
jananīpūjanaṃ bhūpa hyaśvamedhāyutaiḥ samam ..
pūrṇaṃ varṣaśataṃ bhūpa kuśāgreṇoddhṛtaṃ jalam .. 7.4.28.10 ..
15.28.d:
जननीपूजनं भूप ह्यश्वमेधायुतैः समम् ..
पूर्णं वर्षशतं भूप कुशाग्रेणोद्धृतं जलम् .. 7.4.28.10 ..
15.28.m: Honoring mother, O king, is equal to ten thousand horse sacrifices. / Drinking water taken up with the tip of a kuśa grass for a full hundred years, O king, 10

15.28.s:
pibanpātre dvijaḥ samyaktīrthe puṣkarasaṃjñite ..
jāgarasyaiva caitāni kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm .. 11 ..
15.28.d:
पिबन्पात्रे द्विजः सम्यक्तीर्थे पुष्करसंज्ञिते ..
जागरस्यैव चैतानि कलां नार्हंति षोडशीम् .. 11 ..
15.28.m: from a cup by a twice-born properly at the sacred ford called Puṣkara— / these do not equal even a sixteenth part of the vigil. 11

15.28.s:
kṛtvā kāṃcanasaṃpūrṇāṃ vasudhāṃ vasudhādhipa ..
dattvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ harijāgare .. 12 ..
15.28.d:
कृत्वा कांचनसंपूर्णां वसुधां वसुधाधिप ..
दत्त्वा यत्फलमाप्नोति तत्फलं हरिजागरे .. 12 ..
15.28.m: Making the earth filled with gold, O lord of the earth, / the fruit one obtains from giving it away, that fruit is obtained in the vigil of Hari. 12

15.28.s:
nikṛṃtanaṃ karmaṇaśca hyātmanā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam ..
vyapohati na saṃdeho yena jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtam .. ..
saṃkṣepataḥ pravakṣyāmi punareva mahīpate ..
jāgare padmanābhasya yatphalaṃ kavayo viduḥ .. 14 ..
15.28.d:
निकृंतनं कर्मणश्च ह्यात्मना दुष्कृतं कृतम् ..
व्यपोहति न संदेहो येन जागरणं कृतम् .. ..
संक्षेपतः प्रवक्ष्यामि पुनरेव महीपते ..
जागरे पद्मनाभस्य यत्फलं कवयो विदुः .. 14 ..
15.28.m: It is the severing of karma, and the misdeed committed by oneself / is destroyed, there is no doubt, by him who has kept the vigil. / I will tell you briefly once again, O king of the earth, / the fruit known by the poets of the vigil of Padmanābha. 14

15.28.s:
raverbiṃbamidaṃ bhittvā sa yogī harijāgare ..
prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yogigamyaṃ niraṃjanam ..
sāṃkhyayogaiḥ suduḥkhena prāpyate yatpadaṃ hareḥ .. 15 ..
15.28.d:
रवेर्बिंबमिदं भित्त्वा स योगी हरिजागरे ..
प्रयाति परमं स्थानं योगिगम्यं निरंजनम् ..
सांख्ययोगैः सुदुःखेन प्राप्यते यत्पदं हरेः .. 15 ..
15.28.m: Cleaving this solar disc during the vigil of Hari, that yogin / goes to the supreme abode, accessible only to yogins, free from taint, / that state of Hari which is attained with great difficulty through Sāṃkhya and Yoga. 15

15.28.s:
nadyo nadā yathā yāṃti sāgare saṃsthitiṃ kramāt ..
evaṃ jāgaraṇātsarve tatpade yāṃti saṃsthitim .. 16 ..
15.28.d:
नद्यो नदा यथा यांति सागरे संस्थितिं क्रमात् ..
एवं जागरणात्सर्वे तत्पदे यांति संस्थितिम् .. 16 ..
15.28.m: Just as rivers and streams gradually go to find their place in the ocean, / even so through the vigil all reach their place in that abode. 16

15.28.s:
merumaṃdaramānāni kṛtvā pāpāni vā naraḥ ..
harijāgaraṇe tāni vyapohati na saṃśayaḥ .. 17 ..
15.28.d:
मेरुमंदरमानानि कृत्वा पापानि वा नरः ..
हरिजागरणे तानि व्यपोहति न संशयः .. 17 ..
15.28.m: Even if a man has committed sins the size of Mount Meru and Mandara, / in the vigil of Hari he destroys them, there is no doubt. 17

15.28.s:
rājyaṃ svargaṃ tathā mokṣaṃ yaccānyadīpsitaṃ nṛṇām ..
dadāti bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ svagītairjāgare sthitaḥ .. 18 ..
15.28.d:
राज्यं स्वर्गं तथा मोक्षं यच्चान्यदीप्सितं नृणाम् ..
ददाति भगवान्कृष्णः स्वगीतैर्जागरे स्थितः .. 18 ..
15.28.m: Sovereignty, heaven, liberation, and whatever else men desire, / the blessed Lord Kṛṣṇa grants when honored with his own songs during the vigil. 18

15.28.s:
jāgareṇaiva pāpānāṃ śvapacānāṃ mahīpate ..
tatpadaṃ kavibhiḥ proktaṃ kiṃ punastu dvijanmanām .. 19 ..
15.28.d:
जागरेणैव पापानां श्वपचानां महीपते ..
तत्पदं कविभिः प्रोक्तं किं पुनस्तु द्विजन्मनाम् .. 19 ..
15.28.m: Even for outcastes, through the vigil of the sins / that abode is proclaimed by the poets, O king of the earth; what then of the twice-born? 19

15.28.s:
japadhyānavihīnasya gāyakasyāpi bhūpate ..
karmabhraṣṭasya ca prokto mokṣastu harijāgare .. 7.4.28.20 ..
15.28.d:
जपध्यानविहीनस्य गायकस्यापि भूपते ..
कर्मभ्रष्टस्य च प्रोक्तो मोक्षस्तु हरिजागरे .. 7.4.28.20 ..
15.28.m: Even for a singer devoid of recitation and meditation, O ruler of the earth, / and fallen from prescribed rites, liberation is proclaimed in the vigil of Hari. 20

15.28.s:
tannāsti triṣu lokeṣu puṇyaṃ puṇyavatāṃ nṛṇām ..
yattu sādhayate bhūpa jāgare saṃvyavasthitaḥ .. 21 ..
15.28.d:
तन्नास्ति त्रिषु लोकेषु पुण्यं पुण्यवतां नृणाम् ..
यत्तु साधयते भूप जागरे संव्यवस्थितः .. 21 ..
15.28.m: There is no merit in the three worlds among virtuous men / equal to that which one achieves, O king, when established in the vigil. 21

15.28.s:
tvayā punaridaṃ kāryyaṃ smarttavyo garuḍadhvajaḥ ..
ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ kartavyaṃ jāgaraṃ sadā .. 22 ..
15.28.d:
त्वया पुनरिदं कार्य्यं स्मर्त्तव्यो गरुडध्वजः ..
एकादश्यां न भोक्तव्यं कर्तव्यं जागरं सदा .. 22 ..
15.28.m: This must be done by you: the one who has Garuḍa on his banner must be remembered, / one must not eat on Ekādaśī, and a vigil must always be kept. 22

15.28.s:
jāgare varttamānasya śvapacasya gatirbhavet ..
kiṃpunarvarṇajātīnāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ mahīpate .. 23 ..
15.28.d:
जागरे वर्त्तमानस्य श्वपचस्य गतिर्भवेत् ..
किंपुनर्वर्णजातीनां वैष्णवानां महीपते .. 23 ..
15.28.m: A favorable destination occurs even for an outcaste who maintains the vigil; / what then for the members of the [four] classes who are Vaiṣṇavas, O king of the earth? 23

15.28.s:
ye tu jāgaraṇe nidrāṃ na yāṃti nṛpapuṃgava ..
na teṣāṃ jananī yāti khedaṃ garbhāvadhāraṇāt .. 24 ..
15.28.d:
ये तु जागरणे निद्रां न यांति नृपपुंगव ..
न तेषां जननी याति खेदं गर्भावधारणात् .. 24 ..
15.28.m: Those who do not fall asleep during the vigil, O best of kings, / their mother never experiences distress from bearing them in the womb. 24

15.28.s:
tasmājjāgaraṇaṃ kāryyaṃ māturjaṭharavarjibhiḥ ..
bhītermokṣaparairmartyaiḥ sukhaceṣṭābahiṣkṛtaiḥ .. 25 ..
15.28.d:
तस्माज्जागरणं कार्य्यं मातुर्जठरवर्जिभिः ..
भीतेर्मोक्षपरैर्मर्त्यैः सुखचेष्टाबहिष्कृतैः .. 25 ..
15.28.m: Therefore, the vigil should be kept by mortals who wish to avoid a mother's womb, / who are fearful [of rebirth], intent on liberation, and renounce pleasant activities. 25

15.28.s:
yastu jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau kuryādbhaktisamanvitaḥ ..
nimiṣenimiṣe rājannaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 26 ..
15.28.d:
यस्तु जागरणं रात्रौ कुर्याद्भक्तिसमन्वितः ..
निमिषेनिमिषे राजन्नश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 26 ..
15.28.m: Whoever keeps the vigil at night endowed with devotion, / at every moment, O king, obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice. 26

15.28.s:
śayano tthāpanābhyāṃ ca samaṃ puṇyamudāhṛtam ..
viśeṣo nāsti bhūpāla viṣṇunā kathitaṃ purā .. 27 ..
15.28.d:
शयनो त्थापनाभ्यां च समं पुण्यमुदाहृतम् ..
विशेषो नास्ति भूपाल विष्णुना कथितं पुरा .. 27 ..
15.28.m: The merit is declared to be equal to both the sleeping and awakening [festivals]; / there is no difference, O ruler of the earth, as Viṣṇu stated of old. 27

15.28.s:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ sthitāḥ śūdrāśca jāgare ..
pakṣiṇaḥ kṛmikīṭāśca hyaneke caiva jaṃtavaḥ ..
te gatāḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ yogigamyaṃ niraṃjanam .. 28 ..
15.28.d:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः स्थिताः शूद्राश्च जागरे ..
पक्षिणः कृमिकीटाश्च ह्यनेके चैव जंतवः ..
ते गताः परमं स्थानं योगिगम्यं निरंजनम् .. 28 ..
15.28.m: Brahmins, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and śūdras present at the vigil, / birds, worms, insects, and many other living beings— / they have gone to the supreme abode, accessible only to yogins, free from taint. 28

15.28.s:
yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyāsamāni ca ..
kṛṣṇajāgaraṇe tāni kṣayaṃ yāṃti na saṃśayaḥ .. 29 ..
15.28.d:
यानि कानि च पापानि ब्रह्महत्यासमानि च ..
कृष्णजागरणे तानि क्षयं यांति न संशयः .. 29 ..
15.28.m: Whatever sins there are, equal to the killing of a brahmin, / they perish in the vigil of Kṛṣṇa, there is no doubt. 29

15.28.s:
ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve sarvatīrthasamanvitāḥ ..
ekato devadevasya jāgaraḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ..
na samaṃ hyadhikaḥ proktaḥ kavibhiḥ kṛṣṇajāgaraḥ .. 7.4.28.30 ..
15.28.d:
एकतः क्रतवः सर्वे सर्वतीर्थसमन्विताः ..
एकतो देवदेवस्य जागरः कृष्णवल्लभः ..
न समं ह्यधिकः प्रोक्तः कविभिः कृष्णजागरः .. 7.4.28.30 ..
15.28.m: On one side are all sacrifices along with all sacred fords; / on the other is the vigil of the god of gods, dear to Kṛṣṇa: / it is not equal, for the vigil of Kṛṣṇa is proclaimed by the poets to be superior. 30

15.28.s:
sūryaśakrādayo devā brahmarudrādayo gaṇāḥ ..
nityameva samāyāṃti jāgare kṛṣṇavallabhe .. 31 ..
15.28.d:
सूर्यशक्रादयो देवा ब्रह्मरुद्रादयो गणाः ..
नित्यमेव समायांति जागरे कृष्णवल्लभे .. 31 ..
15.28.m: The gods headed by Sūrya and Indra, and the hosts headed by Brahmā and Rudra, / always arrive at the vigil dear to Kṛṣṇa. 31

15.28.s:
gaṃgā sarasvatī revā yamunā ca śatahradā..
caṃdrabhāgā vitastā ca nadyaḥ sarvāśca tatra vai ..32..
15.28.d:
गंगा सरस्वती रेवा यमुना च शतह्रदा..
चंद्रभागा वितस्ता च नद्यः सर्वाश्च तत्र वै ..32..
15.28.m: Gaṅgā, Sarasvatī, Revā, Yamunā, and Śatahradā, / Candrabhāgā, and Vitastā, and indeed all rivers are there. 32

15.28.s:
sarāṃsi ca hradāścaiva samudrāḥ kṛtsnaśo nṛpa ..
ekādaśyāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha gacchaṃti harijāgare .. 33 ..
15.28.d:
सरांसि च ह्रदाश्चैव समुद्राः कृत्स्नशो नृप ..
एकादश्यां नृपश्रेष्ठ गच्छंति हरिजागरे .. 33 ..
15.28.m: Lakes, ponds, and all oceans, O king, / go to the vigil of Hari on Ekādaśī, O best of kings. 33

15.28.s:
spṛhaṇīyāstu devebhyo ye narāḥ kṛṣṇajāgare ..
nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ prakurvaṃti vīṇāvādyaṃ tathaiva ca .. 34 ..
15.28.d:
स्पृहणीयास्तु देवेभ्यो ये नराः कृष्णजागरे ..
नृत्यं गीतं प्रकुर्वंति वीणावाद्यं तथैव च .. 34 ..
15.28.m: Those men are indeed envied by the gods who perform dancing, / singing, and playing the vīṇā during the night vigil of Kṛṣṇa.

15.28.s:
bhaktyā vā'pyathavā'bhaktyā śucirvāpyathavā'śuciḥ ..
kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ viṣṇormucyate pāpakoṭibhiḥ .. 35 ..
15.28.d:
भक्त्या वाऽप्यथवाऽभक्त्या शुचिर्वाप्यथवाऽशुचिः ..
कृत्वा जागरणं विष्णोर्मुच्यते पापकोटिभिः .. 35 ..
15.28.m: Whether with devotion or without devotion, whether pure or impure, / by observing the night vigil for Viṣṇu, one is liberated from tens of millions of sins.

15.28.s:
pādayoḥ pāṃsukaṇikā yāvattiṣṭhaṃti bhūtale ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi jāgarī vasate divi .. 36 ..
15.28.d:
पादयोः पांसुकणिका यावत्तिष्ठंति भूतले ..
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि जागरी वसते दिवि .. 36 ..
15.28.m: As many particles of dust as remain on the soles of his feet on the surface of the earth, / for that many thousands of years the observer of the night vigil dwells in heaven.

15.28.s:
tasmādgṛhaṃ pragantavyaṃ jāgare mādhavasya ca ..
kalau malavināśāya dvādaśadvādaśīṣu ca .. 37 ..
15.28.d:
तस्माद्गृहं प्रगन्तव्यं जागरे माधवस्य च ..
कलौ मलविनाशाय द्वादशद्वादशीषु च .. 37 ..
15.28.m: Therefore, one should go to [his] house during the night vigil of Mādhava / and on the twelve Dvādaśīs in the Kali age to destroy impurities.

15.28.s:
subahūnyapi pāpāni kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ ..
nirddahenmerutulyāni yugakoṭiśatānyapi .. 38 ..
15.28.d:
सुबहून्यपि पापानि कृत्वा जागरणं हरेः ..
निर्द्दहेन्मेरुतुल्यानि युगकोटिशतान्यपि .. 38 ..
15.28.m: Even if one has committed very many sins equal to Mount Meru, / by observing the night vigil for Hari, one burns them away, even those accumulated over hundreds of millions of yugas.

15.28.s:
unmīlinī mahīpāla yaiḥ kṛtā prītisaṃyutaiḥ ..
kalau jāgaraṇopetā phalaṃ vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu .. 39 ..
15.28.d:
उन्मीलिनी महीपाल यैः कृता प्रीतिसंयुतैः ..
कलौ जागरणोपेता फलं वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु .. 39 ..
15.28.m: O king, for those who, full of love, observe the Unmīlinī [Dvādaśī] / accompanied by a night vigil in the Kali age, I shall declare the fruit; listen to it!

15.28.s:
sthitau yugasahasraṃ tu pādenaikena bhūtale ..
kāśyāṃ ca jāhnavītīre tatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ ..7.4.28.40..
15.28.d:
स्थितौ युगसहस्रं तु पादेनैकेन भूतले ..
काश्यां च जाह्नवीतीरे तत्फलं लभते नरः ..7.4.28.40..
15.28.m: The fruit that a man obtains by standing on one foot on the surface of the earth / for a thousand yugas in Kāśī on the bank of the Gaṅgā,

15.28.s:
bhavedyugasahasraṃ ca vinā''hāreṇa yatphalam..
unmīlinīṃ samāsādya phalaṃ jāgaraṇe hareḥ .. 41 ..
15.28.d:
भवेद्युगसहस्रं च विना'ऽहारेण यत्फलम्..
उन्मीलिनीं समासाद्य फलं जागरणे हरेः .. 41 ..
15.28.m: and whatever fruit there may be [from standing] without food for a thousand yugas, / that fruit is obtained in the night vigil for Hari when the Unmīlinī arrives.

15.28.s:
duṣprāpyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ makhakoṭiśataiḥ kṛtaiḥ ..
helayā prāpyate nūnaṃ dvādaśyāṃ jāgare kṛte .. 42 ..
15.28.d:
दुष्प्राप्यं वैष्णवं स्थानं मखकोटिशतैः कृतैः ..
हेलया प्राप्यते नूनं द्वादश्यां जागरे कृते .. 42 ..
15.28.m: The Vaishnava abode, which is difficult to attain even through hundreds of millions of sacrifices performed, / is surely attained with ease when a night vigil is observed on the Dvādaśī.

15.28.s:
na kurvaṃti vrataṃ viṣṇorjāgareṇa samanvitam ..
parasvaṃ pāradāryaṃ ca pāpaṃ tānprati gacchati ..43..
15.28.d:
न कुर्वंति व्रतं विष्णोर्जागरेण समन्वितम् ..
परस्वं पारदार्यं च पापं तान्प्रति गच्छति ..43..
15.28.m: To those who do not observe the vow of Viṣṇu accompanied by a night vigil, / the sin of [stealing] another’s property and committing adultery with another’s wife goes.

15.28.s:
ekenaivopavāsena bhāvahīnāstu mānavāḥ ..
nirddagdhā'khilapāpāste prayāṃti svargakānanam .. 44 ..
15.28.d:
एकेनैवोपवासेन भावहीनास्तु मानवाः ..
निर्द्दग्धाऽखिलपापास्ते प्रयांति स्वर्गकाननम् .. 44 ..
15.28.m: Even men devoid of true devotional feeling, by a single fast, / have all their sins burnt away and go to the celestial forest of heaven.

15.28.s:
yatra bhāgavataṃ śāstraṃ yatra jāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ ..
śāligrāmaśilā yatra tatra gaccheddhariḥ svayam.. 45 ..
15.28.d:
यत्र भागवतं शास्त्रं यत्र जागरणं हरेः ..
शालिग्रामशिला यत्र तत्र गच्छेद्धरिः स्वयम्.. 45 ..
15.28.m: Where the Bhāgavata scripture is, where the night vigil for Hari is, / and where the Śāligrāma stone is, there Hari goes in person.

15.28.s:
na puryyaḥ pāvanāḥ sapta kalau vedavaco nahi ..
yādṛśaṃ vāsaraṃ viṣṇoḥ pāvanaṃ jāgarānvitam.. 46 ..
15.28.d:
न पुर्य्यः पावनाः सप्त कलौ वेदवचो नहि ..
यादृशं वासरं विष्णोः पावनं जागरान्वितम्.. 46 ..
15.28.m: The seven holy cities are not purifying in the Kali age, nor are the words of the Veda, / in the way that the day of Viṣṇu accompanied by a night vigil is purifying.

15.28.s:
saṃprāpte vāsare viṣṇorye na kurvaṃti jāgaram..
majjaṃti narake ghore narānāryyo na saṃśayaḥ .. 47 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvādaśījāgaṇaraṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 28 ..
15.28.d:
संप्राप्ते वासरे विष्णोर्ये न कुर्वंति जागरम्..
मज्जंति नरके घोरे नरानार्य्यो न संशयः .. 47 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये द्वादशीजागणरणमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टाविंशतितमोऽध्यायः .. 28 ..
15.28.m:
When the day of Viṣṇu has arrived, men and women who do not observe the night vigil / plunge into a dreadful hell; there is no doubt.
Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of the Night Vigil on Dvādaśī', in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section], in the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [section], in the Śrī Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

15.29.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
athānyacca pravakṣyāmi guhyādguhyataraṃ mahat ..
dvārakāyāḥ paraṃ puṇyaṃ māhātmyaṃ hyuttamottamam .. 1 ..
15.29.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
अथान्यच्च प्रवक्ष्यामि गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं महत् ..
द्वारकायाः परं पुण्यं माहात्म्यं ह्युत्तमोत्तमम् .. 1 ..
15.29.m:
Prahlāda said:
Now I shall declare another great [matter], more secret than the secret, / the supreme, holy māhātmya of Dvārakā, the highest of the high,

15.29.s:
itihāsaṃ purāvṛttaṃ varṇayiṣye manoharam ..
tīrthakṣetrādidevānāmṛṣīṇāṃ saṃśayāpaham ..2..
15.29.d:
इतिहासं पुरावृत्तं वर्णयिष्ये मनोहरम् ..
तीर्थक्षेत्रादिदेवानामृषीणां संशयापहम् ..2..
15.29.m: a charming historical account that occurred in ancient times, / which dispels the doubts of the deities and seers presiding over sacred fords and sacred fields.

15.29.s:
saubhāmyamatulaṃ dṛṣṭvā siṃharāśigate gurau ..
godāvaryyāṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā nārado bhagavatpriyaḥ .. 3 ..
15.29.d:
सौभाम्यमतुलं दृष्ट्वा सिंहराशिगते गुरौ ..
गोदावर्य्यां द्विजश्रेष्ठा नारदो भगवत्प्रियः .. 3 ..
15.29.m: O best of brahmins, seeing the matchless beauty of the Godāvarī / when Jupiter had entered the zodiacal sign of Leo, Nārada, beloved of the Lord,

15.29.s:
gautamasyā'bhito dṛṣṭvā trailokyasaṃbhavāni vai ..
tīrthāni saritaḥ sarvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ .. 4 ..
15.29.d:
गौतमस्याऽभितो दृष्ट्वा त्रैलोक्यसंभवानि वै ..
तीर्थानि सरितः सर्वा विस्मयं परमं गतः .. 4 ..
15.29.m: having seen all around the Gautameśvara [shrine] the sacred fords and all the rivers / that exist in the three worlds, was struck with the greatest wonder.

15.29.s:
tatra kāśī kurukṣetramayodhyā mathurāpurī ..
māyā kāṃcī hyavaṃtī ca araṇyānyāśramaiḥ saha .. 5 ..
15.29.d:
तत्र काशी कुरुक्षेत्रमयोध्या मथुरापुरी ..
माया कांची ह्यवंती च अरण्यान्याश्रमैः सह .. 5 ..
15.29.m: There [were present] Kāśī, Kurukṣetra, Ayodhyā, the city of Mathurā, / Māyā, Kāñcī, and Avantī, along with the sacred forests and hermitages,

15.29.s:
harikṣetraṃ gayā miśrakṣetraṃ ca puruṣottamam ..
prabhāsādīni puṇyāni muktikṣetrāṇyaśeṣataḥ .. 6 ..
15.29.d:
हरिक्षेत्रं गया मिश्रक्षेत्रं च पुरुषोत्तमम् ..
प्रभासादीनि पुण्यानि मुक्तिक्षेत्राण्यशेषतः .. 6 ..
15.29.m: Harikṣetra, Gayā, the Miśrakṣetra, and Puruṣottama, / and entirely all the holy sacred fields that bestow liberation, beginning with Prabhāsa;

15.29.s:
jāhnavī yamunā revā tatra puṇyā sarasvatī ..
sarayūrgaṃḍakī tāpī payoṣṇī saritāṃ varā .. 7 ..
15.29.d:
जाह्नवी यमुना रेवा तत्र पुण्या सरस्वती ..
सरयूर्गंडकी तापी पयोष्णी सरितां वरा .. 7 ..
15.29.m: the Gaṅgā, Yamunā, Revā, and there the holy Sarasvatī, / the Sarayū, Gaṇḍakī, Tāpī, and Payoṣṇī, the best of rivers;

15.29.s:
kṛṣṇā bhīmarathī puṇyā kāveryyādyāḥ saridvarāḥ ..
svarge martye ca pātāle varttamānāḥ satīrthakāḥ .. 8 ..
15.29.d:
कृष्णा भीमरथी पुण्या कावेर्य्याद्याः सरिद्वराः ..
स्वर्गे मर्त्ये च पाताले वर्त्तमानाः सतीर्थकाः .. 8 ..
15.29.m: the Kṛṣṇā, the Bhīmarathī, the holy Kāverī, and other excellent rivers / existing in heaven, on earth, and in Pātāla, along with their sacred fords,

15.29.s:
sthitā godāvarītīre siṃharāśiṃ gate gurau ..
tathā ca puṣkarādīni saptasiṃdhusarāṃsi ca .. 9 ..
15.29.d:
स्थिता गोदावरीतीरे सिंहराशिं गते गुरौ ..
तथा च पुष्करादीनि सप्तसिंधुसरांसि च .. 9 ..
15.29.m: stood on the bank of the Godāvarī when Jupiter entered the sign of Leo, / and likewise Puṣkara and the other lakes, and the seven seas;

15.29.s:
mervādiparvatāḥ puṇyā darśanātpāpanāśanāḥ ..
tīrtharāja prayāgaśca sarvatīrthasamanvitaḥ .. 7.4.29.10 ..
15.29.d:
मेर्वादिपर्वताः पुण्या दर्शनात्पापनाशनाः ..
तीर्थराज प्रयागश्च सर्वतीर्थसमन्वितः .. 7.4.29.10 ..
15.29.m: holy mountains, beginning with Meru, which destroy sins by [mere] sight, / and Prayāga, the king of sacred fords, accompanied by all the sacred fords;

15.29.s:
vedopavedāḥ śāstrāṇi purāṇāni ca sarvaśaḥ ..
siddhā munigaṇāḥ sarve devarṣipitṛdevatāḥ .. 11 ..
15.29.d:
वेदोपवेदाः शास्त्राणि पुराणानि च सर्वशः ..
सिद्धा मुनिगणाः सर्वे देवर्षिपितृदेवताः .. 11 ..
15.29.m: the Vedas, the Upavedas, all the scriptures and Purāṇas, / the perfected beings, all the hosts of sages, celestial seers, ancestral spirits, and deities;

15.29.s:
caṃdrādityau suragaṇāḥ siṃhasthe ca bṛhaspatau ..
sthitā godāvarītīre varṣamekaṃ praharṣitāḥ ..12 ..
15.29.d:
चंद्रादित्यौ सुरगणाः सिंहस्थे च बृहस्पतौ ..
स्थिता गोदावरीतीरे वर्षमेकं प्रहर्षिताः ..12 ..
15.29.m: the moon and the sun, and the hosts of gods, while Jupiter stayed in Leo, / dwelt on the bank of the Godāvarī for one year, greatly delighted.

15.29.s:
yāni kāni ca puṇyāni tīrthakṣetrāṇi saṃti vai ..
trailokye tāni sarvāṇi gautamyāṃ vīkṣya vismitāḥ .. 13 ..
15.29.d:
यानि कानि च पुण्यानि तीर्थक्षेत्राणि संति वै ..
त्रैलोक्ये तानि सर्वाणि गौतम्यां वीक्ष्य विस्मिताः .. 13 ..
