15.29.m: Astonished at seeing all the holy sacred fords and sacred fields / that exist in the three worlds assembled at the Gautamī,

15.29.s:
devarṣirnāradastatra munibhirmudito'vasat ..
siṃhasyāṃte(sthāṃte) ca sarvāṇi svasthānagamanāya vai ..14..
15.29.d:
देवर्षिर्नारदस्तत्र मुनिभिर्मुदितोऽवसत् ..
सिंहस्यांते(स्थांते) च सर्वाणि स्वस्थानगमनाय वै ..14..
15.29.m: the celestial seer Nārada dwelt there joyfully with the sages. / Then, at the end of [Jupiter's stay in] Leo, all of them prepared to depart to their respective abodes.

15.29.s:
āmantrya gautamīṃ devīṃ sthitāni puratastataḥ ..
sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ viprā gautamī khinnamānasā ..
taptā durjanasaṃsargānnāradaṃ duḥkhitā'bravīt .. 15 ..
15.29.d:
आमन्त्र्य गौतमीं देवीं स्थितानि पुरतस्ततः ..
सर्वेषां शृण्वतां विप्रा गौतमी खिन्नमानसा ..
तप्ता दुर्जनसंसर्गान्नारदं दुःखिताऽब्रवीत् .. 15 ..
15.29.m: Having bid farewell to the goddess Gautamī, they stood before her. / Then, O brahmins, while all were listening, the Gautamī, her mind dejected / and tormented by contact with wicked people, spoke sorrowfully to Nārada:

15.29.s:
.. gautamyuvāca .. ..
paśyaitāni sutīrthāni gaṃgādyāḥ sarito'malāḥ ..
sāgarā girayaḥ puṇyā gayātritayameva ca..16..
15.29.d:
.. गौतम्युवाच .. ..
पश्यैतानि सुतीर्थानि गंगाद्याः सरितोऽमलाः ..
सागरा गिरयः पुण्या गयात्रितयमेव च..16..
15.29.m:
Gautamī said:
Behold these excellent sacred fords, the spotless rivers beginning with the Gaṅgā, / the oceans, the holy mountains, and the triad of Gayās,

15.29.s:
kṣetrāṇi mokṣadānyaṃga trailokyajāni nārada ..
devāśca pitaraḥ siddhā ṛṣayo mānavādayaḥ ..17..
15.29.d:
क्षेत्राणि मोक्षदान्यंग त्रैलोक्यजानि नारद ..
देवाश्च पितरः सिद्धा ऋषयो मानवादयः ..17..
15.29.m: the sacred fields that grant liberation throughout the three worlds, O dear Nārada, / and the gods, the ancestral spirits, the perfected beings, the seers, and mankind.

15.29.s:
tīrtha rāja prayāgaśca sarvatīrthasamanvitaḥ ..
eteṣāmeva sarveṣāṃ matsaṃsargānmahāmune ..
viśuddhānāṃ prakāśena rājate bhuvanatrayam ..18..
15.29.d:
तीर्थ राज प्रयागश्च सर्वतीर्थसमन्वितः ..
एतेषामेव सर्वेषां मत्संसर्गान्महामुने ..
विशुद्धानां प्रकाशेन राजते भुवनत्रयम् ..18..
15.29.m: And Prayāga, the king of sacred fords, accompanied by all sacred fords— / by contact with me, O great sage, all of them / shine with radiance, so that the three worlds are illuminated.

15.29.s:
prayāṃti tāni sarvāṇi svaṃsvaṃ sthānaṃ prati prabho ..
adhunā'haṃ pariśrāṃtā dahyamānā tvaharniśam ..19..
15.29.d:
प्रयांति तानि सर्वाणि स्वंस्वं स्थानं प्रति प्रभो ..
अधुनाऽहं परिश्रांता दह्यमाना त्वहर्निशम् ..19..
15.29.m: All of them are now departing each to its own place, O lord, / while now I am exhausted and burning day and night

15.29.s:
durjanānāṃ susaṃparkādbhṛśaṃ pāpātmanā prabho ..
saubhaṇyamadhunā prāptaṃ satsaṃsargeṇa nārada ..7.4.29.20..
15.29.d:
दुर्जनानां सुसंपर्काद्भृशं पापात्मना प्रभो ..
सौभण्यमधुना प्राप्तं सत्संसर्गेण नारद ..7.4.29.20..
15.29.m: from intense contact with the wicked, sinful people, O lord! / Through association with the good, O Nārada, beauty was attained just now,

15.29.s: prayāṃtyetāni sarvāṇi svasthānaṃ muditāni ca ..21..
15.29.d: प्रयांत्येतानि सर्वाणि स्वस्थानं मुदितानि च ..21..
15.29.m: and all these are departing to their own places, rejoicing.

15.29.s:
etāni matprasādena puṇyāni kathitāni ca ..
kathaya śramaśāṃtyarthaṃ duḥkhi tā kiṃ karomyaham..22..
15.29.d:
एतानि मत्प्रसादेन पुण्यानि कथितानि च ..
कथय श्रमशांत्यर्थं दुःखि ता किं करोम्यहम्..22..
15.29.m: These have been proclaimed as holy through my grace. / Tell me, what shall I, miserable as I am, do to relieve my exhaustion?

15.29.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
godāvaryyā vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānnārado dvijāḥ ..
kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā tu duḥkhārttaḥ prāha saṃśayamānasaḥ ..23.. ..
15.29.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
गोदावर्य्या वचः श्रुत्वा भगवान्नारदो द्विजाः ..
क्षणं ध्यात्वा तु दुःखार्त्तः प्राह संशयमानसः ..23.. ..
15.29.m:
Prahlāda said:
Having heard the words of the Godāvarī, O brahmins, the venerable Nārada, / having meditated for a moment, being pained by sorrow and doubtful in mind, spoke:

15.29.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
aho atyadbhutaṃ hyetadgautamyā vyasanaṃ mahat ..
paśyantvasaṃśayaṃ devāstīrthakṣetrasaridvarāḥ..24..
15.29.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
अहो अत्यद्भुतं ह्येतद्गौतम्या व्यसनं महत् ..
पश्यन्त्वसंशयं देवास्तीर्थक्षेत्रसरिद्वराः..24..
15.29.m:
Nārada said:
Oh, how exceedingly wonderful is this great distress of the Gautamī! / Let the gods, the sacred fords, the sacred fields, and the best of rivers see it without doubt!

15.29.s:
satpuṇyanicayo yasyāṃ yuṣmākaṃ samabhūddhruvam ..
tasyāḥ pāpāgniśamanaṃ kathaṃ syāditi cintyatām.. 25 ..
15.29.d:
सत्पुण्यनिचयो यस्यां युष्माकं समभूद्ध्रुवम् ..
तस्याः पापाग्निशमनं कथं स्यादिति चिन्त्यताम्.. 25 ..
15.29.m: Consider how the extinguishing of the fire of sins may be effected for her, / in whom a heap of true merit certainly arose for you.

15.29.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
tadā cintayatāṃ teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhāvitātmanām ..
gautamo bhagavāṃstatra samāyāto munīśvarāḥ .. 26 ..
15.29.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
तदा चिन्तयतां तेषां सर्वेषां भावितात्मनाम् ..
गौतमो भगवांस्तत्र समायातो मुनीश्वराः .. 26 ..
15.29.m:
Śrī Prahlāda said:
While all those contemplative souls were considering that, / the venerable Gautama arrived there, O lords of sages.

15.29.s:
dṛṣṭvā tamṛṣayo devā yathocitamapūjayan ..
jāhnavī yamunā puṇyā narmadā ca sarasvatī .. 27 ..
15.29.d:
दृष्ट्वा तमृषयो देवा यथोचितमपूजयन् ..
जाह्नवी यमुना पुण्या नर्मदा च सरस्वती .. 27 ..
15.29.m: Seeing him, the seers, the gods, the Gaṅgā, Yamunā, / the holy Narmadā, and the Sarasvatī worshipped him fittingly.

15.29.s:
anyāśca sarvāḥ saritastrailokyamanuvartitāḥ ..
vārāṇasī kurukṣetra pramukhānyāśramaiḥ saha ..
yugapattāni sarvāṇi saṃpūjya munimabuvan..28..
15.29.d:
अन्याश्च सर्वाः सरितस्त्रैलोक्यमनुवर्तिताः ..
वाराणसी कुरुक्षेत्र प्रमुखान्याश्रमैः सह ..
युगपत्तानि सर्वाणि संपूज्य मुनिमबुवन्..28..
15.29.m: And all the other rivers flowing throughout the three worlds, / along with the hermitages, headed by Vārāṇasī and Kurukṣetra— / having all together worshipped the sage, they said:

15.29.s:
tvatprasādena vai trātāḥ samyakchuddhā mahāmune ..
yadānītā tvayā gaṃgā gautamī bhūtalaṃ prati ..29..
15.29.d:
त्वत्प्रसादेन वै त्राताः सम्यक्छुद्धा महामुने ..
यदानीता त्वया गंगा गौतमी भूतलं प्रति ..29..
15.29.m: “By your grace, O great sage, we have indeed been protected and thoroughly purified, / since the Gautamī Gaṅgā was brought by you down to the surface of the earth.

15.29.s:
kṛtārthā mānavāḥ sarve sarvapāpavivarjitāḥ ..
kiṃtu durjanasaṃparkātsaṃtaptā gautamī bhṛśam..7.4.29.30..
15.29.d:
कृतार्था मानवाः सर्वे सर्वपापविवर्जिताः ..
किंतु दुर्जनसंपर्कात्संतप्ता गौतमी भृशम्..7.4.29.30..
15.29.m: All human beings have accomplished their purpose, freed from all sin. / But from contact with wicked people, Gautamī is intensely tormented.

15.29.s:
kathaṃ pāpairvinirmuktā paramānandasaṃplutā ..
suprabhā jāyate devī tadgautama vicintyatām .. 31 ..
15.29.d:
कथं पापैर्विनिर्मुक्ता परमानन्दसंप्लुता ..
सुप्रभा जायते देवी तद्गौतम विचिन्त्यताम् .. 31 ..
15.29.m: How may the goddess be freed from sins, inundated with supreme bliss, / and become brightly radiant? Consider that, O Gautama!”

15.29.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
evamukto munistaistu cintākulitamānasaḥ ..
nāradasya mukhaṃ vīkṣya prahasangautamo'bravīt .. 32 ..
15.29.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्तो मुनिस्तैस्तु चिन्ताकुलितमानसः ..
नारदस्य मुखं वीक्ष्य प्रहसन्गौतमोऽब्रवीत् .. 32 ..
15.29.m: Prahlāda said: / Thus addressed by them, the sage Gautama, his mind agitated by worry, / looked at the face of Nārada and said, smiling:

15.29.s:
.. gautama uvāca .. ..
sarveṣāṃ kṣetratīrthānāṃ mahāśubhavināśinī ..
gautamīyaṃ mahābhāgā asyāstāpaḥ kva śāmyati ..33..
15.29.d:
.. गौतम उवाच .. ..
सर्वेषां क्षेत्रतीर्थानां महाशुभविनाशिनी ..
गौतमीयं महाभागा अस्यास्तापः क्व शाम्यति ..33..
15.29.m: Gautama said: / “The destroyer of great misfortune for all sacred fields and sacred fords, / this illustrious Gautamī—where can her burning pain be extinguished?

15.29.s:
nāsti lokatraye tīrthaṃ snātuṃ siṃhagate gurau ..
yadvai nāyāti gautamyāṃ kṣetraṃ cāpi viśuddhaye ..
kāśīprayāgamukhyāni rājaṃte yatprasādataḥ .. 34 ..
15.29.d:
नास्ति लोकत्रये तीर्थं स्नातुं सिंहगते गुरौ ..
यद्वै नायाति गौतम्यां क्षेत्रं चापि विशुद्धये ..
काशीप्रयागमुख्यानि राजंते यत्प्रसादतः .. 34 ..
15.29.m: There is no sacred ford in the three worlds, nor any sacred field, / which does not come to Gautamī for purification to bathe when Jupiter is in Leo; / through her grace places headed by Kāśī and Prayāga shine forth.

15.29.s:
vadaṃtu munayaḥ sarve kṣetratīrthasamāśritāḥ ..
śuddhaṃ vicāryaṃ yatkāryyaṃ mayā'smiñjātasaṃkaṭe .. 35 ..
15.29.d:
वदंतु मुनयः सर्वे क्षेत्रतीर्थसमाश्रिताः ..
शुद्धं विचार्यं यत्कार्य्यं मयाऽस्मिञ्जातसंकटे .. 35 ..
15.29.m: Let all the sages residing at sacred fields and sacred fords declare: / having considered it carefully, what should be done by me in this distress that has arisen?”

15.29.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
ityuktvā munayaḥ sarve nocuḥ kiñcidvimohitāḥ ..
tatropāyamavijñāya gautamīṃ gautamo'bravīt .. 36 ..
15.29.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वा मुनयः सर्वे नोचुः किञ्चिद्विमोहिताः ..
तत्रोपायमविज्ञाय गौतमीं गौतमोऽब्रवीत् .. 36 ..
15.29.m: Prahlāda said: / Having spoken thus, all the sages, bewildered, said nothing. / Gautama, not knowing an expedient in that matter, spoke to Gautamī:

15.29.s:
.. gautama uvāca .. ..
ānītāsi mayā devi tapasā''rādhya śaṃkaram..
vadiṣyati sa copāyamityuktvā'cintayattadā ..37..
15.29.d:
.. गौतम उवाच .. ..
आनीतासि मया देवि तपसा'ऽराध्य शंकरम्..
वदिष्यति स चोपायमित्युक्त्वाऽचिन्तयत्तदा ..37..
15.29.m: Gautama said: / “O goddess, you were brought down by me having propitiated Śaṃkara through austerity. / He will declare the expedient!” Having said this, he then meditated.

15.29.s:
gautamaḥ śraddhayā bhaktyā gaṃgāmaulimakhaṃḍadhīḥ ..
tadā'bhūnmahadāścaryaṃ śṛṇvaṃtu ṛṣayo'malāḥ .. 38 ..
15.29.d:
गौतमः श्रद्धया भक्त्या गंगामौलिमखंडधीः ..
तदाऽभून्महदाश्चर्यं शृण्वंतु ऋषयोऽमलाः .. 38 ..
15.29.m: With unswerving intellect, Gautama [meditated] on him whose crest is Gaṅgā with faith and devotion. / Then a great wonder occurred; hear it, O stainless seers!

15.29.s:
dhyāyamāne mahādeve gautamena mahātmanā ..
akasmādabhavadvāṇī harṣayantī jagattrayam .. 39 ..
15.29.d:
ध्यायमाने महादेवे गौतमेन महात्मना ..
अकस्मादभवद्वाणी हर्षयन्ती जगत्त्रयम् .. 39 ..
15.29.m: As the great lord was being meditated upon by the great-souled Gautama, / suddenly a voice arose, gladdening the three worlds,

15.29.s:
nādayantī diśaḥ sarvā ābrahmabhuvanaṃ dvijāḥ ..
arūpalakṣaṇākārā viṣādaśamanī śubhā ... .. 7.4.29.40 ..
15.29.d:
नादयन्ती दिशः सर्वा आब्रह्मभुवनं द्विजाः ..
अरूपलक्षणाकारा विषादशमनी शुभा ... .. 7.4.29.40 ..
15.29.m: resounding through all the directions, up to the realm of Brahmā, O twice-born, / having form without visible physical marks, dispelling dejection, auspicious.

15.29.s:
.. divyavāṇyuvāca .. ..
aho bata mahāścaryyaṃ sarveṣāṃ sukhade śubhe ..
prasaṃge'tra mahākṣetre magnā duḥkhārṇave budhāḥ.. 41 ..
15.29.d:
.. दिव्यवाण्युवाच .. ..
अहो बत महाश्चर्य्यं सर्वेषां सुखदे शुभे ..
प्रसंगेऽत्र महाक्षेत्रे मग्ना दुःखार्णवे बुधाः.. 41 ..
15.29.m: The heavenly voice said: / “Ah, behold, what a great wonder! In this auspicious occasion / which gives joy to all in this great sacred field, the wise are drowned in an ocean of sorrow!

15.29.s:
aho he gautamācāryya ṛṣayo nāradādayaḥ ..
śṛṇvaṃtu tīrthakṣetrāṇi kṛpayā saṃvadāmyaham .. 42 ..
15.29.d:
अहो हे गौतमाचार्य्य ऋषयो नारदादयः ..
शृण्वंतु तीर्थक्षेत्राणि कृपया संवदाम्यहम् .. 42 ..
15.29.m: O teacher Gautama! O seers headed by Nārada! / Let the sacred fords and sacred fields listen: out of compassion, I speak.

15.29.s:
paścimasya samudrasya tīramāśritya vartate ..
asmācca diśi vāyavyāṃ dvārakākṣetramuttamam .. 43 ..
15.29.d:
पश्चिमस्य समुद्रस्य तीरमाश्रित्य वर्तते ..
अस्माच्च दिशि वायव्यां द्वारकाक्षेत्रमुत्तमम् .. 43 ..
15.29.m: Resting upon the shore of the western ocean, / and in the north-western direction from here, lies the supreme sacred field of Dvārakā,

15.29.s:
yatrā''ste gomatī puṇyā sāgareṇa samanvitā ..
paścimābhimukho yatra mahāviṣṇuḥ sadā sthitaḥ .. 44 ..
15.29.d:
यत्रा'ऽस्ते गोमती पुण्या सागरेण समन्विता ..
पश्चिमाभिमुखो यत्र महाविष्णुः सदा स्थितः .. 44 ..
15.29.m: where the sacred Gomatī abides united with the ocean, / [and] where Mahāviṣṇu stands constantly facing west.

15.29.s:
anekapāparāśīnāmugrāṇāmapi sarvadā ..
dāhasthāna samākhyātamindhanānāṃ yathā'nalaḥ .. 45 ..
15.29.d:
अनेकपापराशीनामुग्राणामपि सर्वदा ..
दाहस्थान समाख्यातमिन्धनानां यथाऽनलः .. 45 ..
15.29.m: It is declared to be the place of burning away even the most ferocious heaps / of numerous sins at all times, just as fire burns heaps of fuel.

15.29.s:
devaviśvadruho yatra dagdhvā pātakamadbhutam ..
lokatrayavadhājjātaṃ virājate'rkavatsadā .. 46 ..
15.29.d:
देवविश्वद्रुहो यत्र दग्ध्वा पातकमद्भुतम् ..
लोकत्रयवधाज्जातं विराजतेऽर्कवत्सदा .. 46 ..
15.29.m: There, having burned away his wondrous sin against gods and the universe, / arisen from the slaughter of the three worlds, [the sun] shines forever like the sun.

15.29.s:
tadgamyatāṃ mahābhāgā gomatīmaghadāhakām ..
godāvarīṃ puraskṛtya kṣetratīrthasamanvitām .. 47 ..
15.29.d:
तद्गम्यतां महाभागा गोमतीमघदाहकाम् ..
गोदावरीं पुरस्कृत्य क्षेत्रतीर्थसमन्विताम् .. 47 ..
15.29.m: Therefore, O illustrious ones, let Godāvarī, accompanied by the sacred fields and sacred fords, / go, placed at the head, to Gomatī which burns away sins.

15.29.s:
prāpya dvāravatīṃ puṇyāṃ matprasādāddvijottamāḥ ..
prabhāvāddvārakāyāśca satyamāvirbhaviṣyati .. 48 ..
15.29.d:
प्राप्य द्वारवतीं पुण्यां मत्प्रसादाद्द्विजोत्तमाः ..
प्रभावाद्द्वारकायाश्च सत्यमाविर्भविष्यति .. 48 ..
15.29.m: Having reached sacred Dvāravatī by my grace, O best of the twice-born, / truth will become manifest through the power of Dvārakā.”

15.29.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
ityukte sati te sarve harṣa nirbharamānasāḥ ..
śrutvā sarvottamaṃ kṣetraṃ jagarjurharināmabhiḥ .. 49 ..
15.29.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्ते सति ते सर्वे हर्ष निर्भरमानसाः ..
श्रुत्वा सर्वोत्तमं क्षेत्रं जगर्जुर्हरिनामभिः .. 49 ..
15.29.m: Prahlāda said: / When this was said, all of them, their minds overflowing with joy / upon hearing of that supreme sacred field, roared with the names of Hari:

15.29.s:
jitaṃ bho jitamasbhābhirdhanyā dhanyatamā vayam ..
daivādapagato moho jñātaṃ tīrthottamottamam .. 7.4.29.50 ..
15.29.d:
जितं भो जितमस्भाभिर्धन्या धन्यतमा वयम् ..
दैवादपगतो मोहो ज्ञातं तीर्थोत्तमोत्तमम् .. 7.4.29.50 ..
15.29.m: “Victory! Ah, victory has been won by us! We are most blessed, most blessed! / By divine grace our delusion has vanished; the best of the supreme sacred fords is known!”

15.29.s:
tadā sarvāṇi tīrthāni kṣetrāraṇyāśramaiḥ saha ..
vārāṇasīprayāgādi sarāṃsi sindhavo nagāḥ .. 51 ..
15.29.d:
तदा सर्वाणि तीर्थानि क्षेत्रारण्याश्रमैः सह ..
वाराणसीप्रयागादि सरांसि सिन्धवो नगाः .. 51 ..
15.29.m: Then all the sacred fords, along with sacred fields, forests, and hermitages, / lakes headed by Vārāṇasī and Prayāga, oceans, mountains,

15.29.s:
gayā ca devakhātāni pitaro devamānavāḥ ..
śrutvā pramuditā vācaṃ procurjayajayeti ca .. 52 ..
15.29.d:
गया च देवखातानि पितरो देवमानवाः ..
श्रुत्वा प्रमुदिता वाचं प्रोचुर्जयजयेति च .. 52 ..
15.29.m: Gayā, divine excavations, ancestors, gods, and human beings, / hearing that voice, were delighted and proclaimed, “Victory, victory!”

15.29.s:
aho sarvottamaṃ kṣetraṃ sarveṣāṃ no'ghanāśanam ..
rājānaṃ tīrtharājānaṃ dvārakāṃ śirasā namaḥ.. 93 ..
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
śrutvā sarvottamaṃ kṣetraṃ tīrthaṃ sarvottamottamam ..
devottamottamaṃ devaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ kleśanāśanam ..54..
utkaṇṭhā hyabhavatteṣāṃ tīrthādīnāṃ hyanuttamā ..
procuranyonyato vācaṃ sarvāṇi yugapattadā .. 55 ..
.. ṛṣitīrthadevā ūcuḥ .. ..
kadā drakṣyāmahe puṇyāṃ dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇapālitām ..
śrīkṛṣṇadevamūrtiṃ ca kṛṣṇavaktraṃ suśobhitam .. 56 ..
kadā nu gomatīsnānamasmākaṃ tu bhaviṣyati ..
cakratīrthe kadā snātvā kṛṣṇadevasya maṃdiram ..
drakṣyāmaḥ sumahāpuṇyaṃ muktidvāramapāvṛtam .. 57 ..
durllabho dvārakāvāso durllabhaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam ..
durllabhaṃ gomatī snānaṃ rukmiṇīdarśanaṃ dvijāḥ .. 58 ..
15.29.d:
अहो सर्वोत्तमं क्षेत्रं सर्वेषां नोऽघनाशनम् ..
राजानं तीर्थराजानं द्वारकां शिरसा नमः.. 93 ..
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
श्रुत्वा सर्वोत्तमं क्षेत्रं तीर्थं सर्वोत्तमोत्तमम् ..
देवोत्तमोत्तमं देवं श्रीकृष्णं क्लेशनाशनम् ..54..
उत्कण्ठा ह्यभवत्तेषां तीर्थादीनां ह्यनुत्तमा ..
प्रोचुरन्योन्यतो वाचं सर्वाणि युगपत्तदा .. 55 ..
.. ऋषितीर्थदेवा ऊचुः .. ..
कदा द्रक्ष्यामहे पुण्यां द्वारकां कृष्णपालिताम् ..
श्रीकृष्णदेवमूर्तिं च कृष्णवक्त्रं सुशोभितम् .. 56 ..
कदा नु गोमतीस्नानमस्माकं तु भविष्यति ..
चक्रतीर्थे कदा स्नात्वा कृष्णदेवस्य मंदिरम् ..
द्रक्ष्यामः सुमहापुण्यं मुक्तिद्वारमपावृतम् .. 57 ..
दुर्ल्लभो द्वारकावासो दुर्ल्लभं कृष्णदर्शनम् ..
दुर्ल्लभं गोमती स्नानं रुक्मिणीदर्शनं द्विजाः .. 58 ..
15.29.m:
“Ah, the supreme sacred field, the destroyer of sins for all of us, / the king of kings of sacred fords, Dvārakā—we bow our heads to it!”
Prahlāda said: / Having heard of the supreme sacred field, the best of all sacred fords, / [and] the supreme god among gods, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the destroyer of distress,
an unsurpassed yearning arose in those sacred fords and the others. / Then all of them at once spoke words to one another:
The seers, sacred fords, and gods said: / “When shall we see the sacred Dvārakā protected by Kṛṣṇa, / and the image of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and Kṛṣṇa’s beautifully adorned face?
When indeed will our ritual ablution in the Gomatī take place? / When, having bathed in the Cakratīrtha, shall we behold / the temple of Lord Kṛṣṇa, the most sacred open gate of liberation?
Difficult to obtain is residence in Dvārakā, difficult to obtain is the darśana of Kṛṣṇa, / difficult to obtain is the ritual ablution in the Gomatī, and the darśana of Rukmiṇī, O twice-born!”

15.29.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye gautamītīrasthasamastatīrthakṣetrādīnāṃ devavāṇyā dvārakāprabhāvaṃ śrutvā dvārakāgamanotsukatāpūrvaka gomatīvarṇanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 29 ..
15.29.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये गौतमीतीरस्थसमस्ततीर्थक्षेत्रादीनां देववाण्या द्वारकाप्रभावं श्रुत्वा द्वारकागमनोत्सुकतापूर्वक गोमतीवर्णनंनामैकोनत्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 29 ..
15.29.m: Thus ends the twenty-ninth chapter, entitled “The Description of Gomatī Preceded by the Eagerness to Go to Dvārakā upon Hearing the Power of Dvārakā from a Divine Voice by All the Sacred Fords, Sacred Fields, and Others Situated on the Bank of Gautamī,” in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section], in the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [section] of the Skandapurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse compendium.

15.30.s:
.. .. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
tadā teṣāṃ sutīrthānāṃ kṣetrāṇāmabhavanmudaḥ ..
gantuṃ dvāravatīṃ puṇyāṃ sarveṣāmapi sarvaśaḥ .. 1 ..
15.30.d:
.. .. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
तदा तेषां सुतीर्थानां क्षेत्राणामभवन्मुदः ..
गन्तुं द्वारवतीं पुण्यां सर्वेषामपि सर्वशः .. 1 ..
15.30.m: Prahlāda said: / Then there was joy among those noble sacred fords and sacred fields / everywhere, in all of them, to go to sacred Dvāravatī.

15.30.s:
dvārakāgamane dṛṣṭvā tathā nāradagautamau ..
mahotsavo mahāṃstatra bhaviṣyati manoharaḥ ..2 ..
15.30.d:
द्वारकागमने दृष्ट्वा तथा नारदगौतमौ ..
महोत्सवो महांस्तत्र भविष्यति मनोहरः ..2 ..
15.30.m: Seeing that they were setting out for Dvārakā, Nārada and Gautama [thought], / “A great, captivating festival will take place there!”

15.30.s:
tīrthānāṃ kṛṣṇayātrāyāṃ gantavyamityavo catuḥ ..
atha te hyṛṣayo devāḥ sarvatīrthasamanvitāḥ .. 3 ..
15.30.d:
तीर्थानां कृष्णयात्रायां गन्तव्यमित्यवो चतुः ..
अथ ते ह्यृषयो देवाः सर्वतीर्थसमन्विताः .. 3 ..
15.30.m: They said, “One must go on the pilgrimage to Kṛṣṇa along with the sacred fords.” / Then those seers and gods, accompanied by all the sacred fords,

15.30.s:
gautamīṃ tu puraskṛtya yayurdvāravatīṃ mudā ..
tadā sarvāṇi tīrthāni kṣetrāraṇyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
dvārakāgamanaṃ cakruḥ sānandā ṛṣayaḥ surāḥ .. 4 ..
15.30.d:
गौतमीं तु पुरस्कृत्य ययुर्द्वारवतीं मुदा ..
तदा सर्वाणि तीर्थानि क्षेत्रारण्यानि कृत्स्नशः ..
द्वारकागमनं चक्रुः सानन्दा ऋषयः सुराः .. 4 ..
15.30.m: placing Gautamī at the head, joyfully set out for Dvāravatī. / Then all the sacred fords, sacred fields, and forests in their entirety, / the joyful seers and gods, made their departure to Dvārakā.

15.30.s:
śraddhayā parayā bhaktyā kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ..
vīṇāninādatattvajñaṃ nāradaṃ pathi te' bruvan.. 5 ..
15.30.d:
श्रद्धया परया भक्त्या कृष्णदर्शनलालसाः..
वीणानिनादतत्त्वज्ञं नारदं पथि ते' ब्रुवन्.. 5 ..
15.30.m: With supreme faith and devotion, longing for the darśana of Kṛṣṇa, / on the way they spoke to Nārada, who knew the truth of the sounds of the vīṇā:

15.30.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
rāśayaḥ puṇyapuñjānāṃ kṛtā vai tapasāṃ tathā ..
yajñadānavratānāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ mahatāṃ bhuvi .. 6 ..
15.30.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
राशयः पुण्यपुञ्जानां कृता वै तपसां तथा ..
यज्ञदानव्रतानां च तीर्थानां महतां भुवि .. 6 ..
15.30.m: The seers said: / “Heaps of piles of merit have indeed been accumulated, as well as austerities, / and sacrifices, gifts, vows, and great sacred fords on the earth,

15.30.s:
saṃprāptastatprasādo'yaṃ yaddrakṣyāmaḥ kuśasthalīm ..
pṛcchāmahe'dhunā tvāṃ vai yogināṃ paramaṃ gurum .. 7 ..
15.30.d:
संप्राप्तस्तत्प्रसादोऽयं यद्द्रक्ष्यामः कुशस्थलीम् ..
पृच्छामहेऽधुना त्वां वै योगिनां परमं गुरुम् .. 7 ..
15.30.m: the reward of which has now been obtained, since we shall see Kuśasthalī! / We now ask you, indeed the supreme guru of yogins:”

15.30.s:
dvārakāyāstu yātrāyāṃ ko vidhiḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ ..
niyamaḥ ko'tra karttavyo varjanīyaṃ ca kiṃ mune .. 8 ..
15.30.d:
द्वारकायास्तु यात्रायां को विधिः संप्रकीर्तितः ..
नियमः कोऽत्र कर्त्तव्यो वर्जनीयं च किं मुने .. 8 ..
15.30.m: "What rule is prescribed for the pilgrimage to Dvārakā? / What observance should be kept here, and what should be avoided, O sage? 8

15.30.s:
śrotavyaṃ kīrtitavyaṃ ca smartavyaṃ kiṃ ca vai pathi ..
utsavāścātra ke proktā dvārakāyāśca tatpathi...
ekaikaśca mahābhāga bhaktānandavivarddhanam ..
etatsarvaṃ mahābhāga kṛpayā saṃprakīrtyatām .. 7.4.30.10 ..
15.30.d:
श्रोतव्यं कीर्तितव्यं च स्मर्तव्यं किं च वै पथि ..
उत्सवाश्चात्र के प्रोक्ता द्वारकायाश्च तत्पथि...
एकैकश्च महाभाग भक्तानन्दविवर्द्धनम् ..
एतत्सर्वं महाभाग कृपया संप्रकीर्त्यताम् .. 7.4.30.10 ..
15.30.m: What should be heard, chanted, and remembered along the path? / And what celebrations are declared here, and on that path to Dvārakā, / each one increasing the joy of devotees, O illustrious one? / Tell all of this, O illustrious one, out of compassion." 10

15.30.s:
.. śrīnārada uvāca .. ..
kṛtābhyaṃgastu pūrvedyuḥ saṃpūjya śraddhayā harim..
bhojayedvaiṣṇavānviprānsvaśaktyā saṃpraharṣitaḥ .. 11 ..
15.30.d:
.. श्रीनारद उवाच .. ..
कृताभ्यंगस्तु पूर्वेद्युः संपूज्य श्रद्धया हरिम्..
भोजयेद्वैष्णवान्विप्रान्स्वशक्त्या संप्रहर्षितः .. 11 ..
15.30.m: The venerable Nārada said: / Having taken an oil bath on the previous day and worshipped Hari with faith, / one should feed Vaiṣṇava brahmins according to one's ability, greatly delighted. 11

15.30.s:
anujñāto mahāviṣṇoḥ prasādamupayujya vai ..
śayīta bhuvi suprīto dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇamānasaḥ .. 12 ..
śvobhūte tu śuciḥ snātaḥ saṃpūjya jagadīśvaram ..
pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskṛtya mahāviṣṇoranujñayā ..
pṛṣṭvā kulavṛddhāṃśca brāhmaṇānvaiṣṇavānpriyān.. 12 ..
15.30.d:
अनुज्ञातो महाविष्णोः प्रसादमुपयुज्य वै ..
शयीत भुवि सुप्रीतो द्वारकां कृष्णमानसः .. 12 ..
श्वोभूते तु शुचिः स्नातः संपूज्य जगदीश्वरम् ..
प्रदक्षिणं नमस्कृत्य महाविष्णोरनुज्ञया ..
पृष्ट्वा कुलवृद्धांश्च ब्राह्मणान्वैष्णवान्प्रियान्.. 12 ..
15.30.m:
With the permission of Mahāviṣṇu, partaking of his consecrated offering, / one should sleep on the ground, well-pleased, with mind fixed on Dvārakā and Kṛṣṇa. 12
On the next day, pure, having bathed and worshipped the Lord of the Universe, / having circumambulated, bowed down, with the leave of Mahāviṣṇu, / and having consulted the family elders and dear Vaiṣṇava brahmins, 13

15.30.s:
tatastu tadanujñāto gītavāditrasaṃstavaiḥ ..
yātrāraṃbhaṃ prakurvīta dvārakāyāṃ praharṣitaḥ .. 14 ..
15.30.d:
ततस्तु तदनुज्ञातो गीतवादित्रसंस्तवैः ..
यात्रारंभं प्रकुर्वीत द्वारकायां प्रहर्षितः .. 14 ..
15.30.m: then, permitted by them, with songs, instruments, and hymns of praise, / one should joyfully commence the journey to Dvārakā. 14

15.30.s:
dvārakāṃ gacchamānastu śānto dāṃtaḥ śuciḥ sadā ..
brahmacaryamadhaḥ śayyāṃ kurvīta niyatendriyaḥ .. 15 ..
15.30.d:
द्वारकां गच्छमानस्तु शान्तो दांतः शुचिः सदा ..
ब्रह्मचर्यमधः शय्यां कुर्वीत नियतेन्द्रियः .. 15 ..
15.30.m: Going to Dvārakā, one should always be calm, self-restrained, and pure, / practicing celibacy, sleeping on the ground, with senses controlled. 15

15.30.s:
sahasranāmapaṭhanaṃ purāṇapaṭhanaṃ tathā ..
karttavyaṃ sakṛpaṃ cittaṃ satāṃ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ tathā .. 16 ..
15.30.d:
सहस्रनामपठनं पुराणपठनं तथा ..
कर्त्तव्यं सकृपं चित्तं सतां शुश्रूषणं तथा .. 16 ..
15.30.m: Recitation of the Thousand Names and recitation of the Purāṇas / should be performed, with a compassionate mind, as well as service to the virtuous. 16

15.30.s:
annadānādikaṃ sarvaṃ vibhave sati mānavaḥ ..
api svalpaṃ svaśaktyā vai kṛtaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet .. 17 ..
15.30.d:
अन्नदानादिकं सर्वं विभवे सति मानवः ..
अपि स्वल्पं स्वशक्त्या वै कृतं कोटिगुणं भवेत् .. 17 ..
15.30.m: A person should perform the gift of food and all else, if means exist; / even a very small [gift] given according to one's ability becomes ten-million-fold. 17

15.30.s:
pathi kṛṣṇasya yo bhaktyā grāsamekaṃ prayacchati ..
dvīpāṃtā tena dattā bhūḥ puṇyasyānto na vidyate .. 18 ..
15.30.d:
पथि कृष्णस्य यो भक्त्या ग्रासमेकं प्रयच्छति ..
द्वीपांता तेन दत्ता भूः पुण्यस्यान्तो न विद्यते .. 18 ..
15.30.m: Whoever gives a single morsel of food with devotion on the path of Kṛṣṇa, / by him the earth up to its island boundaries has been given; there is no end to his merit. 18

15.30.s:
kiṃ punardvārakākṣetre kṛṣṇasya ca samīpataḥ ..
kalāvekekasikthe ca rājasūyāyutaṃ phalam.. 19 ..
15.30.d:
किं पुनर्द्वारकाक्षेत्रे कृष्णस्य च समीपतः ..
कलावेकेकसिक्थे च राजसूयायुतं फलम्.. 19 ..
15.30.m: What then in the sacred field of Dvārakā, near Kṛṣṇa? / In the Kali [age], for every single grain of food, the fruit is ten thousand Rājasūya sacrifices. 19

15.30.s:
gayāśrāddhasahasrāṇi kṛtāni śatasaṃkhyayā ..
annadānaṃ kṛtaṃ yaistu dvārakāpathi mānavaiḥ .. 7.4.30.20 ..
15.30.d:
गयाश्राद्धसहस्राणि कृतानि शतसंख्यया ..
अन्नदानं कृतं यैस्तु द्वारकापथि मानवैः .. 7.4.30.20 ..
15.30.m: A hundred times a thousand Gayā-śrāddhas have been performed / by those people who have given the gift of food on the path to Dvārakā. 20

15.30.s:
auṣadhaṃ cānnapānīyaṃ pāduke kaṃbalaṃ tathā..
vāsāṃsyupānahau caiva vittaṃ ca vibhave sati ..
varjayetsaṃkaraṃ vidvānyūthālāpāṃstathaiva ca .. 21 ..
15.30.d:
औषधं चान्नपानीयं पादुके कंबलं तथा..
वासांस्युपानहौ चैव वित्तं च विभवे सति ..
वर्जयेत्संकरं विद्वान्यूथालापांस्तथैव च .. 21 ..
15.30.m: Medicine, food, water, sandals, and a blanket, / clothes, shoes, and wealth, if means exist [should be given]; / the wise person should avoid confusion [of duties] and gossiping in crowds. 21

15.30.s:
paranindāṃ ca paiśunyaṃ parasya parivañcanam ..
parānnaṃ parapākaṃ ca sati vitte tyajedbudhaḥ .. 22 ..
15.30.d:
परनिन्दां च पैशुन्यं परस्य परिवञ्चनम् ..
परान्नं परपाकं च सति वित्ते त्यजेद्बुधः .. 22 ..
15.30.m: Speaking ill of others, slander, deceiving another, / another's food, and cooking done by another, a wise person should avoid if wealth exists. 22

15.30.s:
na doṣo hīnavittasya tāvanmātraparigrahe ..
śrotavyā satkathā viṣṇornāmasaṃkīrttanāmṛtam.. 23 ..
15.30.d:
न दोषो हीनवित्तस्य तावन्मात्रपरिग्रहे ..
श्रोतव्या सत्कथा विष्णोर्नामसंकीर्त्तनामृतम्.. 23 ..
15.30.m: There is no fault for one destitute of wealth in accepting only that much. / The sacred story of Viṣṇu and the nectar of chanting his name should be heard. 23

15.30.s:
dvārakāpathigacchadbhiranyonyaṃ bhaktivarddhanam ..
japtavyaṃ vaidikaṃ jāpyaṃ stotramāgamikaṃ tathā .. 24 ..
15.30.d:
द्वारकापथिगच्छद्भिरन्योन्यं भक्तिवर्द्धनम् ..
जप्तव्यं वैदिकं जाप्यं स्तोत्रमागमिकं तथा .. 24 ..
15.30.m: Mutual increase of devotion [should be fostered] by those walking on the path to Dvārakā; / the Vedic prayer should be murmured, as well as Tantric praise. 24

15.30.s:
yātrāyāṃ yatphalaṃ proktaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya ca vai kalau ..
na śakyate mayā vaktuṃ vadanairyugasaṃkhyayā .. 25 ..
15.30.d:
यात्रायां यत्फलं प्रोक्तं श्रीकृष्णस्य च वै कलौ ..
न शक्यते मया वक्तुं वदनैर्युगसंख्यया .. 25 ..
15.30.m: Whatever fruit is spoken of in the Kali [age] for the pilgrimage of glorious Kṛṣṇa, / cannot be told by me even with mouths counted by the yugas. 25

15.30.s:
ityetatkathitaṃ sarvaṃ yatpṛṣṭaṃ tu dvijottamāḥ ..
yatadhvaṃ tatprayatnena viṣṇuprāptau ca satvaram .. 26 ..
15.30.d:
इत्येतत्कथितं सर्वं यत्पृष्टं तु द्विजोत्तमाः ..
यतध्वं तत्प्रयत्नेन विष्णुप्राप्तौ च सत्वरम् .. 26 ..
15.30.m: Thus has all been related, which was asked, O best of the twice-born; / strive therefore with effort and swiftly for the attainment of Viṣṇu." 26

15.30.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
evaṃ te nāradenoktā munayo hṛṣṭamānasāḥ ..
cakruste sahitāḥ sarve kṛṣṇadevasya tatpathi .. 27 ..
15.30.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
एवं ते नारदेनोक्ता मुनयो हृष्टमानसाः ..
चक्रुस्ते सहिताः सर्वे कृष्णदेवस्य तत्पथि .. 27 ..
15.30.m: Glorious Prahlāda said: / Thus addressed by Nārada, the sages, delighted in mind, / all together performed [their pilgrimage] on that path of the god Kṛṣṇa. 27

15.30.s:
kecicchṛṇvanti tā viṣṇoḥ satkathā lokaviśrutāḥ ..
yāsāṃ saṃśravaṇādeva bhagavānviśate hṛdi .. 28 ..
15.30.d:
केचिच्छृण्वन्ति ता विष्णोः सत्कथा लोकविश्रुताः ..
यासां संश्रवणादेव भगवान्विशते हृदि .. 28 ..
15.30.m: Some listened to those sacred stories of Viṣṇu celebrated in the world, / by merely hearing which the Blessed Lord enters into the heart. 28

15.30.s:
kīrtyamānāni nāmāni mahāpuṇyapradāni vai ..
pāvanāni sadā loke kalau viprā viśeṣataḥ .. 29 ..
15.30.d:
कीर्त्यमानानि नामानि महापुण्यप्रदानि वै ..
पावनानि सदा लोके कलौ विप्रा विशेषतः .. 29 ..
15.30.m: His names were being chanted, which bestow great merit / and are ever purifying in the world, especially in the Kali [age], O brahmins. 29

15.30.s:
purāṇasaṃhitā divyā munibhiḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
prakāśayaṃti yā viṣṇormahimānaṃ sumaṃgalam .. 7.4.30.30 ..
15.30.d:
पुराणसंहिता दिव्या मुनिभिः परिकीर्तिताः ..
प्रकाशयंति या विष्णोर्महिमानं सुमंगलम् .. 7.4.30.30 ..
15.30.m: The divine Purāṇa collections, proclaimed by the sages, / which reveal the most auspicious majesty of Viṣṇu, 30

15.30.s:
sadguṇāḥ karmavīryyāṇi kṛtāni viṣṇunā purā ..
līlāvatārarūpaistu śṛṇvanti parayā mudā .. ..31..
15.30.d:
सद्गुणाः कर्मवीर्य्याणि कृतानि विष्णुना पुरा ..
लीलावताररूपैस्तु शृण्वन्ति परया मुदा .. ..31..
15.30.m: the good qualities and deeds of valour performed by Viṣṇu of old / in the forms of his playful incarnations, they heard with supreme joy. 31

15.30.s:
apare vāsudevasya caritāni sumaṃgalāḥ ..
vadaṃti parayā bhaktyā sānandāḥ sāśrulocanāḥ .. 32 ..
15.30.d:
अपरे वासुदेवस्य चरितानि सुमंगलाः ..
वदंति परया भक्त्या सानन्दाः साश्रुलोचनाः .. 32 ..
15.30.m: Others, full of joy and with tear-filled eyes, / related with supreme devotion the most auspicious deeds of Vāsudeva. 32

15.30.s:
anye smaraṃti deveśamanādinidhanaṃ vibhum..
kecijjapaṃti munayaḥ stotrāṇi parayā mudā .. 33 ..
15.30.d:
अन्ये स्मरंति देवेशमनादिनिधनं विभुम्..
केचिज्जपंति मुनयः स्तोत्राणि परया मुदा .. 33 ..
15.30.m: Others remembered the Lord of gods, the omnipresent one without beginning or end; / some sages murmured prayers with supreme delight. 33

15.30.s:
kecittu śatanāmāni japanti munayaḥ pathi ..
anye sahasranāmāni lakṣanāma tathā'pare .. 34 ..
15.30.d:
केचित्तु शतनामानि जपन्ति मुनयः पथि ..
अन्ये सहस्रनामानि लक्षनाम तथाऽपरे .. 34 ..
15.30.m: Some sages indeed murmured the Hundred Names on the path; / others the Thousand Names, and others likewise the Hundred-Thousand Names. 34

15.30.s:
kecillaukikagītāni harināmāni harṣitāḥ ..
utsavaiśca vrajaṃtyanye patākādivibhūṣitāḥ .. 35 ..
15.30.d:
केचिल्लौकिकगीतानि हरिनामानि हर्षिताः ..
उत्सवैश्च व्रजंत्यन्ये पताकादिविभूषिताः .. 35 ..
15.30.m: Some, delighted, [sang] popular songs [containing] the names of Hari; / others proceeded with celebrations, adorned with flags and banners, 35

15.30.s:
gītavāditraghoṣeṇa karatālasvanena ca .. ..
nāsti dhanyatamastasmāttriṣu lokeṣu kaścana .. 36 ..
15.30.d:
गीतवादित्रघोषेण करतालस्वनेन च .. ..
नास्ति धन्यतमस्तस्मात्त्रिषु लोकेषु कश्चन .. 36 ..
15.30.m: with the roar of songs and musical instruments, and the sound of cymbals. / There is none more blessed than him in the three worlds, 36

15.30.s:
darśanaṃ yasya saṃjātaṃ vaiṣṇavānāmanuttamam..
tathaiva jāhnavī puṇyā yamunā ca sarasvatī .. .. 37 ..
15.30.d:
दर्शनं यस्य संजातं वैष्णवानामनुत्तमम्..
तथैव जाह्नवी पुण्या यमुना च सरस्वती .. .. 37 ..
15.30.m: by whom the supreme darśana of the Vaiṣṇavas was obtained. / Likewise the holy Jāhnavī, Yamunā, and Sarasvatī, 37

15.30.s:
revādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ pracakrurgītanarttanam ..
prayāgādīni tīrthāni sāgarāḥ parvatottamāḥ .. 38 ..
15.30.d:
रेवाद्याः सरितः सर्वाः प्रचक्रुर्गीतनर्त्तनम् ..
प्रयागादीनि तीर्थानि सागराः पर्वतोत्तमाः .. 38 ..
15.30.m: and all the rivers such as Revā performed singing and dancing; / the sacred fords such as Prayāga, oceans, and best of mountains, 38

15.30.s:
vārāṇasī kurukṣetraṃ puṇyānyanyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
trailokye yāni tīrthāni kṣetrāṇi devanāyakāḥ ..
cakrurgītaṃ ca nṛtyaṃ ca dvārakāyāśca satpathi .. 39 ..
15.30.d:
वाराणसी कुरुक्षेत्रं पुण्यान्यन्यानि कृत्स्नशः ..
त्रैलोक्ये यानि तीर्थानि क्षेत्राणि देवनायकाः ..
चक्रुर्गीतं च नृत्यं च द्वारकायाश्च सत्पथि .. 39 ..
15.30.m: Vārāṇasī, Kurukṣetra, and all other holy places, / whatever sacred fords and sacred fields exist in the three worlds, and the chiefs of the gods, / performed singing and dancing on the good path to Dvārakā. 39

15.30.s:
ekaikasminpade datte dvārakāpathi gacchatām ..
puṇyaṃ kratusahasrāṇāṃ tatpādarajasaṃkhyayā .. 7.4.30.40 ..
15.30.d:
एकैकस्मिन्पदे दत्ते द्वारकापथि गच्छताम् ..
पुण्यं क्रतुसहस्राणां तत्पादरजसंख्यया .. 7.4.30.40 ..
15.30.m: At every single step taken by those walking on the path to Dvārakā, / there is the merit of a thousand sacrifices, according to the number of dust particles on their feet. 40

15.30.s:
atha te munayaḥ sarve tīrthakṣetrādisaṃyutāḥ ..
śrīmatkṛṣṇālayaṃ dūrāddadṛśurnāradādayaḥ .. 41 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakāṃ prati godāvaryāditīrthakṣetradeva maharṣigamanotsavayātrāvarṇanaṃnāma triṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 30 ..
15.30.d:
अथ ते मुनयः सर्वे तीर्थक्षेत्रादिसंयुताः ..
श्रीमत्कृष्णालयं दूराद्ददृशुर्नारदादयः .. 41 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये द्वारकां प्रति गोदावर्यादितीर्थक्षेत्रदेव महर्षिगमनोत्सवयात्रावर्णनंनाम त्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 30 ..
15.30.m:
Then all those sages, Nārada and the others, accompanied by the sacred fords, sacred fields, and deities, / beheld from afar the glorious abode of Kṛṣṇa. 41
Thus ends the thirtieth chapter, named 'The Description of the Festive Pilgrimage of the Great Sages, Gods, Sacred Fields, and Sacred Fords Beginning with Godāvarī Going toward Dvārakā,' in the Dvārakā-māhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] in the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 30

15.31.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca... ..
divyasvaprabhayā dhvāṃtaṃ bhūtānāṃ nāśayansadā ..
janayanparamānaṃdaṃ bhaktānāṃ ca bhayāpahaḥ .. 1 ..
15.31.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच... ..
दिव्यस्वप्रभया ध्वांतं भूतानां नाशयन्सदा ..
जनयन्परमानंदं भक्तानां च भयापहः .. 1 ..
15.31.m: Prahlāda said: / Dispelling ever the darkness of living beings with its divine intrinsic radiance, / generating supreme bliss, and removing the fear of devotees, 1

15.31.s:
patākābhirdhvajasthābhirdvārakājayavarddhanaḥ ..
divyapuṇyaprakāśena rājate girirāḍiva .. 2 ..
15.31.d:
पताकाभिर्ध्वजस्थाभिर्द्वारकाजयवर्द्धनः ..
दिव्यपुण्यप्रकाशेन राजते गिरिराडिव .. 2 ..
15.31.m: magnifying the victory of Dvārakā with banners mounted upon flagstaffs, / it shines like the king of mountains with its divine holy light. 2

15.31.s:
dṛṣṭvā''layaṃ tadā viṣṇostadāyudhavibhūṣitam..
vihāya pāduke cchatraṃ daṇḍavatpatitā bhuvi .. 3 ..
15.31.d:
दृष्ट्वा'ऽलयं तदा विष्णोस्तदायुधविभूषितम्..
विहाय पादुके च्छत्रं दण्डवत्पतिता भुवि .. 3 ..
15.31.m: Then, having seen the abode of Viṣṇu adorned with his weapons, / having set aside shoes and umbrella, they fell like a rod upon the ground. 3

15.31.s:
bhūmisaṃluṭhanaṃ teṣāṃ tīrthānāmadbhutaṃ mahat ..
abhavadvipra śārdūlāḥ kṣetrādīnāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ .. 4 ..
15.31.d:
भूमिसंलुठनं तेषां तीर्थानामद्भुतं महत् ..
अभवद्विप्र शार्दूलाः क्षेत्रादीनां च सर्वशः .. 4 ..
15.31.m: Great and wondrous was the rolling on the earth of those sacred fords / and of the sacred fields and all else, O tigers among brahmins: 4

15.31.s:
vārāṇasī kurukṣetraṃ prayāgo jāhnavī tathā ..
yamunā narmadā puṇyā puṇyā prācī sarasvatī .. 5 ..
15.31.d:
वाराणसी कुरुक्षेत्रं प्रयागो जाह्नवी तथा ..
यमुना नर्मदा पुण्या पुण्या प्राची सरस्वती .. 5 ..
15.31.m: Vārāṇasī, Kurukṣetra, Prayāga, and likewise Jāhnavī, / Yamunā, the holy Narmadā, and the holy Prācī-Sarasvatī, 5

15.31.s:
godāvarī mahāpuṇyā gayā tisrastu maṃgalāḥ ..
śāligrāmaṃ mahākṣetraṃ puṇyā cakranadī śubhā .. 6 ..
15.31.d:
गोदावरी महापुण्या गया तिस्रस्तु मंगलाः ..
शालिग्रामं महाक्षेत्रं पुण्या चक्रनदी शुभा .. 6 ..
15.31.m: the exceedingly holy Godāvarī, Gayā, and the three auspicious ones, / the great sacred field Śāligrāma, and the holy, auspicious Cakranadī. 6

15.31.s:
payoṣṇī tapatī kṛṣṇā kāveryyādyāḥ supuṇyadāḥ ..
puṣkarādīni tīrthāni sāgarāḥ parvatottamāḥ .. 7 ..
15.31.d:
पयोष्णी तपती कृष्णा कावेर्य्याद्याः सुपुण्यदाः ..
पुष्करादीनि तीर्थानि सागराः पर्वतोत्तमाः .. 7 ..
15.31.m: The Payoṣṇī, Tapatī, Kṛṣṇā, Kāverī, and others giving great merit, / sacred fords such as Puṣkara, the oceans, the best of mountains, 7

15.31.s:
ayodhyā mathurā māyā avaṃtyādyāśca muktidāḥ ..
śrīraṃgākhyamanaṃtaṃ ca prabhāsaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. 8 ..
15.31.d:
अयोध्या मथुरा माया अवंत्याद्याश्च मुक्तिदाः ..
श्रीरंगाख्यमनंतं च प्रभासं च विशेषतः .. 8 ..
15.31.m: Ayodhyā, Mathurā, Māyā, Avantī, and others giving liberation, / and that called Śrīraṅga, Ananta, and especially Prabhāsa, 8

15.31.s:
puruṣottamaṃ mahākṣetramaraṇyānyādayaḥ śubhāḥ ..
trailokye varttamānāni sarvatīrthāni sarvaśaḥ .. 9 ..
15.31.d:
पुरुषोत्तमं महाक्षेत्रमरण्यान्यादयः शुभाः ..
त्रैलोक्ये वर्त्तमानानि सर्वतीर्थानि सर्वशः .. 9 ..
15.31.m: the great sacred field Puruṣottama, auspicious great forests and others, / all the sacred fords present everywhere in the three worlds, 9

15.31.s:
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇālayaṃ puṇyaṃ muhurmuhuḥ praharṣitāḥ ..
jaya śabdairnamaḥśabdairgarjaṃto harināmabhiḥ .. 7.4.31.10 ..
15.31.d:
दृष्ट्वा कृष्णालयं पुण्यं मुहुर्मुहुः प्रहर्षिताः ..
जय शब्दैर्नमःशब्दैर्गर्जंतो हरिनामभिः .. 7.4.31.10 ..
15.31.m: rejoiced greatly again and again on beholding the holy abode of Kṛṣṇa, / roaring with shouts of victory, words of homage, and the names of Hari. 10

15.31.s:
ānaṃdāśrūṇi muṃcaṃtaḥ premṇā gadgadayā girā ..
stuvaṃti munayaḥ sarve tīrthādīni ca sarvaśaḥ .. 11 ..
15.31.d:
आनंदाश्रूणि मुंचंतः प्रेम्णा गद्गदया गिरा ..
स्तुवंति मुनयः सर्वे तीर्थादीनि च सर्वशः .. 11 ..
15.31.m: Shedding tears of joy, with choked voices full of love, / all the sages and all the sacred fords praised [her] everywhere. 11

15.31.s:
atha saṃstuvatāṃ teṣāmanyonyaṃ muditātmanām ..
vīkṣya vaktrāṇi sarveṣāṃ maharṣirnārado'bravīt .. 12 ..
15.31.d:
अथ संस्तुवतां तेषामन्योन्यं मुदितात्मनाम् ..
वीक्ष्य वक्त्राणि सर्वेषां महर्षिर्नारदोऽब्रवीत् .. 12 ..
15.31.m: Then, as they thus praised [her] together with delighted hearts, / the great seer Nārada, looking upon the faces of all, spoke: 12

15.31.s:
.. śrīnārada uvāca .. ..
rāśayaḥ puṇya puṃjānāṃ kṛtā yuṣmābhiruttamāḥ ..
tajjanmanā sahasraistu yaddṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇamaṃdiram .. 13 ..
15.31.d:
.. श्रीनारद उवाच .. ..
राशयः पुण्य पुंजानां कृता युष्माभिरुत्तमाः ..
तज्जन्मना सहस्रैस्तु यद्दृष्टं कृष्णमंदिरम् .. 13 ..
15.31.m: Śrī Nārada said: / Masses of heaps of supreme merit have been earned by you, / since by thousands of births that temple of Kṛṣṇa has been seen! 13

15.31.s:
darśanaṃ kṛṣṇadevasya dvārakāgamane matiḥ ..
dṛḍhabhaktirmahāviṣṇornālpasya tapasaḥ phalam .. 14 ..
15.31.d:
दर्शनं कृष्णदेवस्य द्वारकागमने मतिः ..
दृढभक्तिर्महाविष्णोर्नाल्पस्य तपसः फलम् .. 14 ..
15.31.m: The darśana of Lord Kṛṣṇa, the resolve to journey to Dvārakā, / firm devotion to Mahāviṣṇu—this is not the fruit of meager austerity. 14

15.31.s:
dhanyā vai pūrvajāsteṣāṃ vaṃśajāḥ kṛṣṇadarśanaṃ ..
sotsavā dvārakāṃ yāṃti paśyaṃti ca haripriyām .. 19 ..
dhanyeyaṃ gautamī gaṃgā gautamo'yaṃ mahātapāḥ ..
yatprasādena sarveṣāṃ kalyāṇaṃ samupasthitam .. 16 ..
yajñādhyayanadānānāṃ tapovratasamādhinām..
saṃprāptaphalamasmābhiryuṣmābhiḥ sarvatīrthakāḥ .. 17 ..
yūyaṃ sarvāṇi tīrthāni kṣetrāṇi caiva kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
kṛṣṇājñayā sarvakālaṃ tiṣṭhadhvaṃ sarvadaivataiḥ .. .. 18 ..
vasaṃti ye'tra te dhanyā ekāhamapi pāvanāḥ ..
paśyaṃtu sumahābhāgā godāvaryyatra jāhnavī .. 19 ..
15.31.d:
धन्या वै पूर्वजास्तेषां वंशजाः कृष्णदर्शनं ..
सोत्सवा द्वारकां यांति पश्यंति च हरिप्रियाम् .. 19 ..
धन्येयं गौतमी गंगा गौतमोऽयं महातपाः ..
यत्प्रसादेन सर्वेषां कल्याणं समुपस्थितम् .. 16 ..
यज्ञाध्ययनदानानां तपोव्रतसमाधिनाम्..
संप्राप्तफलमस्माभिर्युष्माभिः सर्वतीर्थकाः .. 17 ..
यूयं सर्वाणि तीर्थानि क्षेत्राणि चैव कृत्स्नशः ..
कृष्णाज्ञया सर्वकालं तिष्ठध्वं सर्वदैवतैः .. .. 18 ..
वसंति येऽत्र ते धन्या एकाहमपि पावनाः ..
पश्यंतु सुमहाभागा गोदावर्य्यत्र जाह्नवी .. 19 ..
15.31.m:
Blessed indeed are their ancestors, and blessed are the descendants / who joyfully go to Dvārakā for the darśana of Kṛṣṇa and behold the beloved of Hari! 15
Blessed is this Gautamī Gaṅgā! Blessed is this Gautama of great austerities, / by whose grace welfare has arrived for all! 16
O all sacred fords, the fruit of sacrifices, study, gifts, / austerities, vows, and samādhis has been obtained by us and by you. 17
May you, all sacred fords and sacred fields entirely, / abide at all times by Kṛṣṇa's command together with all the gods! 18
Those who dwell here even for a single day are blessed and purified. / O highly fortunate ones, behold the Godāvarī and the Jāhnavī here! 19

15.31.s:
iyaṃ ca śobhate puṇyā dvārakā kṛṣṇa vallabhā ..
prapaśyaṃtu mahābhāgāstathā vārāṇasīṃ śubhām .. 7.4.31.20 ..
15.31.d:
इयं च शोभते पुण्या द्वारका कृष्ण वल्लभा ..
प्रपश्यंतु महाभागास्तथा वाराणसीं शुभाम् .. 7.4.31.20 ..
15.31.m: And this holy Dvārakā, beloved of Kṛṣṇa, shines. / Let the highly fortunate ones behold also auspicious Vārāṇasī! 20

15.31.s:
kṣetrāṇi kurumukhyāni paśyaṃtu dvārakāṃ prabhoḥ ..
tādṛśī mathurā kāśī māyā'dhyodhyā ca rājate .. 21 ..
15.31.d:
क्षेत्राणि कुरुमुख्यानि पश्यंतु द्वारकां प्रभोः ..
तादृशी मथुरा काशी मायाऽध्योध्या च राजते .. 21 ..
15.31.m: Behold the sacred fields, the chief of which is Kuru[kṣetra], and the Dvārakā of the Lord! / [Yet neither] Mathurā, Kāśī, Māyā, nor Ayodhyā shines like this; 21

15.31.s:
avantī na ca kāṃcī ca kṣetraṃ ca puruṣottamam ..
sūryoparāgakāle'pi kurukṣetraṃ na rājate .. 22 ..
15.31.d:
अवन्ती न च कांची च क्षेत्रं च पुरुषोत्तमम् ..
सूर्योपरागकालेऽपि कुरुक्षेत्रं न राजते .. 22 ..
15.31.m: neither Avantī nor Kāñcī, nor the sacred field Puruṣottama; / even at the time of a solar eclipse, Kurukṣetra does not shine [so]. 22

15.31.s: īdṛśaṃ na gayātīrthaṃ yādṛgetatprakāśate .. 23 ..
15.31.d: ईदृशं न गयातीर्थं यादृगेतत्प्रकाशते .. 23 ..
15.31.m: The sacred ford Gayā is not such as this one appears. 23

15.31.s:
grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ yathā sūryyo virājate ..
sakṣetratīrtharājānāṃ dvārakārko virājate .. 24 ..
15.31.d:
ग्रहनक्षत्रताराणां यथा सूर्य्यो विराजते ..
सक्षेत्रतीर्थराजानां द्वारकार्को विराजते .. 24 ..
15.31.m: Just as the sun shines among planets, lunar mansions, and stars, / so the sun of Dvārakā shines among the kings of sacred fields and sacred fords. 24

15.31.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
niśamya nāradenoktaṃ prahṛṣṭāśca tathā dvijāḥ ..
kṣetrāṇi sarvatīrthāni puraskṛtya ca gautamam .. 25 ..
15.31.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
निशम्य नारदेनोक्तं प्रहृष्टाश्च तथा द्विजाः ..
क्षेत्राणि सर्वतीर्थानि पुरस्कृत्य च गौतमम् .. 25 ..
15.31.m: Prahlāda said: / Having heard what was spoken by Nārada, the brahmins rejoiced, / as did the sacred fields and all the sacred fords, placing Gautama at their head. 25

15.31.s:
vihāya gautamīṃ tatra prayayurhyagratogrataḥ ..
prahṛṣṭā gautamī tatra praṇamya tvaritā yayau .. 26 ..
15.31.d:
विहाय गौतमीं तत्र प्रययुर्ह्यग्रतोग्रतः ..
प्रहृष्टा गौतमी तत्र प्रणम्य त्वरिता ययौ .. 26 ..
15.31.m: Leaving the Gautamī there, they went onward and onward; / delighted, the Gautamī bowed down there and swiftly went along. 26

15.31.s:
gītavādyaiśca nṛtyaiśca patākābhiḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
prayayuḥ stotrapāṭhaiśca sarve te dvārakāśraye .. 27 ..
15.31.d:
गीतवाद्यैश्च नृत्यैश्च पताकाभिः समंततः ..
प्रययुः स्तोत्रपाठैश्च सर्वे ते द्वारकाश्रये .. 27 ..
15.31.m: With songs, instruments, dances, and banners on every side, / and with recitations of hymns of praise, they all went to the sanctuary of Dvārakā. 27

15.31.s:
sa tīrthānyagrataḥ kṛtvā madhye kṛtvā tu śobhanam ..
prayāgaṃ tīrtharājaṃ ca prahṛṣṭaṃ kṣetradarśanāt .. 28 ..
15.31.d:
स तीर्थान्यग्रतः कृत्वा मध्ये कृत्वा तु शोभनम् ..
प्रयागं तीर्थराजं च प्रहृष्टं क्षेत्रदर्शनात् .. 28 ..
15.31.m: Placing the sacred fords in front, and placing in the center splendid / Prayāga, king of sacred fords, rejoicing at the sight of the sacred field, 28

15.31.s:
tataḥ paścātsaritsnānaṃ cakāra ṛṣisattamaḥ ..
jāhnavī gautamī revā yamunāprāksarasvatī .. 29 ..
15.31.d:
ततः पश्चात्सरित्स्नानं चकार ऋषिसत्तमः ..
जाह्नवी गौतमी रेवा यमुनाप्राक्सरस्वती .. 29 ..
15.31.m: the best of seers then performed river ablutions. / The Jāhnavī, Gautamī, Revā, Yamunā, and eastern Sarasvatī, 29

15.31.s:
sarayūrgaṃḍakī tāpī payoṣṇī yamunā tathā ..
kṛṣṇā bhīmarathī gaṃgā kāverī cāghanāśinī .. .. 7.4.31.30 ..
15.31.d:
सरयूर्गंडकी तापी पयोष्णी यमुना तथा ..
कृष्णा भीमरथी गंगा कावेरी चाघनाशिनी .. .. 7.4.31.30 ..
15.31.m: the Sarayū, Gaṇḍakī, Tāpī, Payoṣṇī, and Yamunā, / the Kṛṣṇā, Bhīmarathī, Gaṅgā, and Kāverī that destroys sins, 30

15.31.s:
maṃdākinī mahāpuṇyā puṇyā bhogavatī nadī ..
vrajaṃti yugapatsarvāḥ paśyaṃtyo dvārakāṃ purīm .. 31 ..
15.31.d:
मंदाकिनी महापुण्या पुण्या भोगवती नदी ..
व्रजंति युगपत्सर्वाः पश्यंत्यो द्वारकां पुरीम् .. 31 ..
15.31.m: the Mandākinī of great merit, and the holy river Bhogavatī— / all went together, gazing upon the city of Dvārakā. 31

15.31.s:
tataste sāgarāḥ sapta svaiḥsvaistīrthaiḥ samanvitāḥ ..
tataḥ paścādaraṇyānyāśramaiḥ puṇyaiyutāni ca .. 32 ..
15.31.d:
ततस्ते सागराः सप्त स्वैःस्वैस्तीर्थैः समन्विताः ..
ततः पश्चादरण्यान्याश्रमैः पुण्यैयुतानि च .. 32 ..
15.31.m: Then the seven oceans, accompanied by their respective sacred fords, / and after them the great forests endowed with holy hermitages; 32

15.31.s:
tatastu parvatā ramyā mervādyāstu suśobhanāḥ ..
nṛtyaṃto gāyamānāśca stavādyaistu maharṣibhiḥ .. 33 ..
15.31.d:
ततस्तु पर्वता रम्या मेर्वाद्यास्तु सुशोभनाः ..
नृत्यंतो गायमानाश्च स्तवाद्यैस्तु महर्षिभिः .. 33 ..
15.31.m: then the delightful mountains, Meru and the rest, exceedingly radiant, / dancing and singing along with the great seers through hymns and the like; 33

15.31.s:
tataśca ṛṣayo devāḥ samaṃtāddhṛṣṭamānasāḥ ..
gāyaṃto nṛtyamānāśca garjaṃto harināmabhiḥ .. 34 ..
15.31.d:
ततश्च ऋषयो देवाः समंताद्धृष्टमानसाः ..
गायंतो नृत्यमानाश्च गर्जंतो हरिनामभिः .. 34 ..
15.31.m: and then the seers and gods, delighted in heart on every side, / singing and dancing, roaring with the names of Hari, 34

15.31.s:
vāditraninadairuccairjayaśabdaiḥ praharṣitāḥ ..
prāptāste gomatītīraṃ sarvayajñasamanvitāḥ ..
vavaṃdire mahāpuṇyāḥ sarve te hṛṣṭamānasāḥ .. 35 ..
15.31.d:
वादित्रनिनदैरुच्चैर्जयशब्दैः प्रहर्षिताः ..
प्राप्तास्ते गोमतीतीरं सर्वयज्ञसमन्विताः ..
ववंदिरे महापुण्याः सर्वे ते हृष्टमानसाः .. 35 ..
15.31.m: rejoicing with the loud sounds of musical instruments and shouts of victory, / arrived at the bank of the Gomatī along with all the sacrifices; / full of great merit, all of them bowed down with delighted hearts. 35

15.31.s:
.. śrīnārada uvāca .. ..
he bhāgīrathi he reve yamune śṛṇu gautami ..
śreṣṭhā śrīgomatīdevī vikhyātā bhuvanatraye .. 36 ..
15.31.d:
.. श्रीनारद उवाच .. ..
हे भागीरथि हे रेवे यमुने शृणु गौतमि ..
श्रेष्ठा श्रीगोमतीदेवी विख्याता भुवनत्रये .. 36 ..
15.31.m: Śrī Nārada said: / O Bhāgīrathī, O Revā, Yamunā, listen O Gautamī! / The goddess Śrī Gomatī is supreme, renowned in the three worlds. 36

15.31.s:
yasyāḥ sakṛjjalasnānaṃ sparddhate brahmavidyayā ..
tena vai gomatī seyaṃ sarvatīrthottamottamā ..
brahmajñānena mucyaṃte prayāgamaraṇena vā ..
snānamātreṇa gomatyāṃ mucyate pūrvajaiḥ saha .. 37 ..
15.31.d:
यस्याः सकृज्जलस्नानं स्पर्द्धते ब्रह्मविद्यया ..
तेन वै गोमती सेयं सर्वतीर्थोत्तमोत्तमा ..
ब्रह्मज्ञानेन मुच्यंते प्रयागमरणेन वा ..
स्नानमात्रेण गोमत्यां मुच्यते पूर्वजैः सह .. 37 ..
15.31.m: Even a single ritual ablution in whose waters rivals the knowledge of Brahman; / therefore this Gomatī is indeed the best among all the best of sacred fords. / People are liberated by the knowledge of Brahman, or by dying at Prayāga; / by mere ablution in the Gomatī, one is liberated along with one's ancestors. 37

15.31.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
niśamya tāni tīrthāni māhātmyaṃ mahadadbhutam ..
gomatyāḥ śraddhayā snātvā utsavairagrato yayuḥ .. 38 ..
15.31.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
निशम्य तानि तीर्थानि माहात्म्यं महदद्भुतम् ..
गोमत्याः श्रद्धया स्नात्वा उत्सवैरग्रतो ययुः .. 38 ..
15.31.m: Prahlāda said: / Having heard the great, marvelous māhātmya of the Gomatī, / those sacred fords bathed with faith and went forward in celebration. 38

15.31.s:
tataḥ kṣetrāṇi tīrthāni saritaḥ sāgarādayaḥ ..
dadṛśurdvārakāṃ ramyāmāgatā dvāramaṇḍape .. 39 ..
15.31.d:
ततः क्षेत्राणि तीर्थानि सरितः सागरादयः ..
ददृशुर्द्वारकां रम्यामागता द्वारमण्डपे .. 39 ..
15.31.m: Then the sacred fields, sacred fords, rivers, oceans, and the rest, / coming to the gateway pavilion, beheld charming Dvārakā, 39

15.31.s:
sthitāṃ siṃhāsane divye maṇikāṃcanabhūṣite ..
sundarāṃ śukla varṇāṃ ca rudrādityasamaprabhām .. 7.4.31.40 ..
15.31.d:
स्थितां सिंहासने दिव्ये मणिकांचनभूषिते ..
सुन्दरां शुक्ल वर्णां च रुद्रादित्यसमप्रभाम् .. 7.4.31.40 ..
15.31.m: seated upon a divine throne adorned with gems and gold, / beautiful, white in complexion, radiant like Rudra and the sun, 40

15.31.s:
divyavastrāṃ sugaṃdhāḍhyāṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitām ..
kirīṭakuṇḍalairdivyaiḥ śobhitāṃ kaṃkaṇādibhiḥ .. 41 ..
15.31.d:
दिव्यवस्त्रां सुगंधाढ्यां रत्नाभरणभूषिताम् ..
किरीटकुण्डलैर्दिव्यैः शोभितां कंकणादिभिः .. 41 ..
15.31.m: clad in divine garments, rich in sweet fragrances, adorned with jewel-ornaments, / resplendent with a divine crown, earrings, bracelets, and the like, 41

15.31.s:
varadābhayahastāṃ ca śaṃkhacakragadāyudhām..
śvetātapatraśobhāḍhyāṃ cāmaravyajanādibhiḥ .. 42 ..
15.31.d:
वरदाभयहस्तां च शंखचक्रगदायुधाम्..
श्वेतातपत्रशोभाढ्यां चामरव्यजनादिभिः .. 42 ..
15.31.m: with hands showing the boon-granting and fear-dispelling gestures, armed with conch, discus, and mace, / richly adorned with a white parasol, chowries, fans, and the like, 42

15.31.s:
saṃstavaiḥ stūyamānāṃ ca gītavādyādiharṣitām ..
mahāsiṃhāsanasthāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā dvāravatīṃ purīm..
praṇemuryugapatsarve sarvāṇi ca subhaktitaḥ .. 43 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye mūrtimatīdvāravatīdarśanavarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 31 ..
15.31.d:
संस्तवैः स्तूयमानां च गीतवाद्यादिहर्षिताम् ..
महासिंहासनस्थां तु दृष्ट्वा द्वारवतीं पुरीम्..
प्रणेमुर्युगपत्सर्वे सर्वाणि च सुभक्तितः .. 43 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये मूर्तिमतीद्वारवतीदर्शनवर्णनंनामैकत्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 31 ..
15.31.m:
praised with hymns of eulogy and delighted by song, music, and the like. / Beholding the city of Dvāravatī seated upon the great throne, / all of them bowed down together with great devotion. 43
Thus ends the thirty-first chapter, named 'The Description of the Darśana of the Embodied Dvāravatī', in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 31

15.32.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca ..
nāradastvagrato gatvā praṇamyātha haripriyām ..
uvāca lalitāṃ vācaṃ harṣayandvārakāṃ purīm .. 1 ..
15.32.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच ..
नारदस्त्वग्रतो गत्वा प्रणम्याथ हरिप्रियाम् ..
उवाच ललितां वाचं हर्षयन्द्वारकां पुरीम् .. 1 ..
15.32.m: Prahlāda said: / Going forward and bowing down to the beloved of Hari, / Nārada then spoke charming words, gladdening the city of Dvārakā: 1

15.32.s:
.. śrīnārada uvāca .. ..
paśyapaśya mahābhāge sarve prāptāḥ suśobhane ..
tīrthakṣetrāṇi devāśca ṛṣayaścaiva kṛtsnaśaḥ .. 2 ..
15.32.d:
.. श्रीनारद उवाच .. ..
पश्यपश्य महाभागे सर्वे प्राप्ताः सुशोभने ..
तीर्थक्षेत्राणि देवाश्च ऋषयश्चैव कृत्स्नशः .. 2 ..
15.32.m: Śrī Nārada said: / Look, look, O highly fortunate one, O most beautiful lady, all have arrived— / the sacred fords, the sacred fields, the gods, and the seers in their entirety! 2

15.32.s:
paśyemaṃ purataḥ prāptaṃ prayāgaṃ tīrthakaiḥ saha ..
dvārake tava pādābje luṇṭhaṃte śraddhayādbhutam .. 3 ..
15.32.d:
पश्येमं पुरतः प्राप्तं प्रयागं तीर्थकैः सह ..
द्वारके तव पादाब्जे लुण्ठंते श्रद्धयाद्भुतम् .. 3 ..
15.32.m:
"Behold Prayāga, arrived before [you] along with its sacred fords; / O Dvārakā, they roll at your lotus feet with wonderful faith.
3

15.32.s:
idaṃ tu puṣkaraṃ tīrthaṃ namati śraddhayā śubhe ..
iyaṃ tu gautamī puṇyā sarvatīrthasamāśrayā .. 4 ..
15.32.d:
इदं तु पुष्करं तीर्थं नमति श्रद्धया शुभे ..
इयं तु गौतमी पुण्या सर्वतीर्थसमाश्रया .. 4 ..
15.32.m:
And this Puṣkara sacred ford bows down with faith, O auspicious one; / and this is the holy Gautamī, the refuge of all sacred fords.
4

15.32.s:
siṃhasthe ca gurau bhadre saṃprāptā saubhagaṃ mahat ..
kintu durjanasaṃsargāddagdhā pāpāgninā bhṛśam .. 5 ..
15.32.d:
सिंहस्थे च गुरौ भद्रे संप्राप्ता सौभगं महत् ..
किन्तु दुर्जनसंसर्गाद्दग्धा पापाग्निना भृशम् .. 5 ..
15.32.m:
When Jupiter was in Leo, O blessed lady, she obtained great good fortune; / yet, through contact with wicked people, she was severely burned by the fire of sin.
5

15.32.s:
tatropāyamabhijñāya ṛṣīṇāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tadā ..
śrutvā karṇe mahacchabdaṃ saṃprāpteyaṃ tavāṃtikam .. 6 ..
15.32.d:
तत्रोपायमभिज्ञाय ऋषीणां शृण्वतां तदा ..
श्रुत्वा कर्णे महच्छब्दं संप्राप्तेयं तवांतिकम् .. 6 ..
15.32.m:
Not knowing the remedy there while seers were listening at that time, / hearing a great sound in her ear, she has arrived near you.
6

15.32.s:
namaskaroti devi tvāṃ dvārake gautamī śubhā ..
paśyapaśya mahāpuṇyā iyaṃ bhāgīrathī śubhā .. 7 ..
15.32.d:
नमस्करोति देवि त्वां द्वारके गौतमी शुभा ..
पश्यपश्य महापुण्या इयं भागीरथी शुभा .. 7 ..
15.32.m:
O goddess, the auspicious Gautamī bows to you, O Dvārakā; / look, look at this very holy, auspicious Bhāgīrathī!
7

15.32.s:
namaskaroti te pādau saṃhṛṣṭā ca punaḥpunaḥ ..
paśyemāṃ narmadāṃ ramyāṃ praṇatāṃ tava pādayoḥ .. 8 ..
15.32.d:
नमस्करोति ते पादौ संहृष्टा च पुनःपुनः ..
पश्येमां नर्मदां रम्यां प्रणतां तव पादयोः .. 8 ..
15.32.m:
Greatly delighted, she bows to your feet again and again; / behold this charming Narmadā bowed at your feet!
8

15.32.s:
yamunā candrabhāgeyamiyaṃ prācīsarasvatī ..
sarayūrgaṃḍakī prāptā gomatī pūrvavāhinī .. .. 9 ..
15.32.d:
यमुना चन्द्रभागेयमियं प्राचीसरस्वती ..
सरयूर्गंडकी प्राप्ता गोमती पूर्ववाहिनी .. .. 9 ..
15.32.m:
Yamunā, Candrabhāgā, this eastward-flowing Sarasvatī, / Sarayū, and Gaṇḍakī have arrived, [and] the eastward-flowing Gomatī.
9

15.32.s:
śoṇaḥ sindhunadī caitā anyāśca saritāṃ varāḥ ..
kṛṣṇā bhīmarathī puṇyā kāveryyādyāḥ saridvarāḥ .. 7.4.32.10 ..
15.32.d:
शोणः सिन्धुनदी चैता अन्याश्च सरितां वराः ..
कृष्णा भीमरथी पुण्या कावेर्य्याद्याः सरिद्वराः .. 7.4.32.10 ..
15.32.m:
The Śoṇa, the Sindhu river, and these other best of rivers, / the holy Kṛṣṇā, the Bhīmarathī, Kāverī, and the other best rivers—
10

15.32.s:
sītācakṣurnadī bhadrā namaṃtyetāḥ padāṃbujam ..
dvārake tā mahāpuṇyāḥ saptadvīpodbhavāḥ parāḥ..11..
15.32.d:
सीताचक्षुर्नदी भद्रा नमंत्येताः पदांबुजम् ..
द्वारके ता महापुण्याः सप्तद्वीपोद्भवाः पराः..11..
15.32.m:
the Sītā, Cakṣu river, [and] Bhadrā—these bow to your lotus feet; / O Dvārakā, those very holy, supreme [rivers] born of the seven continents,
11

15.32.s:
mandākinī mahāpuṇyā bhogavatyādisaṃyutā..
paśyāścaryamidaṃ bhadre vārāṇasī vimuktidā ..12..
15.32.d:
मन्दाकिनी महापुण्या भोगवत्यादिसंयुता..
पश्याश्चर्यमिदं भद्रे वाराणसी विमुक्तिदा ..12..
15.32.m:
the greatly holy Mandākinī accompanied by Bhogavatī and others. / Behold this wonder, O blessed lady: Vārāṇasī, bestower of liberation,
12

15.32.s:
bhaktyā te ca padāṃbhojaṃ śirasyādhāya vartate ..
kurukṣetraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ namati tvāmaharniśam ..13..
15.32.d:
भक्त्या ते च पदांभोजं शिरस्याधाय वर्तते ..
कुरुक्षेत्रं महापुण्यं नमति त्वामहर्निशम् ..13..
15.32.m:
remains placing your lotus foot upon her head with devotion; / the greatly holy Kurukṣetra bows to you day and night.
13

15.32.s:
dvārake mathurāṃ paśya praṇatāṃ tava pādayoḥ ..
ayodhyā'vaṃtikāmāyāstā namaṃti padāṃbujam.. 14 ..
15.32.d:
द्वारके मथुरां पश्य प्रणतां तव पादयोः ..
अयोध्याऽवंतिकामायास्ता नमंति पदांबुजम्.. 14 ..
15.32.m:
O Dvārakā, behold Mathurā bowed at your feet; / Ayodhyā, Avantikā, and Māyā bow to your lotus feet.
14

15.32.s:
kāṃcī gayā viśālā ca virajā luṭhati kṣitau ..
śāligrāmaṃ mahākṣetraṃ patitaṃ tava pādayoḥ..
virājate prabhāsaṃ ca kṣetraṃ ca puruṣottamam .. 15 ..
15.32.d:
कांची गया विशाला च विरजा लुठति क्षितौ ..
शालिग्रामं महाक्षेत्रं पतितं तव पादयोः..
विराजते प्रभासं च क्षेत्रं च पुरुषोत्तमम् .. 15 ..
15.32.m:
Kāñcī, Gayā, and Viśālā; and Virajā rolls on the ground; / the great sacred field Śāligrāma has fallen at your feet; / Prabhāsa shines forth, as well as the Puruṣottama sacred field;
15

15.32.s:
bhārgavādīni cānyāni sarvakṣetrāṇi sundari ..
dvārake praṇamaṃti tvāṃ bhaktyotthāya punaḥpunaḥ .. .. 16 ..
15.32.d:
भार्गवादीनि चान्यानि सर्वक्षेत्राणि सुन्दरि ..
द्वारके प्रणमंति त्वां भक्त्योत्थाय पुनःपुनः .. .. 16 ..
15.32.m:
and all the other sacred fields such as Bhārgava, O beautiful lady; / O Dvārakā, they bow to you with devotion, rising again and again.
16

15.32.s:
paśyemānsāgarānsapta patitastāṃba pādayoḥ ..
paśyāraṇyāni sarvāṇi naimiṣaṃ praṇataṃ puraḥ .. 17 ..
15.32.d:
पश्येमान्सागरान्सप्त पतितस्तांब पादयोः ..
पश्यारण्यानि सर्वाणि नैमिषं प्रणतं पुरः .. 17 ..
15.32.m:
Behold these seven oceans fallen at your feet, O mother; / behold all the forests: Naimiṣa has bowed in front,
17

15.32.s:
dhanuṣkaṃ ca daśāraṇyaṃ daṃḍakāraṇyamarbudam..
nārāyaṇāśramaṃ paśya dvārake praṇataṃ tathā .. 18 ..
15.32.d:
धनुष्कं च दशारण्यं दंडकारण्यमर्बुदम्..
नारायणाश्रमं पश्य द्वारके प्रणतं तथा .. 18 ..
15.32.m:
Dhanuṣka, Daśāraṇya, Daṇḍakāraṇya, Arbuda; / and behold the Nārāyaṇāśrama bowed in that way, O Dvārakā.
17

15.32.s:
ayaṃ meruśca kailāso mandarādyāḥ sahasraśaḥ ..
himādrirviṃdhyaśailaśca śrīśailādyāḥ praharṣitāḥ ..
ete hyṛṣigaṇāḥ sarve namaṃtisma punaḥpunaḥ .. 19 ..
15.32.d:
अयं मेरुश्च कैलासो मन्दराद्याः सहस्रशः ..
हिमाद्रिर्विंध्यशैलश्च श्रीशैलाद्याः प्रहर्षिताः ..
एते ह्यृषिगणाः सर्वे नमंतिस्म पुनःपुनः .. 19 ..
15.32.m:
This Meru, and Kailāsa, and thousands such as Mandara; / Himādri, the Vindhya mountain, and those such as Śrīśaila are overjoyed; / all these hosts of seers indeed bow again and again.
19

15.32.s:
gaṃgādyāḥ sāgarāḥ śailā nṛtyaṃti puratastava ..
ṛṣidevagaṇāḥ sarve sarve garjaṃti nāmabhiḥ .. 7.4.32.20 .. ..
15.32.d:
गंगाद्याः सागराः शैला नृत्यंति पुरतस्तव ..
ऋषिदेवगणाः सर्वे सर्वे गर्जंति नामभिः .. 7.4.32.20 .. ..
15.32.m:
The Gaṅgā and others, oceans, and mountains dance before you; / all the hosts of seers and gods roar with [your] names."
20

15.32.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
ityevaṃ vadatastasya dvārakā hṛṣṭamānasā ..
nṛtyato muditānvīkṣya sarvānpremṇābhinaṃdya ca ..
uvāca lalitā vācaṃ gautamīṃ spṛśya pāṇinā .. 21 ..
15.32.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
इत्येवं वदतस्तस्य द्वारका हृष्टमानसा ..
नृत्यतो मुदितान्वीक्ष्य सर्वान्प्रेम्णाभिनंद्य च ..
उवाच ललिता वाचं गौतमीं स्पृश्य पाणिना .. 21 ..
15.32.m:
Śrī Prahlāda said: / While he was speaking thus, Dvārakā, joyful at heart, / having seen them all dancing and glad, greeted them with love / and, touching Gautamī with her hand, spoke pleasant words.
21

15.32.s:
bhāgīrathīprayāgādīnkṣetrādīnatha sarvaśaḥ ..
dvārakā madhurālāpaiḥ sarvānānaṃdayattadā .. 22 ..
15.32.d:
भागीरथीप्रयागादीन्क्षेत्रादीनथ सर्वशः ..
द्वारका मधुरालापैः सर्वानानंदयत्तदा .. 22 ..
15.32.m:
To the Bhāgīrathī, Prayāga, and others, and all the sacred fields, / Dvārakā then gave joy to all with sweet conversations.
22

15.32.s:
athāścaryamabhūttatra sarvānaṃdavivarddhanam ..
atha tāvattadā''kāśe gītavādyajayasvanāḥ .. 23 ..
15.32.d:
अथाश्चर्यमभूत्तत्र सर्वानंदविवर्द्धनम् ..
अथ तावत्तदा'ऽकाशे गीतवाद्यजयस्वनाः .. 23 ..
15.32.m:
Then a wonder occurred there, increasing the joy of all; / then at that time in the sky [arose] the sounds of singing, instrumental music, and "Victory!",
23

15.32.s:
garjanāni supuṇyāni hariśabdaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak ..
apaśyanvai tadā sarve brahmādyā devanāyakāḥ .. 24 ..
15.32.d:
गर्जनानि सुपुण्यानि हरिशब्दैः पृथक्पृथक् ..
अपश्यन्वै तदा सर्वे ब्रह्माद्या देवनायकाः .. 24 ..
15.32.m:
supremely holy roaring sounds, each distinct with the words "Hari!"; / all the lords of gods headed by Brahmā indeed saw [this] then.
24

15.32.s:
maheśaḥ svagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ bhavānyā samadṛśyata ..
indrastu tridaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ yakṣagandharvakinnaraiḥ .. 25 ..
15.32.d:
महेशः स्वगणैः सार्द्धं भवान्या समदृश्यत ..
इन्द्रस्तु त्रिदशैः सार्द्धं यक्षगन्धर्वकिन्नरैः .. 25 ..
15.32.m:
Maheśa was seen together with his own attendants and with Bhavānī; / and Indra with the gods, along with yakṣas, gandharvas, and kinnaras,
25

15.32.s:
marudbhirlokapālaiścā nṛtyamānāḥ praharṣitāḥ ..
siddhavidyādharāḥ sarve vasvādityāśca sagrahāḥ .. 26 ..
15.32.d:
मरुद्भिर्लोकपालैश्चा नृत्यमानाः प्रहर्षिताः ..
सिद्धविद्याधराः सर्वे वस्वादित्याश्च सग्रहाः .. 26 ..
15.32.m:
overjoyed, dancing along with the Maruts and the world-protectors; / all the siddhas and vidyādharas, the Vasus, Ādityas, and the planets,
26

15.32.s:
bhṛgvādyāḥ sanakādyāśca nṛtyamānāḥ praharṣitāḥ ..
brahmāṇaṃ ca namaskṛtya saptasvargasthitāḥ surāḥ .. 27 ..
15.32.d:
भृग्वाद्याः सनकाद्याश्च नृत्यमानाः प्रहर्षिताः ..
ब्रह्माणं च नमस्कृत्य सप्तस्वर्गस्थिताः सुराः .. 27 ..
15.32.m:
those headed by Bhṛgu, and those headed by Sanaka, overjoyed and dancing, / and the gods dwelling in the seven heavens, having bowed to Brahmā,
27

15.32.s:
ūcuste dvārakāṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmeśānādayastadā ..
harṣavihvalitātmāno vīkṣyā'nyonyaṃ ca vismitāḥ .. 28 .. ..
15.32.d:
ऊचुस्ते द्वारकां दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मेशानादयस्तदा ..
हर्षविह्वलितात्मानो वीक्ष्याऽन्योन्यं च विस्मिताः .. 28 .. ..
15.32.m:
those headed by Brahmā and Īśāna, seeing Dvārakā then, / their minds overwhelmed with joy, looking at one another in wonder, spoke.
28

15.32.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
seyaṃ vai dvārakā devī vahate yatra gomatī ..
yatrā''ste bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ seyaṃ puṇyā virājate .. 29 ..
15.32.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
सेयं वै द्वारका देवी वहते यत्र गोमती ..
यत्रा'ऽस्ते भगवान्कृष्णः सेयं पुण्या विराजते .. 29 ..
15.32.m:
The gods said: / "Indeed, this is the goddess Dvārakā where the Gomatī flows; / this holy [city] where the Lord Kṛṣṇa resides shines forth.
29

15.32.s:
sarvakṣetrottamā yā ca sarvatīrthottamottamā ..
svargādapyadhikā bhūmau dvārakeyaṃ prakāśate .. 7.4.32.30 ..
15.32.d:
सर्वक्षेत्रोत्तमा या च सर्वतीर्थोत्तमोत्तमा ..
स्वर्गादप्यधिका भूमौ द्वारकेयं प्रकाशते .. 7.4.32.30 ..
15.32.m:
She who is the best of all sacred fields, the most supreme among all sacred fords, / higher even than heaven, this Dvārakā shines on earth.
30

15.32.s:
etadvai cakratīrthaṃ ca yacchilā cakra cihnitā ..
muktidā pāpināṃ loke mlecchadeśe'pi pūjitā .. 31 ..
15.32.d:
एतद्वै चक्रतीर्थं च यच्छिला चक्र चिह्निता ..
मुक्तिदा पापिनां लोके म्लेच्छदेशेऽपि पूजिता .. 31 ..
15.32.m:
Indeed, this is the Cakra sacred ford whose stones are marked with the discus, / bestowing liberation upon sinners in the world, worshipped even in a barbarian country."
31

15.32.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
brahmādīnāgatāndṛṣṭvā vismitā nāradādayaḥ ..
kṣetrāṇi tīrthamukhyāni vismitāni saridvarāḥ ..
praṇemuryugapatsarve sarvāḥ sarvāṇi sarvaśaḥ .. 32 ..
15.32.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मादीनागतान्दृष्ट्वा विस्मिता नारदादयः ..
क्षेत्राणि तीर्थमुख्यानि विस्मितानि सरिद्वराः ..
प्रणेमुर्युगपत्सर्वे सर्वाः सर्वाणि सर्वशः .. 32 ..
15.32.m:
Prahlāda said: / Seeing those headed by Brahmā arrived, those headed by Nārada were amazed; / the sacred fields, the chief sacred fords, and the best of rivers were amazed; / all of them bowed simultaneously in every way.
32

15.32.s:
brahmādīnāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ dṛṣṭvā yātrāṃ manoharām ..
dvārakāṃ prati viprendrā vismitā dvārakaukasaḥ .. 33 ..
15.32.d:
ब्रह्मादीनां च तीर्थानां दृष्ट्वा यात्रां मनोहराम् ..
द्वारकां प्रति विप्रेन्द्रा विस्मिता द्वारकौकसः .. 33 ..
15.32.m:
Seeing the captivating journey of those headed by Brahmā and of the sacred fords / toward Dvārakā, O best of brahmins, the residents of Dvārakā were astonished.
33

15.32.s:
dṛṣṭvā devagaṇāḥ sarve dvārakāṃ prati maṃdire ..
gītavādyādi nirghoṣairnṛtyamānāḥ praharṣitāḥ .. 34 ..
15.32.d:
दृष्ट्वा देवगणाः सर्वे द्वारकां प्रति मंदिरे ..
गीतवाद्यादि निर्घोषैर्नृत्यमानाः प्रहर्षिताः .. 34 ..
15.32.m:
Having seen the hosts of gods, overjoyed, dancing toward Dvārakā in the temple / with the sounds of songs, instruments, and the like,
34

15.32.s:
vadanto jayaśabdāṃśca seyaṃ kṛṣṇapriyeti ca ..
dṛṣṭvā brahmamaheśānau dvārakāṃ prītamānasau .. 35 ..
15.32.d:
वदन्तो जयशब्दांश्च सेयं कृष्णप्रियेति च ..
दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्ममहेशानौ द्वारकां प्रीतमानसौ .. 35 ..
15.32.m:
and uttering words of "Victory!" and "She is dear to Kṛṣṇa!", / Brahmā and Maheśāna, pleased at heart upon seeing Dvārakā,
35

15.32.s:
tyaktvā ca vāhane śreṣṭhe daṇḍavatpatitau bhuvi ..
ūcatuśca tadā devau dvārakāṃ prati harṣitau .. 36 ..
15.32.d:
त्यक्त्वा च वाहने श्रेष्ठे दण्डवत्पतितौ भुवि ..
ऊचतुश्च तदा देवौ द्वारकां प्रति हर्षितौ .. 36 ..
15.32.m:
left their excellent mounts and fell prostrate like a staff on the ground; / and the two gods then spoke with delight to Dvārakā:
36

15.32.s:
śreṣṭhā tvamamba sarvebhyo'smadādibhyo'pi sarvataḥ ..
yatastvāṃ na tyajetsākṣādbhagavānviṣṇuravyayaḥ .. 37 ..
15.32.d:
श्रेष्ठा त्वमम्ब सर्वेभ्योऽस्मदादिभ्योऽपि सर्वतः ..
यतस्त्वां न त्यजेत्साक्षाद्भगवान्विष्णुरव्ययः .. 37 ..
15.32.m:
"You are superior, O mother, to all, even to us in every way, / because the imperishable Lord Viṣṇu himself does not abandon you.
37

15.32.s:
ato darśaya deveśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kaṃsavināśanam ..
yaddarśanānmahāsiddhiḥ sarveṣāṃ ca bhaviṣyati .. 38 .. ..
15.32.d:
अतो दर्शय देवेशं कृष्णं कंसविनाशनम् ..
यद्दर्शनान्महासिद्धिः सर्वेषां च भविष्यति .. 38 .. ..
15.32.m:
Therefore show [us] Kṛṣṇa, the lord of gods, the destroyer of Kaṃsa, / by whose darśana the great perfection will come to all."
38

15.32.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
ityuktvā prayayau devī tīrthakṣetrādisaṃyutā ..
brahmeśānau puraskṛtya hṛṣṭau dṛṣṭvā mahotsavān .. 39 ..
15.32.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ देवी तीर्थक्षेत्रादिसंयुता ..
ब्रह्मेशानौ पुरस्कृत्य हृष्टौ दृष्ट्वा महोत्सवान् .. 39 ..
15.32.m:
Prahlāda said: / Having spoken thus, the goddess departed, accompanied by the sacred fords, fields, and the rest, / having placed Brahmā and Īśāna in front, pleased at seeing the great festivals.
39

15.32.s:
gītavādyapatākaiśca divyopāyanapāṇibhiḥ ..
prāpyovāca tato devāndvārakā harṣavihvalā .. 7.4.32.40 ..
15.32.d:
गीतवाद्यपताकैश्च दिव्योपायनपाणिभिः ..
प्राप्योवाच ततो देवान्द्वारका हर्षविह्वला .. 7.4.32.40 ..
15.32.m:
With songs, instruments, flags, and with divine offerings in their hands, / having approached, Dvārakā, overcome with joy, then said to the gods:
40

15.32.s:
paśyatāṃ paśyatāṃ devāḥ so'yaṃ vai dvārakeśvaraḥ ..
prāpya saṃdarśanaṃ yasya muktānāṃ yatphalaṃ bhavet ..
na vidyate sahasreṣu brahmāṃḍeṣu ca yatphalam .. 41 ..
15.32.d:
पश्यतां पश्यतां देवाः सोऽयं वै द्वारकेश्वरः ..
प्राप्य संदर्शनं यस्य मुक्तानां यत्फलं भवेत् ..
न विद्यते सहस्रेषु ब्रह्मांडेषु च यत्फलम् .. 41 ..
15.32.m:
"Look, look, O gods! He is indeed the Lord of Dvārakā, / having obtained the sight of whom there is that fruit of the liberated / which does not exist in thousands of cosmic eggs."
41

15.32.s:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve kṣetratīrthādisaṃyutāḥ ..
paścimābhimukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ kleśavināśanam ..
praṇemuryugapatsarve prahṛṣṭāḥ samupāgatāḥ .. 42 ..
15.32.d:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे क्षेत्रतीर्थादिसंयुताः ..
पश्चिमाभिमुखं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं क्लेशविनाशनम् ..
प्रणेमुर्युगपत्सर्वे प्रहृष्टाः समुपागताः .. 42 ..
15.32.m:
Then all the hosts of gods, accompanied by the sacred fields, fords, and the rest, / seeing Kṛṣṇa facing west, the destroyer of distress, / approached and all simultaneously bowed down with great delight.
42

15.32.s:
gītavādyapraghoṣaiśca nṛtyamānāḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
jayaśabdaṃ namaḥśabdaṃ garjaṃto harināmabhiḥ .. 43 ..
15.32.d:
गीतवाद्यप्रघोषैश्च नृत्यमानाः समंततः ..
जयशब्दं नमःशब्दं गर्जंतो हरिनामभिः .. 43 ..
15.32.m: Dancing on every side to the sounding of songs and musical instruments, / roaring cries of "Victory!" and "Salutations!" with the names of Hari,

15.32.s:
brahmā bhavo bhavānī ca sendrā devagaṇā bhuvi ..
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇemuste bhaktyotthāya punaḥpunaḥ.. 44 ..
15.32.d:
ब्रह्मा भवो भवानी च सेन्द्रा देवगणा भुवि ..
दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं प्रणेमुस्ते भक्त्योत्थाय पुनःपुनः.. 44 ..
15.32.m: Brahmā, Bhava, Bhavānī, and the hosts of gods led by Indra on the earth / saw Kṛṣṇa and bowed down, rising again and again with devotion.

15.32.s:
prayāgādīni tīrthāni gaṃgādyāḥ sarito'malāḥ ..
ṛṣayo devagaṃdharvāḥ śukādyāḥ sanakādayaḥ ..
vīkṣya vaktraṃ mahāviṣṇoḥ praṇemuśca muhurmuhuḥ .. 45 ..
15.32.d:
प्रयागादीनि तीर्थानि गंगाद्याः सरितोऽमलाः ..
ऋषयो देवगंधर्वाः शुकाद्याः सनकादयः ..
वीक्ष्य वक्त्रं महाविष्णोः प्रणेमुश्च मुहुर्मुहुः .. 45 ..
15.32.m: The sacred fords beginning with Prayāga, the immaculate rivers beginning with the Gaṅgā, / the seers, the divine gandharvas, Śuka and the others, and Sanaka and the rest, / seeing the face of Mahāviṣṇu, bowed down repeatedly,

15.32.s:
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti jaya kṛṣṇeti vādinaḥ ..
snātvā tu gomatīnīre tīre caiva mahodadheḥ ..
kamalāsanaḥ saṃhṛṣṭaḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇamapūjayat .. 46 ..
15.32.d:
कृष्णकृष्णेति कृष्णेति जय कृष्णेति वादिनः ..
स्नात्वा तु गोमतीनीरे तीरे चैव महोदधेः ..
कमलासनः संहृष्टः श्रीमत्कृष्णमपूजयत् .. 46 ..
15.32.m: crying, "Kṛṣṇa! Kṛṣṇa! Kṛṣṇa! Victory to Kṛṣṇa!" / Having bathed in the water of the Gomatī and on the shore of the great ocean, / Brahmā, seated on his lotus, joyfully worshipped glorious Kṛṣṇa.

15.32.s:
svardhenupayasā snāpya divyaiścā mṛtapaṃcakaiḥ ..
bhavaścātha bhavānī ca pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ .. 47 ..
15.32.d:
स्वर्धेनुपयसा स्नाप्य दिव्यैश्चा मृतपंचकैः ..
भवश्चाथ भवानी च पूजयामास भक्तितः .. 47 ..
15.32.m: Bathing [him] with the milk of the cow of heaven and with the divine five nectars, / Bhava and Bhavānī then worshipped [him] with devotion.

15.32.s:
indro devagaṇāḥ sarve yoginaḥ sanakādayaḥ ..
ṛṣayo nāradādyāśca gaṃgādyāśca saridvarāḥ .. 48 ..
15.32.d:
इन्द्रो देवगणाः सर्वे योगिनः सनकादयः ..
ऋषयो नारदाद्याश्च गंगाद्याश्च सरिद्वराः .. 48 ..
15.32.m: Indra, all the hosts of gods, the yogins led by Sanaka, / the seers led by Nārada, and the best of rivers led by the Gaṅgā,

15.32.s:
amūlyābharaṇairbhaktyā mahāratnavinirmitaiḥ ..
divyairmālyairanekaiśca nandanādisamudbhavaiḥ .. 49 ..
15.32.d:
अमूल्याभरणैर्भक्त्या महारत्नविनिर्मितैः ..
दिव्यैर्माल्यैरनेकैश्च नन्दनादिसमुद्भवैः .. 49 ..
15.32.m: with priceless ornaments crafted from great jewels, with devotion, / and with various divine garlands born in Nandana and other heavenly gardens,

15.32.s:
priyayā śrītulasyā vai śrīmatkṛṣṇamapūjayan ..
dhūpairnīrājanairdivyaiḥ karpūraiśca pṛthakpṛthak .. 7.4.32.50 ..
15.32.d:
प्रियया श्रीतुलस्या वै श्रीमत्कृष्णमपूजयन् ..
धूपैर्नीराजनैर्दिव्यैः कर्पूरैश्च पृथक्पृथक् .. 7.4.32.50 ..
15.32.m: and with his beloved sacred tulasī, worshipped glorious Kṛṣṇa / with incenses, divine wave-offerings of light, and with pieces of camphor separately,

15.32.s:
naivedyairvividhaiḥ puṣpairdivyaiḥ karpūravāsitaiḥ ..
sakarpūraiśca tāṃbūlaiḥ priyaiścopāyanaistathā ..51
15.32.d:
नैवेद्यैर्विविधैः पुष्पैर्दिव्यैः कर्पूरवासितैः ..
सकर्पूरैश्च तांबूलैः प्रियैश्चोपायनैस्तथा ..51
15.32.m: with various offerings of food, with divine flowers scented with camphor, / with betel leaves mixed with camphor, and likewise with dear presents,

15.32.s:
mahāmāṃgalikaiḥ sarvaiḥ sudivyairmaṃgalā''rtikaiḥ ..
saṃpūjyaivaṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kleśavināśanam ..
prahṛṣṭā nanṛtuḥ sarve gītavādyapraharṣitāḥ ..52 ..
15.32.d:
महामांगलिकैः सर्वैः सुदिव्यैर्मंगला'ऽर्तिकैः ..
संपूज्यैवं महाविष्णुं कृष्णं क्लेशविनाशनम् ..
प्रहृष्टा ननृतुः सर्वे गीतवाद्यप्रहर्षिताः ..52 ..
15.32.m: with all the most auspicious, exquisite divine auspicious lights. / Having thus worshipped Mahāviṣṇu, Kṛṣṇa who destroys affliction, / all rejoiced and danced, gladdened by song and instruments,

15.32.s:
purataḥ kṛṣṇadevasya hyapsarobhiḥ samanvitāḥ ..
brahmā ca brahmaputrāśca tataḥ sendrā marudgaṇāḥ .. 53 ..
15.32.d:
पुरतः कृष्णदेवस्य ह्यप्सरोभिः समन्विताः ..
ब्रह्मा च ब्रह्मपुत्राश्च ततः सेन्द्रा मरुद्गणाः .. 53 ..
15.32.m: in front of the divine Kṛṣṇa, accompanied by the apsarases: / Brahmā, and the sons of Brahmā, and then the Maruts accompanied by Indra.

15.32.s:
brahmādīnnṛtyataḥ prekṣya bhagavānkamalekṣaṇaḥ ..
vārayāmāsa hastena prītaḥ prāha surānvibhuḥ.. 54 ..
15.32.d:
ब्रह्मादीन्नृत्यतः प्रेक्ष्य भगवान्कमलेक्षणः ..
वारयामास हस्तेन प्रीतः प्राह सुरान्विभुः.. 54 ..
15.32.m: Seeing Brahmā and the others dancing, the lotus-eyed Lord, / the all-pervading one, gestured them to stop with his hand and, pleased, spoke to the gods:

15.32.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
bhobho brahmanmaheśāna he bhavāni maheśvari ..
kṣetrāṇi sarvatīrthāni nāradaḥ sanakādayaḥ ..
prīto'haṃ bhavatā samyaksarvānkāmānavāpsyatha .. 55 ..
15.32.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
भोभो ब्रह्मन्महेशान हे भवानि महेश्वरि ..
क्षेत्राणि सर्वतीर्थानि नारदः सनकादयः ..
प्रीतोऽहं भवता सम्यक्सर्वान्कामानवाप्स्यथ .. 55 ..
15.32.m: The holy Lord said: / "O Brahmā, O Maheśāna, O Bhavānī, O Maheśvarī, / O sacred fields, all sacred fords, Nārada, Sanaka and the rest, / I am well pleased with you; you shall obtain all your desires."

15.32.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
tadābhilaṣitām̐llabdhvā sa rvānkāmavarānatha ..
bhaktyā paramayā śrīmatkṛṣṇaṃ procuḥ praharṣitāḥ .. 56 ..
15.32.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
तदाभिलषिताम्̐ल्लब्ध्वा स र्वान्कामवरानथ ..
भक्त्या परमया श्रीमत्कृष्णं प्रोचुः प्रहर्षिताः .. 56 ..
15.32.m: Prahlāda said: / Then, having obtained their coveted choices of boons, all their desires, / they, overjoyed, addressed glorious Kṛṣṇa with supreme devotion.

15.32.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
prāptaḥ kāmavaro'smābhiḥ sarvataḥ kṛpayā vibho ..
sapremā tvatpadāṃbhoje bhaktirbhavyā'napāyinī .. 57 ..
15.32.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
प्राप्तः कामवरोऽस्माभिः सर्वतः कृपया विभो ..
सप्रेमा त्वत्पदांभोजे भक्तिर्भव्याऽनपायिनी .. 57 ..
15.32.m: The gods said: / "The boon of our choice has been obtained in every way through your grace, O Lord: / [namely] that loving, auspicious, imperishable devotion may remain at your lotus feet."

15.32.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
tathaiva pūjayāmāsū rukmiṇīṃ kṛṣṇavallabhām ..
atha brahmamaheśānau sarveṣāṃ śṛṇva tāmidam .. 58 ..
15.32.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
तथैव पूजयामासू रुक्मिणीं कृष्णवल्लभाम् ..
अथ ब्रह्ममहेशानौ सर्वेषां शृण्व तामिदम् .. 58 ..
15.32.m: Prahlāda said: / Just so they worshipped Rukmiṇī, Kṛṣṇa's beloved. / Then Brahmā and Maheśāna, while all were listening to this,

15.32.s:
śraddhayā parayā yuktau dvārakāṃ pratyavocatuḥ ..
tvaṃ devi sarvatīrthānāṃ kṣetrāṇāmuttamottamā .. 59 ..
15.32.d:
श्रद्धया परया युक्तौ द्वारकां प्रत्यवोचतुः ..
त्वं देवि सर्वतीर्थानां क्षेत्राणामुत्तमोत्तमा .. 59 ..
15.32.m: filled with supreme faith, spoke to Dvārakā: / "O goddess, you are the highest of the highest among all sacred fords and sacred fields!

15.32.s:
parvatānāṃ yathā meruḥ sindhūnāṃ sāgaro yathā ..
prāṇo yathā śarīrāṇāmindriyāṇāṃ tu vai manaḥ .. 7.4.32.60 ..
15.32.d:
पर्वतानां यथा मेरुः सिन्धूनां सागरो यथा ..
प्राणो यथा शरीराणामिन्द्रियाणां तु वै मनः .. 7.4.32.60 ..
15.32.m: As Meru is among mountains, as the ocean is among rivers, / as the breath of life is among bodies, and indeed the mind among the senses,

15.32.s:
tejasvināṃ yathā vahnistattvānāṃ caittya ījyate ..
yathā graharkṣatārāṇāṃ somo vai jyotiṣāṃ dhuvam ..
eṣāṃ prakāśapuṃjānāṃ yathā sūryyaḥ prakāśate .. 61 ..
15.32.d:
तेजस्विनां यथा वह्निस्तत्त्वानां चैत्त्य ईज्यते ..
यथा ग्रहर्क्षताराणां सोमो वै ज्योतिषां धुवम् ..
एषां प्रकाशपुंजानां यथा सूर्य्यः प्रकाशते .. 61 ..
15.32.m: as fire is among luminous entities, and the intellect is revered among principles, / as Soma indeed is among planets, lunar mansions, and stars, and Dhruva among the heavenly lights, / and as the sun shines out among these masses of light,

15.32.s:
yathā naḥ sarvadevānāṃ mahāviṣṇurayaṃ mahān ..
tathaiva sarvatīrthānāṃ pūjyeyaṃ dvārakā śubhā .. 62 ..
15.32.d:
यथा नः सर्वदेवानां महाविष्णुरयं महान् ..
तथैव सर्वतीर्थानां पूज्येयं द्वारका शुभा .. 62 ..
15.32.m: as this great Mahāviṣṇu is supreme among us, all the gods, / just so is this auspicious Dvārakā worthy of worship among all sacred fords."

15.32.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
ityuktvā sarvadevānāṃ kṣetrādīnāṃ ca sattamāḥ ..
ādhipatye sureśānau dvārakāmabhiṣecatuḥ .. 63 ..
15.32.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वा सर्वदेवानां क्षेत्रादीनां च सत्तमाः ..
आधिपत्ये सुरेशानौ द्वारकामभिषेचतुः .. 63 ..
15.32.m: Prahlāda said: / Having spoken thus, O best of beings, the two lords of the gods / consecrated Dvārakā for sovereignty over all gods and sacred fields.

15.32.s:
brahmeśānau tathā devāḥ prajeśā ṛṣayo'malāḥ ..
tīrthānāṃ kṣetrarājānāṃ mahārājatvakāraṇam..64..
15.32.d:
ब्रह्मेशानौ तथा देवाः प्रजेशा ऋषयोऽमलाः ..
तीर्थानां क्षेत्रराजानां महाराजत्वकारणम्..64..
15.32.m: Brahmā and Īśāna, likewise the gods, the lords of creatures, and the pure seers, / to bring about paramount sovereignty among the sacred fords and royal sacred fields,

15.32.s:
cakrurmahābhiṣekaṃ tu dvārakāyāḥ praharṣitāḥ..
vādayanto vicitrāṇi vāditrāṇi mahotsave .. 65 ..
15.32.d:
चक्रुर्महाभिषेकं तु द्वारकायाः प्रहर्षिताः..
वादयन्तो विचित्राणि वादित्राणि महोत्सवे .. 65 ..
15.32.m: joyfully performed the great consecration of Dvārakā, / playing diverse musical instruments at that great festival

15.32.s:
divyaiḥ pañcāmṛtaistoyaiḥ sarvatīrthasamudbhavaiḥ ..
puṇyaiścākāśagaṃgāyā diggajānāṃ karoddhṛtaiḥ .. 66 ..
15.32.d:
दिव्यैः पञ्चामृतैस्तोयैः सर्वतीर्थसमुद्भवैः ..
पुण्यैश्चाकाशगंगाया दिग्गजानां करोद्धृतैः .. 66 ..
15.32.m: with divine five nectars, with waters gathered from all sacred fords, / and with the holy waters of the heavenly Gaṅgā held up in the trunks of the elephants of the quarters.

15.32.s:
atha vāsāṃsi divyāni dattvā cā''camanaṃ tathā ..
carcitāṃ candanairdivyairdivyābharaṇabhūṣitām .. 67 ..
15.32.d:
अथ वासांसि दिव्यानि दत्त्वा चा'ऽचमनं तथा ..
चर्चितां चन्दनैर्दिव्यैर्दिव्याभरणभूषिताम् .. 67 ..
15.32.m: Then, having offered divine garments and water for sipping, / [and Dvārakā being] anointed with divine sandal-pastes and adorned with divine ornaments,

15.32.s:
pūjāṃ ca cakrire puṣpaiścaṃdanādisamudbhavaiḥ ..
tadā jātā mahādivyā puruṣāḥ pārṣadā hareḥ .. 68 ..
15.32.d:
पूजां च चक्रिरे पुष्पैश्चंदनादिसमुद्भवैः ..
तदा जाता महादिव्या पुरुषाः पार्षदा हरेः .. 68 ..
15.32.m: they performed worship with flowers grown from sandalwood and other trees. / Then there appeared the exalted, divine attendants of Hari,

15.32.s:
viṣvaksenasunaṃdādyā dyotayanto diśo daśa ..
jayaśabdaṃ namaḥśabdaṃ vadaṃtaḥ puṣpavarṣiṇaḥ .. 69 ..
15.32.d:
विष्वक्सेनसुनंदाद्या द्योतयन्तो दिशो दश ..
जयशब्दं नमःशब्दं वदंतः पुष्पवर्षिणः .. 69 ..
15.32.m: Viṣvaksena, Sunanda, and others, illuminating the ten directions, / shouting "Victory!" and "Salutations!", raining flowers,

15.32.s:
gītavāditraghoṣeṇa nṛtyamānāḥ praharṣitāḥ ..
kirīṭakuṇḍalairhārairvaijayaṃtyā vibhūṣitāḥ .. 7.4.32.70 ..
15.32.d:
गीतवादित्रघोषेण नृत्यमानाः प्रहर्षिताः ..
