किरीटकुण्डलैर्हारैर्वैजयंत्या विभूषिताः .. 7.4.32.70 ..
15.32.m: dancing with delight to the sound of song and musical instruments, / adorned with diadems, earrings, necklaces, and the Vaijayantī garland,

15.32.s:
śyāmāścaturbhujāḥ pītavastramālyairvibhūṣitāḥ ..
svaprabhā dīpyamānau te dṛṣṭvā brahmamaheśvarau .. 71 ..
15.32.d:
श्यामाश्चतुर्भुजाः पीतवस्त्रमाल्यैर्विभूषिताः ..
स्वप्रभा दीप्यमानौ ते दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्ममहेश्वरौ .. 71 ..
15.32.m: dark-complexioned, four-armed, adorned with yellow garments and garlands, / blazing with their own splendour. Seeing them, Brahmā and Maheśvara,

15.32.s:
nāradaṃ sanakādīṃśca mahābhāgavatānṛṣīn ..
te'pi tānapi saṃhṛṣṭāḥ praharṣāgatasaṃbhramāḥ ..72..
15.32.d:
नारदं सनकादींश्च महाभागवतानृषीन् ..
तेऽपि तानपि संहृष्टाः प्रहर्षागतसंभ्रमाः ..72..
15.32.m: Nārada, Sanaka and the rest, and the seers who were great devotees of the Lord, / were also gladdened, and their flurry of excitement gave way to supreme joy.

15.32.s:
vavaṃdire tato 'nyo'nyaṃ hṛṣṭā āliṃganādibhiḥ ..
ṛṣayo'nye ca devāśca praṇemurviṣṇupārṣadān .. 73 ..
15.32.d:
ववंदिरे ततो ऽन्योऽन्यं हृष्टा आलिंगनादिभिः ..
ऋषयोऽन्ये च देवाश्च प्रणेमुर्विष्णुपार्षदान् .. 73 ..
15.32.m: Then they joyfully greeted one another with embraces and the like; / the seers and the other gods bowed down to Viṣṇu's attendants.

15.32.s:
atha te samupāgamya dvārakāṃ viṣṇupārṣadāḥ ..
natvā'tha dvārakānāthaṃ dvārakāṃ vai tathaiva ca .. 74 ..
15.32.d:
अथ ते समुपागम्य द्वारकां विष्णुपार्षदाः ..
नत्वाऽथ द्वारकानाथं द्वारकां वै तथैव च .. 74 ..
15.32.m: Then those attendants of Viṣṇu, approaching Dvārakā, / bowed to the Lord of Dvārakā and likewise to Dvārakā herself,

15.32.s:
saṃpūjya śraddhayā bhaktyā niḥśreyasavanodbhavaiḥ ..
kusumairvividhairdivyaistulasyā tadvanotthayā .. 75 ..
15.32.d:
संपूज्य श्रद्धया भक्त्या निःश्रेयसवनोद्भवैः ..
कुसुमैर्विविधैर्दिव्यैस्तुलस्या तद्वनोत्थया .. 75 ..
15.32.m: and having worshipped with faith and devotion with various divine flowers / born in the Niḥśreyasa forest, and with tulasī grown in that forest,

15.32.s:
tadutpannaiḥ phalairdivyairdhūpairnīrājanaiḥ prabhum ..
vividhaiścānnatāṃbūlairdattvā kṛṣṇamatoṣayan .. 76 ..
15.32.d:
तदुत्पन्नैः फलैर्दिव्यैर्धूपैर्नीराजनैः प्रभुम् ..
विविधैश्चान्नतांबूलैर्दत्त्वा कृष्णमतोषयन् .. 76 ..
15.32.m: with divine fruits produced there, with incenses and wave-offerings of light to the Lord, / presenting various foods and betel leaves, they pleased Kṛṣṇa.

15.32.s:
kṣetratīrthādirājānāṃ mahārājastvamīśvari ..
iti sarve vadantastu dvārakāṃ ca vavaṃdire .. 77 ..
15.32.d:
क्षेत्रतीर्थादिराजानां महाराजस्त्वमीश्वरि ..
इति सर्वे वदन्तस्तु द्वारकां च ववंदिरे .. 77 ..
15.32.m: "O sovereign goddess, you are the great monarch over all sacred fields and royal sacred fords!" / Saying this, all bowed to Dvārakā.

15.32.s:
etasminnaṃtare viprā devadundubhinisvanāḥ ..
aśrūyaṃta mahāśabdā abhavanpuṣpavṛṣṭayaḥ ..78..
15.32.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे विप्रा देवदुन्दुभिनिस्वनाः ..
अश्रूयंत महाशब्दा अभवन्पुष्पवृष्टयः ..78..
15.32.m: At that moment, O brahmins, the sounds of celestial drums / were heard, loud noises arose, and there were showers of flowers.

15.32.s:
athā''sīnmahadāścaryyaṃ śṛṇvantu ṛṣisattamāḥ ..
kurukṣetraṃ prayāgaṃ ca savyadakṣiṇapārśvayoḥ .. 79 ..
15.32.d:
अथा'ऽसीन्महदाश्चर्य्यं शृण्वन्तु ऋषिसत्तमाः ..
कुरुक्षेत्रं प्रयागं च सव्यदक्षिणपार्श्वयोः .. 79 ..
15.32.m: Then a great wonder occurred; hear it, O best of seers! / Kurukṣetra and Prayāga, standing on the left and right sides,

15.32.s:
sthitvā jagṛhaturddivye śvetacchatre manohare ..
dvārakāyastathā śubhre cāmaravyajane śubhe .. 7.4.32.80 ..
15.32.d:
स्थित्वा जगृहतुर्द्दिव्ये श्वेतच्छत्रे मनोहरे ..
द्वारकायस्तथा शुभ्रे चामरव्यजने शुभे .. 7.4.32.80 ..
15.32.m: held two enchanting, divine white parasols, / and two bright, auspicious chowrie fans for Dvārakā.

15.32.s:
ayodhyā mathurā māyā vārāṇasī jayasvanaiḥ ..
stuvaṃtyanyāstathānyāni sarvakṣetrāṇi sarvaśaḥ .. 81 ..
15.32.d:
अयोध्या मथुरा माया वाराणसी जयस्वनैः ..
स्तुवंत्यन्यास्तथान्यानि सर्वक्षेत्राणि सर्वशः .. 81 ..
15.32.m: Ayodhyā, Mathurā, Māyā, and Vārāṇasī, with shouts of "Victory!", / and all the other sacred fields on every side praised her.

15.32.s:
tīrthāni saritaḥ sarvā dvārakāyā mukhāṃbujam ..
paśyataḥ paramānaṃdaṃ lebhire devamānavāḥ .. 82 ..
15.32.d:
तीर्थानि सरितः सर्वा द्वारकाया मुखांबुजम् ..
पश्यतः परमानंदं लेभिरे देवमानवाः .. 82 ..
15.32.m: While all the sacred fords and rivers gazed upon the lotus-face of Dvārakā, / gods and mortals experienced supreme bliss.

15.32.s:
āhuśca pārṣadā viṣṇordhanyānyetāni sarvaśaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā tu dvārakāṃ puṇyāṃ sarvalokaikamaṇḍanām .. 83 ..
15.32.d:
आहुश्च पार्षदा विष्णोर्धन्यान्येतानि सर्वशः ..
दृष्ट्वा तु द्वारकां पुण्यां सर्वलोकैकमण्डनाम् .. 83 ..
15.32.m: And the attendants of Viṣṇu said, "These [places] are fortunate in every way, / having seen holy Dvārakā, the sole ornament of all the worlds.

15.32.s:
vedayajñatapojāpyaiḥ samyagārādhito hariḥ ..
prasīdedyasya tasya syāddvārakāgamane matiḥ .. 84 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye viṣṇupārṣadavarṇitadvārakāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 32 ..
15.32.d:
वेदयज्ञतपोजाप्यैः सम्यगाराधितो हरिः ..
प्रसीदेद्यस्य तस्य स्याद्द्वारकागमने मतिः .. 84 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये विष्णुपार्षदवर्णितद्वारकामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्वात्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 32 ..
15.32.m:
Only he with whom Hari is pleased, having been properly worshipped / with Vedas, sacrifices, austerity, and recitations, will turn his mind to going to Dvārakā."
Thus ends the thirty-second chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Dvārakā as Recounted by the Attendants of Viṣṇu,' in the fourth [sub-section], the Dvārakāmāhātmya, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

15.33.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
śrutvā brahmamaheśānau yaduktaṃ viṣṇupārṣadaiḥ ..
dvārakāyāstu māhātmyaṃ tadvarṇayitumūcatuḥ.. .. 1 ..
15.33.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
श्रुत्वा ब्रह्ममहेशानौ यदुक्तं विष्णुपार्षदैः ..
द्वारकायास्तु माहात्म्यं तद्वर्णयितुमूचतुः.. .. 1 ..
15.33.m: Glorious Prahlāda said: / Having heard what was spoken by the attendants of Viṣṇu, Brahmā and Maheśāna / spoke to describe the glory of Dvārakā.

15.33.s:
.. śrībrahmeśānāvūcatuḥ .. ..
bhobhoḥ kṣetrāṇi tīrthāni sarāṃsi sāgarādayaḥ ..
prayāgādīni tīrthāni kāśyādyā muktidāyakāḥ .. 2 ..
15.33.d:
.. श्रीब्रह्मेशानावूचतुः .. ..
भोभोः क्षेत्राणि तीर्थानि सरांसि सागरादयः ..
प्रयागादीनि तीर्थानि काश्याद्या मुक्तिदायकाः .. 2 ..
15.33.m: Glorious Brahmā and Īśāna said: / "O sacred fields, sacred fords, lakes, oceans and the rest, / sacred fords such as Prayāga, and Kāśī and others which grant liberation!

15.33.s:
bhavatāṃ tīrtharājānāṃ mahārājastviyaṃ śubhā ..
dvārakā sevanīyā vai sthīyatāṃ svecchayā bahiḥ .. 3 ..
15.33.d:
भवतां तीर्थराजानां महाराजस्त्वियं शुभा ..
द्वारका सेवनीया वै स्थीयतां स्वेच्छया बहिः .. 3 ..
15.33.m: To you, who are kings of sacred fords, this auspicious Dvārakā / is indeed the emperor! She must be served; reside outside at your pleasure!"

15.33.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
maheśavacanaṃ śrutvā sarveṣāmutsavo'bhavat ..
pradakṣiṇāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dvārakāṃ praṇipatya ca ..
āvāsaṃ cakrire tatra kṣetratīrthāni harṣataḥ .. 4 ..
15.33.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
महेशवचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वेषामुत्सवोऽभवत् ..
प्रदक्षिणां ततः कृत्वा द्वारकां प्रणिपत्य च ..
आवासं चक्रिरे तत्र क्षेत्रतीर्थानि हर्षतः .. 4 ..
15.33.m: Glorious Prahlāda said: / Hearing the words of Maheśa, there was celebration for all. / Then, having circumambulated Dvārakā and bowed down, / the sacred fields and sacred fords joyfully made their dwelling there.

15.33.s:
bhāgīrathī prayāgaṃ ca yamunā ca sarasvatī ..
sarayūgaṃḍakī puṇyā gomatī pūrvavāhinī .. 5 ..
15.33.d:
भागीरथी प्रयागं च यमुना च सरस्वती ..
सरयूगंडकी पुण्या गोमती पूर्ववाहिनी .. 5 ..
15.33.m: The Bhāgīrathī, Prayāga, Yamunā, and Sarasvatī, / the holy Sarayū and Gaṇḍakī, the eastward-flowing Gomatī,

15.33.s:
anyāśca saritaḥ sarvāḥ sindhuśoṇau nadau tathā ..
paṃcāśatkoṭibhistīrthairdigbhāge hyuttare sthitāḥ ..
laṃpaṭāḥ kṛṣṇasevāyāṃ paśyato dvārakāṃ muhuḥ .. 6 ..
15.33.d:
अन्याश्च सरितः सर्वाः सिन्धुशोणौ नदौ तथा ..
पंचाशत्कोटिभिस्तीर्थैर्दिग्भागे ह्युत्तरे स्थिताः ..
लंपटाः कृष्णसेवायां पश्यतो द्वारकां मुहुः .. 6 ..
15.33.m: and all the other rivers, as well as the two rivers Sindhu and Śoṇa, / situated in the northern direction together with five hundred million sacred fords, / eager for the service of Kṛṣṇa, constantly beholding Dvārakā.

15.33.s:
mandākinī tathā puṇyā nadī bhāgīrathī ca yā ..
mahānadī narmadā ca śiprā prācī sarasvatī .. 7 ..
15.33.d:
मन्दाकिनी तथा पुण्या नदी भागीरथी च या ..
महानदी नर्मदा च शिप्रा प्राची सरस्वती .. 7 ..
15.33.m: The Mandākinī, as well as the holy river which is the Bhāgīrathī, / the Mahānadī, Narmadā, Śiprā, and the eastern Sarasvatī,

15.33.s:
cakṣurbhadrā tathā sītā nadyo'nyāḥ pāpanāśinī ..
vartaṃte pūrvadigbhāge tīrthaiśca ṣaṣṭikoṭibhiḥ .. 8 ..
15.33.d:
चक्षुर्भद्रा तथा सीता नद्योऽन्याः पापनाशिनी ..
वर्तंते पूर्वदिग्भागे तीर्थैश्च षष्टिकोटिभिः .. 8 ..
15.33.m: the Cakṣu, Bhadrā, and Sītā, and other sin-destroying rivers, / reside in the eastern quarter together with six hundred million sacred fords.

15.33.s:
payoṣṇī tapatī puṇyā vidarbhā ca payasvinī ..
godāvarī mahāpuṇyā bhīmā kṛṣṇānadī tathā .. 9 ..
15.33.d:
पयोष्णी तपती पुण्या विदर्भा च पयस्विनी ..
गोदावरी महापुण्या भीमा कृष्णानदी तथा .. 9 ..
15.33.m: The Payoṣṇī, the holy Tapatī, the Vidarbhā, and the Payasvinī, / the most holy Godāvarī, the Bhīmā, and the Kṛṣṇā river,

15.33.s:
kāverīpramukhāḥ puṇyā anyaiścaivāghanāśinīḥ ..
svatīrthasahitā bhaktyā navanavatikoṭibhiḥ .. 7.4.33.10 ..
sthitā dakṣiṇadigbhāge dvārakāsevanotsukāḥ ..
krīḍaṃti gomatīnīre tīre ca kṛṣṇasannidhau ..1 1..
15.33.d:
कावेरीप्रमुखाः पुण्या अन्यैश्चैवाघनाशिनीः ..
स्वतीर्थसहिता भक्त्या नवनवतिकोटिभिः .. 7.4.33.10 ..
स्थिता दक्षिणदिग्भागे द्वारकासेवनोत्सुकाः ..
क्रीडंति गोमतीनीरे तीरे च कृष्णसन्निधौ ..1 1..
15.33.m:
headed by the Kāverī, holy and destroying sins with others, / accompanied by their own sacred fords, nine hundred and ninety million [in number], with devotion,
reside in the southern quarter, eager to serve Dvārakā; / they sport in the water of the Gomatī and on its bank in the presence of Kṛṣṇa.

15.33.s:
saptadvīpeṣu yāḥ saṃti tathā'nyā vai saridvarāḥ ..
sāgarāśca tathā sapta paścimāyāṃ diśi sthitāḥ ..12..
15.33.d:
सप्तद्वीपेषु याः संति तथाऽन्या वै सरिद्वराः ..
सागराश्च तथा सप्त पश्चिमायां दिशि स्थिताः ..12..
15.33.m: Those other excellent rivers that exist across the seven continents, / and likewise the seven oceans, reside in the western direction.

15.33.s:
krīḍaṃti cakratīrthe vai tīrthaiśca śatakoṭibhiḥ..
paśyaṃti ca muhuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ paścimābhimukhaṃ sadā .. 13 ..
15.33.d:
क्रीडंति चक्रतीर्थे वै तीर्थैश्च शतकोटिभिः..
पश्यंति च मुहुः कृष्णं पश्चिमाभिमुखं सदा .. 13 ..
15.33.m: They sport at Cakratīrtha along with one billion sacred fords, / and constantly behold Kṛṣṇa, who faces the west.

15.33.s:
vidiśāsu ca sarvāsu tīrthasaṃkhyā na vidyate ..
puṣkarādīni tīrthāni viśālā virajā gayā .. 14 ..
15.33.d:
विदिशासु च सर्वासु तीर्थसंख्या न विद्यते ..
पुष्करादीनि तीर्थानि विशाला विरजा गया .. 14 ..
15.33.m: And in all the intermediate directions, the count of sacred fords is beyond reckoning. / Sacred fords such as Puṣkara, Viśālā, Virajā, and Gayā,

15.33.s:
śataikakoṭibhistīrthairgomatyudadhisaṃgame ..
varttaṃte kṛṣṇasevāyāṃ sotsavāni dvijottamāḥ .. 15 ..
15.33.d:
शतैककोटिभिस्तीर्थैर्गोमत्युदधिसंगमे ..
वर्त्तंते कृष्णसेवायां सोत्सवानि द्विजोत्तमाः .. 15 ..
15.33.m: along with one billion one hundred million sacred fords, at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, / reside in the service of Kṛṣṇa, full of festivity, O best of brahmins.

15.33.s:
vārāṇasī pūraiśānyāmavantī pūrvadiksthitā ..
āgneyyāṃ diśi kāṃtī ca dakṣiṇe mathurā sthitā .. 16 ..
15.33.d:
वाराणसी पूरैशान्यामवन्ती पूर्वदिक्स्थिता ..
आग्नेय्यां दिशि कांती च दक्षिणे मथुरा स्थिता .. 16 ..
15.33.m: The city of Vārāṇasī is situated in the north-east; Avantī is in the east; / Kāñcī is in the south-east quarter; and Mathurā is situated in the south.

15.33.s:
nairṛtyāṃ ca tathā māyā ayodhyā paścime sthitāḥ..
vāyavyāṃ tu kurukṣetraṃ harikṣetraṃ tathottare .. 17 ..
15.33.d:
नैरृत्यां च तथा माया अयोध्या पश्चिमे स्थिताः..
वायव्यां तु कुरुक्षेत्रं हरिक्षेत्रं तथोत्तरे .. 17 ..
15.33.m: Māyā is in the south-west, and Ayodhyā is situated in the west; / Kurukṣetra is in the north-west, and the sacred field of Hari is in the north.

15.33.s:
śivakṣetraṃ ca aiśānyāmaiṃdryāṃ ca puruṣottamaḥ ..
āgneyyāṃ ca bhṛgukṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ dakṣiṇāśritam..18..
15.33.d:
शिवक्षेत्रं च ऐशान्यामैंद्र्यां च पुरुषोत्तमः ..
आग्नेय्यां च भृगुक्षेत्रं प्रभासं दक्षिणाश्रितम्..18..
15.33.m: The sacred field of Śiva is in the north-east, and Puruṣottama is in the east; / Bhṛgukṣetra is in the south-east, and Prabhāsa rests in the south.

15.33.s:
śrīraṃgaṃ nairṛte bhāge lohadaṃḍaṃ tu paścime ..
nārasiṃhāni vāyavye kokāmukhyaṃ tathottare .. 19 ..
15.33.d:
श्रीरंगं नैरृते भागे लोहदंडं तु पश्चिमे ..
नारसिंहानि वायव्ये कोकामुख्यं तथोत्तरे .. 19 ..
15.33.m: Śrīraṅga is in the south-western part, and Lohadaṇḍa is in the west; / the shrines of Narasiṃha are in the north-west, and Kokāmukha is in the north.

15.33.s:
kāmākhyā reṇukādīni śākteyāni ca sarvaśaḥ ..
kṣetrarājāni sarvāṇi yathāsthāne vasaṃti hi .. 7.4.33.20 ..
15.33.d:
कामाख्या रेणुकादीनि शाक्तेयानि च सर्वशः ..
क्षेत्रराजानि सर्वाणि यथास्थाने वसंति हि .. 7.4.33.20 ..
15.33.m: Kāmākhyā, Reṇukā, and other Śākta shrines on all sides— / all the kings of sacred fields indeed reside each in their appropriate place.

15.33.s:
uttare caiva saurāṇi gāṇapatyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
kṣetrāṇyuttarataḥ saṃti rukmiṇyāḥ sannidhau dvijāḥ .. 21 ..
15.33.d:
उत्तरे चैव सौराणि गाणपत्यानि कृत्स्नशः ..
क्षेत्राण्युत्तरतः संति रुक्मिण्याः सन्निधौ द्विजाः .. 21 ..
15.33.m: And in the north are all the solar and Gāṇapatya shrines; / sacred fields are in the north in the presence of Rukmiṇī, O brahmins.

15.33.s:
dhenukaṃ naimiṣāraṇyaṃ daṃḍakaṃ saiṃdhavaṃ tathā ..
daśāraṇyamarbudaṃ ca naranārāyaṇāśramam .. 22 ..
15.33.d:
धेनुकं नैमिषारण्यं दंडकं सैंधवं तथा ..
दशारण्यमर्बुदं च नरनारायणाश्रमम् .. 22 ..
15.33.m: Dhenuka, Naimiṣāraṇya, Daṇḍaka, Saindhava, / Daśāraṇya, Arbuda, and the hermitage of Nara and Nārāyaṇa,

15.33.s:
yathādiśaṃ vasaṃti sma dvārakāyāḥ samantataḥ ..
mervādyāḥ parvatāḥ saumye dvārakāsevanotsukāḥ .. 23 ..
15.33.d:
यथादिशं वसंति स्म द्वारकायाः समन्ततः ..
मेर्वाद्याः पर्वताः सौम्ये द्वारकासेवनोत्सुकाः .. 23 ..
15.33.m: dwelt all around Dvārakā, according to their respective directions. / Mountains headed by Meru, eager to serve Dvārakā, [dwelt] in the north;

15.33.s:
kailāsādyāśca aiśānyāmaindryāṃ himavadādayaḥ ..
śrīśailādyāśca āgneyyāṃ siṃhādryādyā yame tathā .. 24 ..
15.33.d:
कैलासाद्याश्च ऐशान्यामैन्द्र्यां हिमवदादयः ..
श्रीशैलाद्याश्च आग्नेय्यां सिंहाद्र्याद्या यमे तथा .. 24 ..
15.33.m: mountains headed by Kailāsa in the north-east; mountains headed by the Himavat in the east; / mountains headed by Śrīśaila in the south-east; and likewise mountains headed by Siṃhādri in the south;

15.33.s:
nairṛtyāṃ vāmamārgādyā mahendraṛṣabhādayaḥ ..
anye ca puṇyaśailāśca salokāloka mānasāḥ ..
dvārakāṃ paritaḥ saṃti paryyupāsaṃti pratyaham .. 25 ..
15.33.d:
नैरृत्यां वाममार्गाद्या महेन्द्रऋषभादयः ..
अन्ये च पुण्यशैलाश्च सलोकालोक मानसाः ..
द्वारकां परितः संति पर्य्युपासंति प्रत्यहम् .. 25 ..
15.33.m: mountains headed by Vāmamārga, Mahendra, Ṛṣabha, and others in the south-west; / and other holy mountains along with Lokāloka and Mānasa / surround Dvārakā and attend upon it every day.

15.33.s:
evaṃ brahmādayo devā ṛṣayaḥ sanakādayaḥ ..
kṣetratīrthādibhiryuktā anyaiḥ puṇyatamaistathā .. 26 ..
15.33.d:
एवं ब्रह्मादयो देवा ऋषयः सनकादयः ..
क्षेत्रतीर्थादिभिर्युक्ता अन्यैः पुण्यतमैस्तथा .. 26 ..
15.33.m: Thus the gods headed by Brahmā, the seers headed by Sanaka, / accompanied by sacred fields, sacred fords, and other most sacred places,

15.33.s:
śraddhayā parayā bhaktyā kanyārāśisthite gurau ..
āyāṃti dvārakāṃ draṣṭuṃ brāhmyādyāśca praharṣitāḥ.. 27 ..
15.33.d:
श्रद्धया परया भक्त्या कन्याराशिस्थिते गुरौ ..
आयांति द्वारकां द्रष्टुं ब्राह्म्याद्याश्च प्रहर्षिताः.. 27 ..
15.33.m: come with supreme faith and devotion when Jupiter enters the sign of Virgo, / along with the [mothers] headed by Brāhmī, exceedingly joyful, to see Dvārakā.

15.33.s: iti śrīskānde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyā saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakāmāhātmyavarṇanapūvakaṃ dvārakāyāṃ sarvatīrthakṣetrādikṛtanivāsa varṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 33..
15.33.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महा पुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहिताया सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये द्वारकामाहात्म्यवर्णनपूवकं द्वारकायां सर्वतीर्थक्षेत्रादिकृतनिवास वर्णनंनाम त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 33..
15.33.m: Thus ends the thirty-third chapter, entitled 'Description of the Dwelling Made by All Sacred Fords and Fields in Dvārakā, Preceded by the Description of the Glory of Dvārakā,' in the fourth [sub-section], the Dvārakāmāhātmya, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

15.34.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
evamadbhutamāhātmyaṃ dvārakāyāṃ munīśvarāḥ ..
sarveṣāṃ kṣetratīrthānāṃ mahāpāpavidārakm..1..
15.34.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
एवमद्भुतमाहात्म्यं द्वारकायां मुनीश्वराः ..
सर्वेषां क्षेत्रतीर्थानां महापापविदारक्म्..1..
15.34.m: Glorious Prahlāda said: / Such is the wondrous glory of Dvārakā, O best of sages, / encompassing all sacred fields and sacred fords, destroying great sins.

15.34.s:
varṇānāmaśramāṇāṃ ca patitānāṃ viśeṣataḥ.
mahāpāpaharaṃ proktaṃ mahāpuṇyavivarddhanaṃ..2..
15.34.d:
वर्णानामश्रमाणां च पतितानां विशेषतः.
महापापहरं प्रोक्तं महापुण्यविवर्द्धनं..2..
15.34.m: It is declared to remove the great sins of the castes and life-stages, / especially of the fallen, and to multiply great merit.

15.34.s:
atyugrapāparāśīnāṃ dāhasthānaṃ yathā smṛtam ..
dvārakāgamanaṃ viprāḥ kiṃ punardvārakāsthitiḥ .. 3 ..
15.34.d:
अत्युग्रपापराशीनां दाहस्थानं यथा स्मृतम् ..
द्वारकागमनं विप्राः किं पुनर्द्वारकास्थितिः .. 3 ..
15.34.m: Just as it is remembered as the burning ground for heaps of most terrible sins, / [even] going to Dvārakā, O brahmins, what then to say of dwelling in Dvārakā?

15.34.s:
viśeṣeṇa tu viprendrāḥ kanyārāśisthite gurau ..
brahmādayopi dṛśyaṃte yatra tīrthaiśca saṃyutāḥ .. 4 ..
15.34.d:
विशेषेण तु विप्रेन्द्राः कन्याराशिस्थिते गुरौ ..
ब्रह्मादयोपि दृश्यंते यत्र तीर्थैश्च संयुताः .. 4 ..
15.34.m: Particularly, O foremost of brahmins, when Jupiter is in the sign of Virgo, / even Brahmā and the others are seen there accompanied by the sacred fords.

15.34.s:
prativarṣaṃ prakurvaṃti dvārakāgamanaṃ narāḥ ..
teṣāṃ pādarajaḥ spṛṣṭvā divaṃ yāṃti ca pāpinaḥ .. 5..
15.34.d:
प्रतिवर्षं प्रकुर्वंति द्वारकागमनं नराः ..
तेषां पादरजः स्पृष्ट्वा दिवं यांति च पापिनः .. 5..
15.34.m: Men who make the journey to Dvārakā year after year— / even sinners, having touched the dust of their feet, go to heaven.

15.34.s:
gomatī nīrapūtānāṃ kṛṣṇavaktrāvalokinām ..
darśanātpātakaṃ teṣāṃ yāti janmaśatārjitam .. 6 ..
15.34.d:
गोमती नीरपूतानां कृष्णवक्त्रावलोकिनाम् ..
दर्शनात्पातकं तेषां याति जन्मशतार्जितम् .. 6 ..
15.34.m: From the sight of those who are purified by the water of the Gomatī / and gaze upon the face of Kṛṣṇa, their sin acquired over a hundred lifetimes departs.

15.34.s:
itihāsena pūrvoktaṃ śrūyatāṃ munipuṅgavāḥ ..
dilīpavasiṣṭha saṃvāde paramāścaryyavarddhanam .. 7 ..
15.34.d:
इतिहासेन पूर्वोक्तं श्रूयतां मुनिपुङ्गवाः ..
दिलीपवसिष्ठ संवादे परमाश्चर्य्यवर्द्धनम् .. 7 ..
15.34.m: Let that which was told previously through ancient history be heard, O eminent sages, / in the dialogue between Dilīpa and Vasiṣṭha, which enhances supreme wonder.

15.34.s:
kāśyāṃ tu vajralepo hi kṣetra ekatra naśyati ..
yāturdarśanataḥ śrutvā dilīpo vākyamabravīt .. 8 ..
15.34.d:
काश्यां तु वज्रलेपो हि क्षेत्र एकत्र नश्यति ..
यातुर्दर्शनतः श्रुत्वा दिलीपो वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 8 ..
15.34.m: Having heard that an indelible sin [contracted] in Kāśī is destroyed in that single sacred field / merely from the sight of one who goes there, Dilīpa spoke these words.

15.34.s:
.. dilīpa uvāca .. ..
vajralepaśca kāśyāṃ tu ghoro yatra vinaśyati ..
kṛtsnaśo'tha mahāpuṇyaṃ prāpyaṃ yatra tadasti kim .. 9 ..
15.34.d:
.. दिलीप उवाच .. ..
वज्रलेपश्च काश्यां तु घोरो यत्र विनश्यति ..
कृत्स्नशोऽथ महापुण्यं प्राप्यं यत्र तदस्ति किम् .. 9 ..
15.34.m: Dilīpa said: / "Where is that place in which an indelible, dreadful sin [contracted] in Kāśī / is completely destroyed, and where great merit is to be obtained?"

15.34.s:
na prarohaṃti pāpāni yasminkṣetre dvijottama ..
tatkṣetraṃ kathyatāṃ puṇyaṃ yatra pāpaṃ praṇaśyati ..7.4.34.10..
15.34.d:
न प्ररोहंति पापानि यस्मिन्क्षेत्रे द्विजोत्तम ..
तत्क्षेत्रं कथ्यतां पुण्यं यत्र पापं प्रणश्यति ..7.4.34.10..
15.34.m: In which sacred field sins do not sprout, O best of brahmins? / Let that holy sacred field be told, where sin is destroyed.

15.34.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
āsītkāśyāṃ purā kaścittridaṇḍī mokṣadharmavit ..
japandaśāśvemedhe tu gāyatrīṃ ca samāhitaḥ.. 11 ..
15.34.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
आसीत्काश्यां पुरा कश्चित्त्रिदण्डी मोक्षधर्मवित् ..
जपन्दशाश्वेमेधे तु गायत्रीं च समाहितः.. 11 ..
15.34.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / Formerly in Kāśī there was a certain triple-staff ascetic who knew the duty leading to liberation, / who, fully concentrated, recited the Gāyatrī at Daśāśvamedha.

15.34.s:
tatra kācitsamāyātā yuvatī gajagāminī ..
tīre saṃsthāpya vāsāṃsi gaṃgāyāḥ śramaśāntaye ..
praviṣṭā ca jale nagnā jalakrīḍāṃ cakāra ha .. 12 ..
15.34.d:
तत्र काचित्समायाता युवती गजगामिनी ..
तीरे संस्थाप्य वासांसि गंगायाः श्रमशान्तये ..
प्रविष्टा च जले नग्ना जलक्रीडां चकार ह .. 12 ..
15.34.m: There a certain young woman with the gait of an elephant arrived; / leaving her clothes on the bank of the Gaṅgā to dispel her weariness, / she entered the water naked and engaged in water-sports.

15.34.s:
nagnāṃ tāṃ krīḍatīṃ vīkṣya yatirmadanapūritaḥ ..
daivāgnibhraṃśito mārgātsahasā ca vimohitaḥ .. 13 ..
15.34.d:
नग्नां तां क्रीडतीं वीक्ष्य यतिर्मदनपूरितः ..
दैवाग्निभ्रंशितो मार्गात्सहसा च विमोहितः .. 13 ..
15.34.m: Seeing her playing naked, the ascetic was filled with passion; / knocked off his path by fate, he was suddenly infatuated.

15.34.s:
manasā kāmayāmāsa sā'pi taṃ taruṇaṃ yatim ..
tayośca saṃgatistatra saṃjātā pāpakarmaṇoḥ .. 14 ..
15.34.d:
मनसा कामयामास साऽपि तं तरुणं यतिम् ..
तयोश्च संगतिस्तत्र संजाता पापकर्मणोः .. 14 ..
15.34.m: She too desired the youthful ascetic in her heart, / and there union took place between the two evildoers.

15.34.s:
tayā vimohitaḥ sadyastāmevānusasāra saḥ ..
tatprītyai cārjayāmāsa dhanamanyāyatastadā .. 15 ..
15.34.d:
तया विमोहितः सद्यस्तामेवानुससार सः ..
तत्प्रीत्यै चार्जयामास धनमन्यायतस्तदा .. 15 ..
15.34.m: Instantly deluded by her, he followed only her, / and to please her, he then acquired wealth through unjust means.

15.34.s:
vārāṇasyāṃ hi na tyaktaścaṃḍālasya pratigrahaḥ ..
snānahīnaḥ sadā pāpī rātrau cauryyeṇa varttate ..16..
15.34.d:
वाराणस्यां हि न त्यक्तश्चंडालस्य प्रतिग्रहः ..
स्नानहीनः सदा पापी रात्रौ चौर्य्येण वर्त्तते ..16..
15.34.m: In Vārāṇasī he did not even refuse gifts from an outcaste; / deprived of ritual ablution, ever sinful, he lived by theft at night.

15.34.s:
kasmiṃścitsamaye pāpī māṃsārthī tu vanaṃ gataḥ ..
dadarśa pramadāṃ tatra mātaṃgīṃ madirekṣaṇām .. 17 ..
15.34.d:
कस्मिंश्चित्समये पापी मांसार्थी तु वनं गतः ..
ददर्श प्रमदां तत्र मातंगीं मदिरेक्षणाम् .. 17 ..
15.34.m: At a certain time the sinner, desiring meat, went to the forest; / there he saw an intoxicatingly beautiful, inebriate-eyed outcaste woman.

15.34.s:
tasyāḥ prathamatāruṇyaṃ dṛṣṭvā garveṇa pāpmanā ..
vane'tha nirjane tatra mātaṃgīsaṃgameyivān .. 18 ..
15.34.d:
तस्याः प्रथमतारुण्यं दृष्ट्वा गर्वेण पाप्मना ..
वनेऽथ निर्जने तत्र मातंगीसंगमेयिवान् .. 18 ..
15.34.m: Seeing her prime of youth, through sinful conceit, / he then had intercourse with the outcaste woman there in the deserted forest.

15.34.s:
tayā sahānnapānādi kṛtavānpāpamohitaḥ ..
aśnāti surayā paṃkaṃ gomāṃsaṃ pāpalaṃpaṭaḥ .. 19 ..
15.34.d:
तया सहान्नपानादि कृतवान्पापमोहितः ..
अश्नाति सुरया पंकं गोमांसं पापलंपटः .. 19 ..
15.34.m: Deluded by sin, he shared food and drink with her; / devoted to vice, he consumed wine, dregs, and beef.

15.34.s:
tadgṛhe nidhanaṃ prāptaḥ pāpātmā sarvabhakṣakaḥ ..
vārāṇasīprabhāvena na prāpto narakaṃ tadā .. 7.4.34.20 ..
15.34.d:
तद्गृहे निधनं प्राप्तः पापात्मा सर्वभक्षकः ..
वाराणसीप्रभावेन न प्राप्तो नरकं तदा .. 7.4.34.20 ..
15.34.m: The sinful-minded omnivore met his death in her house; / by the power of Vārāṇasī he did not go to hell then.

15.34.s:
kiṃ tu tatra kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vajralepaṃ sudāruṇam ..
śūdrīsaṃparka pāpena jāto'sau krūrayoniṣu .. 21 ..
15.34.d:
किं तु तत्र कृतं पापं वज्रलेपं सुदारुणम् ..
शूद्रीसंपर्क पापेन जातोऽसौ क्रूरयोनिषु .. 21 ..
15.34.m: Yet the sin committed there had become an inescapable, severe bond; / by the sin of contact with a Śūdra woman he was born in cruel wombs.

15.34.s:
vṛko vyāghroragaḥ śvānaḥ śṛgālaḥ sūkaro'bhavat ..
duraṃtāṃ yātanāṃ prāptaḥ śamaleśaṃ na vindati .. 22 ..
15.34.d:
वृको व्याघ्रोरगः श्वानः शृगालः सूकरोऽभवत् ..
दुरंतां यातनां प्राप्तः शमलेशं न विन्दति .. 22 ..
15.34.m: He became a wolf, a tiger, a snake, a dog, a jackal, and a boar; / subjected to endless torment, he found not even a bit of peace.

15.34.s:
evaṃ janmasahasraistu na tasya pāpakarmaṇaḥ ..
mātaṃgyā saṃgajaṃ pāpaṃ vyanaśyata yugāyutaiḥ .. 23 .
15.34.d:
एवं जन्मसहस्रैस्तु न तस्य पापकर्मणः ..
मातंग्या संगजं पापं व्यनश्यत युगायुतैः .. 23 .
15.34.m: Thus, through thousands of births and myriads of yugas, the sin / born of union with the outcaste woman was not destroyed for that evildoer.

15.34.s:
tato'sau saptame jātaḥ śaśakaścaiva janmani ..
tato'sau rākṣaso jātaḥ pāpātmā sarvabhakṣakaḥ .. 24 ..
15.34.d:
ततोऽसौ सप्तमे जातः शशकश्चैव जन्मनि ..
ततोऽसौ राक्षसो जातः पापात्मा सर्वभक्षकः .. 24 ..
15.34.m: Then, in the seventh birth, he became a hare; / after that he was born a rākṣasa, a sinful-minded omnivore.

15.34.s:
prāṇino bhakṣayansarvānsaṃprāpto viṃdhyaparvate ..
asmādanantaraṃ bhāvyaṃ kṛkalāsatvamadbhutam.. .. 25 ..
15.34.d:
प्राणिनो भक्षयन्सर्वान्संप्राप्तो विंध्यपर्वते ..
अस्मादनन्तरं भाव्यं कृकलासत्वमद्भुतम्.. .. 25 ..
15.34.m: Devouring all living beings, he reached the Vindhya mountain; / after this he was destined to an extraordinary existence as a chameleon.

15.34.s:
śūdrīsaṃgajapāpena bhāvyaṃ ca kṛmiyoninā ..
mātaṃgīsaṃgame proktaṃ phalaṃ hyatijugupsitam .. 26 ..
15.34.d:
शूद्रीसंगजपापेन भाव्यं च कृमियोनिना ..
मातंगीसंगमे प्रोक्तं फलं ह्यतिजुगुप्सितम् .. 26 ..
15.34.m: By the sin born of union with a Śūdra woman he was also destined to the womb of a worm; / for union with an outcaste woman, an utterly repulsive fruit has been declared.

15.34.s:
yugāyutaṃ sahasraistu bhokṣyamāṇaṃ sudāruṇam ..
atyāścaryyamabhūttatra dilīpa śrūyatāṃ mahat .. 27 ..
15.34.d:
युगायुतं सहस्रैस्तु भोक्ष्यमाणं सुदारुणम् ..
अत्याश्चर्य्यमभूत्तत्र दिलीप श्रूयतां महत् .. 27 ..
15.34.m: A terrible [fruit] that was to be experienced for tens of thousands of yugas; / [yet] a great wonder took place there, O Dilīpa; listen to it!

15.34.s:
ālokitaṃ ca viṃdhyādrau sarveṣāṃ vismayāspadam ..
dṛṣṭvā dvārāvatīṃ kaścitkṛṣṇavaktraṃ suśobhanam .. 28 ..
15.34.d:
आलोकितं च विंध्याद्रौ सर्वेषां विस्मयास्पदम् ..
दृष्ट्वा द्वारावतीं कश्चित्कृष्णवक्त्रं सुशोभनम् .. 28 ..
15.34.m: On the Vindhya mountain something was seen that was an object of wonder to all; / someone, having seen Dvārāvatī and the exceedingly beautiful face of Kṛṣṇa,

15.34.s:
gomatīnīrapūtastu viṃdhyaṃ prāptaḥ sa pāṃthikaḥ ..
mātrāṃ kṛṣṇaprasādasya skandhe kṛtvā praharṣitaḥ .. 29 ..
15.34.d:
गोमतीनीरपूतस्तु विंध्यं प्राप्तः स पांथिकः ..
मात्रां कृष्णप्रसादस्य स्कन्धे कृत्वा प्रहर्षितः .. 29 ..
15.34.m: purified by the waters of the Gomatī, reached the Vindhya, a traveler / placing a portion of Kṛṣṇa's prasāda on his shoulder, overjoyed.

15.34.s:
prayāsyansvagṛhaṃ tatra dadarśa pathi rākṣasam ..
drutaṃ ca krūrakarmāṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhakṣitumāgatam .. 7.4.34.30 ..
15.34.d:
प्रयास्यन्स्वगृहं तत्र ददर्श पथि राक्षसम् ..
द्रुतं च क्रूरकर्माणं दृष्ट्वा भक्षितुमागतम् .. 7.4.34.30 ..
15.34.m: About to proceed to his own home, he saw on the path a rākṣasa; / and quickly the performer of cruel deeds, having seen him, came to devour him.

15.34.s:
tasya darśanamātreṇa vajralepaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ..
vārāṇasīsamudbhūto bhasmasādabhavatkṣaṇāt .. 31 ..
15.34.d:
तस्य दर्शनमात्रेण वज्रलेपः सुदारुणः ..
वाराणसीसमुद्भूतो भस्मसादभवत्क्षणात् .. 31 ..
15.34.m: By the mere sight of him, the dreadful, inescapable bond [of sin] / originated in Vārāṇasī turned into ash in an instant.

15.34.s:
janmakoṭiśatenāpi yo na śakyo vyapohitum ..
tatpāpaparvatānmuktaḥ kṛṣṇapāṃthikadarśanāt .. 32 ..
15.34.d:
जन्मकोटिशतेनापि यो न शक्यो व्यपोहितुम् ..
तत्पापपर्वतान्मुक्तः कृष्णपांथिकदर्शनात् .. 32 ..
15.34.m: That which could not be dispelled even by hundreds of millions of births— / he was freed from that mountain of sin by the sight of Kṛṣṇa's traveler.

15.34.s:
dagdhe'tha krūrabhāve tu ghanamukto yathā śaśī ..
reje puṇyaprakāśena kṛṣṇapāṃthikadarśanāt .. 33 ..
15.34.d:
दग्धेऽथ क्रूरभावे तु घनमुक्तो यथा शशी ..
रेजे पुण्यप्रकाशेन कृष्णपांथिकदर्शनात् .. 33 ..
15.34.m: When his cruel nature was burned away, like the moon freed from clouds, / he shone with the light of merit through the sight of Kṛṣṇa's traveler.

15.34.s:
tato'bhimukhamabhyetya dvārakāpathikaṃ mudā ..
nanāma śraddhayā bhūmau taddarśanamahotsavaḥ .. 34 ..
15.34.d:
ततोऽभिमुखमभ्येत्य द्वारकापथिकं मुदा ..
ननाम श्रद्धया भूमौ तद्दर्शनमहोत्सवः .. 34 ..
15.34.m: Then, approaching the traveler to Dvārakā with joy, / he bowed down to the ground with faith, celebrating the sight of him as a great festival.

15.34.s:
natvā'tha vismitaḥ prāha aho'dya tava darśanāt ..
gato ghoratamo bhāvaḥ prāptā saṃsiddhiruttamā .. 35 ..
15.34.d:
नत्वाऽथ विस्मितः प्राह अहोऽद्य तव दर्शनात् ..
गतो घोरतमो भावः प्राप्ता संसिद्धिरुत्तमा .. 35 ..
15.34.m: Having bowed, amazed, he said: “Ah, today through your darśana / my most dreadful nature has departed, and supreme success is attained!

15.34.s:
kasmāttvamāgato bhadra prabhāvaḥ kīdṛśastava ..
vajralepastu kāśyāṃ vai dagdhaste darśanādanu .. 36 ..
15.34.d:
कस्मात्त्वमागतो भद्र प्रभावः कीदृशस्तव ..
वज्रलेपस्तु काश्यां वै दग्धस्ते दर्शनादनु .. 36 ..
15.34.m: Whence have you come, good sir? What kind of power is yours? / For following your darśana, the inescapable bond [of sin] from Kāśī has been burned away!”

15.34.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
ityevaṃ rākṣasenoktaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇasya pāṃthikaḥ ..
vismayaṃ paramāpannaḥ prāha taṃ harṣamānasaḥ .. 37 ..
15.34.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
इत्येवं राक्षसेनोक्तं श्रुत्वा कृष्णस्य पांथिकः ..
विस्मयं परमापन्नः प्राह तं हर्षमानसः .. 37 ..
15.34.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / Hearing what was spoken in this way by the rākṣasa, Kṛṣṇa's traveler, / filled with supreme wonder, said to him with a delighted mind:

15.34.s:
.. pāṃthika uvāca .. ...
śrīmaddvāravatīṃ dṛṣṭvā hyāgato'smyatra rākṣasa ..
vajralepaharo'smākaṃ prabhāvaḥ kṛṣṇadarśanāt.. 38 ..
15.34.d:
.. पांथिक उवाच .. ...
श्रीमद्द्वारवतीं दृष्ट्वा ह्यागतोऽस्म्यत्र राक्षस ..
वज्रलेपहरोऽस्माकं प्रभावः कृष्णदर्शनात्.. 38 ..
15.34.m: The traveler said: / “Having seen glorious Dvāravatī, I have indeed come here, O rākṣasa; / my power that destroys the inescapable bond [of sin] comes from the darśana of Kṛṣṇa.

15.34.s:
gomatyāṃ yaḥ sakṛtsnātvā paśyetkṛṣṇamukhāṃbujam ...
sarvānuddharate pāpādapi trailākyadāhakāt .. 39 ..
15.34.d:
गोमत्यां यः सकृत्स्नात्वा पश्येत्कृष्णमुखांबुजम् ...
सर्वानुद्धरते पापादपि त्रैलाक्यदाहकात् .. 39 ..
15.34.m: Whoever, having bathed once in the Gomatī, beholds Kṛṣṇa's lotus-face, / delivers everyone even from sin that could burn the three worlds.”

15.34.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
ityukto rākṣaso hṛṣṭaḥ śuddhātmā bhaktisaṃyutaḥ ..
natvā pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā saṃprāpto dvārakāṃ tadā .. 7.4.34.40 ..
15.34.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्तो राक्षसो हृष्टः शुद्धात्मा भक्तिसंयुतः ..
नत्वा प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा संप्राप्तो द्वारकां तदा .. 7.4.34.40 ..
15.34.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / Addressed thus, the rākṣasa, delighted, purified in soul, and endowed with devotion, / bowed, circumambulated him, and then reached Dvārakā.

15.34.s:
gomatyāṃ sa tanuṃ tyaktvā prāpto'sau vaiṣṇavaṃ padam ..
stūyamānaḥ sureśānairgadharvaiḥ puṣpavṛṣṭibhiḥ .. 41 ..
15.34.d:
गोमत्यां स तनुं त्यक्त्वा प्राप्तोऽसौ वैष्णवं पदम् ..
स्तूयमानः सुरेशानैर्गधर्वैः पुष्पवृष्टिभिः .. 41 ..
15.34.m: Leaving his body in the Gomatī, he attained the realm of Viṣṇu, / praised by the lords of the gods and the gandharvas with showers of flowers.

15.34.s:
itthaṃ mahāprabhāvo hi dvārakāyāḥ prakīrttitaḥ ..
na prarohaṃti pāpāni yasyāḥ pāṃthikadarśanāt ..
dvārakāyāṃ tu kiṃ vācyaṃ na prarohaṃti pātakam .. 42 ..
15.34.d:
इत्थं महाप्रभावो हि द्वारकायाः प्रकीर्त्तितः ..
न प्ररोहंति पापानि यस्याः पांथिकदर्शनात् ..
द्वारकायां तु किं वाच्यं न प्ररोहंति पातकम् .. 42 ..
15.34.m: Thus the great majesty of Dvārakā has indeed been proclaimed, / by the sight of whose traveler sins do not sprout; / what need be said of Dvārakā itself, where wickedness does not sprout?

15.34.s:
ityetatkathitaṃ rājanyatpṛṣṭohaṃ tvayā'nagha ..
sarvakṣetrottamaṃ kṣetraṃ vajralepavināśanam .. 43 ..
15.34.d:
इत्येतत्कथितं राजन्यत्पृष्टोहं त्वयाऽनघ ..
सर्वक्षेत्रोत्तमं क्षेत्रं वज्रलेपविनाशनम् .. 43 ..
15.34.m: This has been recounted, O King, as was asked of me by you, O sinless one: / the best sacred field among all sacred fields, the destroyer of the inescapable bond [of sin].

15.34.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
vasiṣṭhenoditaṃ śrutvā dilīpo hṛṣṭa mānasaḥ ..
dvārakāṃ kṣetrarājaṃ taṃ jñātvā ca vismayaṃ yayau .. 44 ..
15.34.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
वसिष्ठेनोदितं श्रुत्वा दिलीपो हृष्ट मानसः ..
द्वारकां क्षेत्रराजं तं ज्ञात्वा च विस्मयं ययौ .. 44 ..
15.34.m: Śrī Prahlāda said: / Having heard what was spoken by Vasiṣṭha, Dilīpa, delighted in mind, / knew Dvārakā to be that king of sacred fields and was filled with wonder.

15.34.s:
yayau dvāravatīṃ hṛṣṭo devadevasya sādaram ..
kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā parāṃ siddhiṃ saṃprāpto devamaṃdire .. 45 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakāpānthadarśana mātrataḥ kāśyāṃ kṛtasya pāpavajralepasya vināśane yativṛttāntavarṇanapūrvakaṃ dilīpakṛtadvārakāyātrāvarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 34 .. ..
15.34.d:
ययौ द्वारवतीं हृष्टो देवदेवस्य सादरम् ..
कृष्णं दृष्ट्वा परां सिद्धिं संप्राप्तो देवमंदिरे .. 45 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये द्वारकापान्थदर्शन मात्रतः काश्यां कृतस्य पापवज्रलेपस्य विनाशने यतिवृत्तान्तवर्णनपूर्वकं दिलीपकृतद्वारकायात्रावर्णनंनाम चतुस्त्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 34 .. ..
15.34.m:
Rejoicing, he respectfully went to Dvāravatī of the God of gods; / having seen Kṛṣṇa in the divine temple, he attained supreme perfection.
Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter, entitled “Description of Dilīpa's Pilgrimage to Dvārakā, Preceded by the Story of the Ascetic, on the Destruction of the Inescapable Sin Formed in Kāśī by the Mere Sight of a Traveler to Dvārakā,” in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [subdivision] of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandapurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

15.35.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
aho kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ samaṃtāddaśayojanam ..
diviṣṭhā yatra paśyaṃti sarvāneva caturbhujān .. 1 ..
15.35.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
अहो क्षेत्रस्य माहात्म्यं समंताद्दशयोजनम् ..
दिविष्ठा यत्र पश्यंति सर्वानेव चतुर्भुजान् .. 1 ..
15.35.m: Prahlāda said: / Ah, the māhātmya of the sacred field, ten yojanas in circumference, / wherein the dwellers in heaven see all beings as four-armed!

15.35.s:
aho kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ dṛṣṭvā nityaṃ caturbhujān ..
dvārakāvāsinaḥ sarvānnamasyaṃti divaukasaḥ .. 2 ..
15.35.d:
अहो क्षेत्रस्य माहात्म्यं दृष्ट्वा नित्यं चतुर्भुजान् ..
द्वारकावासिनः सर्वान्नमस्यंति दिवौकसः .. 2 ..
15.35.m: Ah, the māhātmya of the sacred field! Seeing all dwellers in Dvārakā / always four-armed, the gods pay homage to them.

15.35.s:
aho kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu viśrutam ..
aho kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇvaṃtu ṛṣayo'malāḥ .. 3 ..
15.35.d:
अहो क्षेत्रस्य माहात्म्यं सर्वशास्त्रेषु विश्रुतम् ..
अहो क्षेत्रस्य माहात्म्यं शृण्वंतु ऋषयोऽमलाः .. 3 ..
15.35.m: Ah, the māhātmya of the sacred field, renowned in all the scriptures! / Ah, let the stainless seers hear the māhātmya of the sacred field!

15.35.s:
muktiṃ necchaṃti yatrasthāḥ kṛṣṇasevotsukāḥ sadā ..
yatratyāścaiva pāṣāṇā yatra kvāpi vimuktidāḥ .. 4 ..
15.35.d:
मुक्तिं नेच्छंति यत्रस्थाः कृष्णसेवोत्सुकाः सदा ..
यत्रत्याश्चैव पाषाणा यत्र क्वापि विमुक्तिदाः .. 4 ..
15.35.m: Those who dwell there, ever eager to serve Kṛṣṇa, do not desire liberation; / and the stones found there grant liberation wherever they may be.

15.35.s:
api kīṭa pataṃgādyāḥ paśavo'tha sarīsṛpāḥ ..
vimuktāḥ pāpinaḥ sarve dvārakāyāḥ prasādataḥ ..
kiṃ punarmānavā nityaṃ dvārakāyāṃ vasaṃti ye .. 5 ..
15.35.d:
अपि कीट पतंगाद्याः पशवोऽथ सरीसृपाः ..
विमुक्ताः पापिनः सर्वे द्वारकायाः प्रसादतः ..
किं पुनर्मानवा नित्यं द्वारकायां वसंति ये .. 5 ..
15.35.m: Even worms, moths and the like, beasts, and reptiles, / all sinners are fully liberated by the grace of Dvārakā; / how much more then human beings who dwell constantly in Dvārakā?

15.35.s:
yā gatiḥ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ dvārakāpuravāsinām ..
sā gatirdurlabhā nūnaṃ munīnāmūrddhvaretasām .. 6 ..
15.35.d:
या गतिः सर्वजंतूनां द्वारकापुरवासिनाम् ..
सा गतिर्दुर्लभा नूनं मुनीनामूर्द्ध्वरेतसाम् .. 6 ..
15.35.m: That destination which belongs to all creatures dwelling in the city of Dvārakā / is indeed difficult to attain even for sages with upward-drawn semen.

15.35.s:
sarveṣu kṣetratīrtheṣu vasatāṃ varṣakoṭibhiḥ ..
tatphalaṃ nimiṣāddheṃna dvārakāyāṃ dinedine .. 7 ..
15.35.d:
सर्वेषु क्षेत्रतीर्थेषु वसतां वर्षकोटिभिः ..
तत्फलं निमिषाद्धेंन द्वारकायां दिनेदिने .. 7 ..
15.35.m: The fruit that belongs to those dwelling in all sacred fields and sacred fords for tens of millions of years / is obtained in half a moment in Dvārakā day after day.

15.35.s:
dvārakāyāṃ sthitāḥ sarve narā nāryyaścaturbhujāḥ ..
dvārakāvāsinaḥ sarvānyaḥ paśyetkaluṣāpahān ..
satyaṃsatyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kṛṣṇasyātipriyo bhavet .. 8 ..
15.35.d:
द्वारकायां स्थिताः सर्वे नरा नार्य्यश्चतुर्भुजाः ..
द्वारकावासिनः सर्वान्यः पश्येत्कलुषापहान् ..
सत्यंसत्यं द्विजश्रेष्ठाः कृष्णस्यातिप्रियो भवेत् .. 8 ..
15.35.m: All men and women abiding in Dvārakā are four-armed. / Whoever beholds all the dwellers of Dvārakā, who remove impurities— / truly, truly, O best of the twice-born, he shall become exceedingly dear to Kṛṣṇa.

15.35.s:
dvārakāvāsino ye vai niṃdaṃti puruṣādhamāḥ ..
kṛṣṇasnehavihīnāste pataṃti duḥkhasāgare .. 9 ..
15.35.d:
द्वारकावासिनो ये वै निंदंति पुरुषाधमाः ..
कृष्णस्नेहविहीनास्ते पतंति दुःखसागरे .. 9 ..
15.35.m: Those vilest of men who revile the dwellers of Dvārakā / fall into the ocean of sorrow, bereft of Kṛṣṇa’s affection.

15.35.s:
jayaṃtena bhṛśaṃ trastāḥ śūlāgrāropitāściram ..
karṣitāstāḍitāste vai mūrcchitāḥ punarutthitāḥ .. 7.4.35.10 ..
15.35.d:
जयंतेन भृशं त्रस्ताः शूलाग्रारोपिताश्चिरम् ..
कर्षितास्ताडितास्ते वै मूर्च्छिताः पुनरुत्थिताः .. 7.4.35.10 ..
15.35.m: Greatly terrified by Jayanta, impaled on the point of a stake for a long time, / dragged and beaten, they indeed faint and rise up again.

15.35.s:
trāhitrāhi jayaṃta tvaṃ vadaṃto hi bhayāturāḥ ..
smaraṃtaḥ pūrvapāpaṃ te jayaṃtena pratāḍitāḥ ..11..
15.35.d:
त्राहित्राहि जयंत त्वं वदंतो हि भयातुराः ..
स्मरंतः पूर्वपापं ते जयंतेन प्रताडिताः ..11..
15.35.m: Saying, ‘Save us, save us, Jayanta!’, distressed with fear, / remembering their past sin, they are beaten by Jayanta.

15.35.s:
.. jayaṃta uvāca .. ..
kiṃ kṛtaṃ maṃdabhāgyairvo yatpāpaṃ ca sudāruṇam ..
sarvaṃ puṇyaphalaṃ labdhvā dvārakāvāsamuttamam..12..
15.35.d:
.. जयंत उवाच .. ..
किं कृतं मंदभाग्यैर्वो यत्पापं च सुदारुणम् ..
सर्वं पुण्यफलं लब्ध्वा द्वारकावासमुत्तमम्..12..
15.35.m: Jayanta said: / ‘What has been done by you wretched ones, what very dreadful sin, / after obtaining all the fruit of merit, an excellent dwelling in Dvārakā?

15.35.s:
dvārakāvāsināṃ niṃdā mahāpāpādhikā dhruvam ..
na nivarteta tatpāpaṃ sā jñeyā parameśvarī .. 13 ..
15.35.d:
द्वारकावासिनां निंदा महापापाधिका ध्रुवम् ..
न निवर्तेत तत्पापं सा ज्ञेया परमेश्वरी .. 13 ..
15.35.m: Reviling the dwellers of Dvārakā is surely worse than a great sin; / that sin does not turn back, for she is known as the supreme goddess.

15.35.s:
ataḥ kṛṣṇājñayā sarvānpāpino daṃḍayāmyaham ..
vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca niṃdāyāḥ phalaṃ bhuktvā sudāruṇam .. 14 ..
15.35.d:
अतः कृष्णाज्ञया सर्वान्पापिनो दंडयाम्यहम् ..
वैष्णवानां च निंदायाः फलं भुक्त्वा सुदारुणम् .. 14 ..
15.35.m: Therefore, by Kṛṣṇa’s command, I punish all sinners, / after they experience the very terrible fruit of reviling Vaiṣṇavas.

15.35.s:
tatastu dvārakāyāṃ ca puṇyaṃ janma bhaviṣyati ..
kṛṣṇaṃ pratoṣya saṃsiddhirbhaviṣyati sudurllabhā .. 15 ..
15.35.d:
ततस्तु द्वारकायां च पुण्यं जन्म भविष्यति ..
कृष्णं प्रतोष्य संसिद्धिर्भविष्यति सुदुर्ल्लभा .. 15 ..
15.35.m: Then, however, a meritorious birth shall take place in Dvārakā; / having pleased Kṛṣṇa, there will be perfection, so very difficult to attain.

15.35.s:
tasmāttadbhujyatāṃ pāpaṃ jātaṃ vaiṣṇavaniṃdanāt ..
tatratyānāṃ prabhurnaiva yama īṣṭe maheśvaraḥ .. 16 ..
15.35.d:
तस्मात्तद्भुज्यतां पापं जातं वैष्णवनिंदनात् ..
तत्रत्यानां प्रभुर्नैव यम ईष्टे महेश्वरः .. 16 ..
15.35.m: Therefore, let that sin born of reviling Vaiṣṇavas be experienced; / Yama, the great lord, has no mastership at all over the people of that place.’

15.35.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
tasmāddvāravatīṃ gatvā saṃsevyo devanāyakaḥ .. 17 ..
15.35.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
तस्माद्द्वारवतीं गत्वा संसेव्यो देवनायकः .. 17 ..
15.35.m: Glorious Prahlāda said: / Therefore, having gone to Dvāravatī, the leader of the gods must be thoroughly served.

15.35.s:
gomatītīramāśritya dvārakāyāṃ prayacchati ..
yattu kiṃciddhanaṃ viprāḥ śrūyatāṃ tatphalodayam .. 18 ..
15.35.d:
गोमतीतीरमाश्रित्य द्वारकायां प्रयच्छति ..
यत्तु किंचिद्धनं विप्राः श्रूयतां तत्फलोदयम् .. 18 ..
15.35.m: Taking resort on the bank of the Gomatī, whatever little wealth one gives in Dvārakā, / O brahmins, hear the emergence of its fruit!

15.35.s:
hemabhārasahasraistu ravivāre ravigrahe ..
kurukṣetre yadāpnoti gajāśvarathadānataḥ .. 19 ..
15.35.d:
हेमभारसहस्रैस्तु रविवारे रविग्रहे ..
कुरुक्षेत्रे यदाप्नोति गजाश्वरथदानतः .. 19 ..
15.35.m: What one obtains at Kurukṣetra during a solar eclipse on a Sunday / by gifts of elephants, horses, and chariots, with thousands of bhāras of gold—

15.35.s:
sahasraguṇitaṃ tasmātsatyaṃsatyaṃ mayoditam ..
hemamāṣārddhamānena dvārakādānayogataḥ .. 7.4.35.20 ..
15.35.d:
सहस्रगुणितं तस्मात्सत्यंसत्यं मयोदितम् ..
हेममाषार्द्धमानेन द्वारकादानयोगतः .. 7.4.35.20 ..
15.35.m: multiplied a thousandfold from that—truly, truly it is spoken by me— / by a measure of half a māṣa of gold through the association of gifts in Dvārakā.

15.35.s:
patrāṇāṃ caiva puṣpāṇāṃ naivedyasikthasaṃkhyayā ..
kṛṣṇadevasya pūjāyāmanaṃtaṃ bhavati dvijāḥ .. 21 ..
15.35.d:
पत्राणां चैव पुष्पाणां नैवेद्यसिक्थसंख्यया ..
कृष्णदेवस्य पूजायामनंतं भवति द्विजाः .. 21 ..
15.35.m: By the count of leaves, flowers, and grains of food-offerings / in the worship of Lord Kṛṣṇa, it becomes endless, O twice-born.

15.35.s:
annadānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryyāddvārakāyāṃ tu tatphalam..
naiva śaknomyahaṃ vaktuṃ brahmā śeṣamaheśvarau .. 22..
15.35.d:
अन्नदानं तु यः कुर्य्याद्द्वारकायां तु तत्फलम्..
नैव शक्नोम्यहं वक्तुं ब्रह्मा शेषमहेश्वरौ .. 22..
15.35.m: As for the gift of food that one might make in Dvārakā, / Brahmā, Śeṣa, and Maheśvara and I are not at all able to state its fruit.

15.35.s:
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā'pyatha vāṃ'tyajaḥ ..
nārī vā dvārakāyāṃ vai bhaktyā vāsaṃ karoti vai .. 23 ..
15.35.d:
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः शूद्रो वाऽप्यथ वांऽत्यजः ..
नारी वा द्वारकायां वै भक्त्या वासं करोति वै .. 23 ..
15.35.m: A brahmin, a kṣatriya, a vaiśya, a śūdra, or even an outcaste, / or a woman who dwells in Dvārakā with devotion,

15.35.s:
kulakoṭiṃ samuddhṛtya viṣṇuloke mahīyate ..
satyaṃsatyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā nānṛtaṃ mama bhāṣitam.. 24..
15.35.d:
कुलकोटिं समुद्धृत्य विष्णुलोके महीयते ..
सत्यंसत्यं द्विजश्रेष्ठा नानृतं मम भाषितम्.. 24..
15.35.m: uplifting ten million ancestors of their family, is honored in the world of Viṣṇu. / Truly, truly, O best of the twice-born, my speech is not untruthful.

15.35.s:
dvārakāvāsinaṃ dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā caiva viśeṣataḥ ..
mahāpāpavinirmuktāḥ svargaloke vasaṃti te .. 25 ..
15.35.d:
द्वारकावासिनं दृष्ट्वा स्पृष्ट्वा चैव विशेषतः ..
महापापविनिर्मुक्ताः स्वर्गलोके वसंति ते .. 25 ..
15.35.m: Having seen a resident of Dvārakā, and especially having touched [one], / completely freed from great sins, they dwell in heaven.

15.35.s:
pāṃsuvo dvārakāyā vai vāyunā samudīritāḥ ..
pāpināṃ muktidāḥ proktāḥ kiṃ punardvārakā bhuvi .. 26 ..
15.35.d:
पांसुवो द्वारकाया वै वायुना समुदीरिताः ..
पापिनां मुक्तिदाः प्रोक्ताः किं पुनर्द्वारका भुवि .. 26 ..
15.35.m: The dust particles of Dvārakā stirred up by the wind / are declared to grant liberation to sinners; how much more so Dvārakā on earth?

15.35.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca ..
śrūyatāṃ dvijaśārdūlā mahāmohavināśanam..
dvārakāyāśca māhātmyaṃ gomatīkṛṣṇasannidhau .. 27 ..
15.35.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच ..
श्रूयतां द्विजशार्दूला महामोहविनाशनम्..
द्वारकायाश्च माहात्म्यं गोमतीकृष्णसन्निधौ .. 27 ..
15.35.m: Glorious Prahlāda said: / O tigers among the twice-born, let the destruction of great delusion / and the māhātmya of Dvārakā in the presence of the Gomatī and Kṛṣṇa be heard!

15.35.s:
kuśāvarttātsamārabhya yāvadvai sāgarāvadhi ..
yasyāṃ tithau samāyāti siṃhe devapurohitaḥ.. 28 ..
15.35.d:
कुशावर्त्तात्समारभ्य यावद्वै सागरावधि ..
यस्यां तिथौ समायाति सिंहे देवपुरोहितः.. 28 ..
15.35.m: Beginning from Kuśāvarta as far as the ocean’s boundary: / on whatever lunar day the priest of the gods enters Leo,

15.35.s:
tasyāṃ hi gomatīsnānaṃ dviṣaṅgodāvarīphalam..
avagāhitā prayatnena siṃhāṃte gautamī sakṛt .. 29..
15.35.d:
तस्यां हि गोमतीस्नानं द्विषङ्गोदावरीफलम्..
अवगाहिता प्रयत्नेन सिंहांते गौतमी सकृत् .. 29..
15.35.m: on that [day] indeed ritual ablution in the Gomatī yields twice the fruit of the Godāvarī / when the Gautamī is bathed in with effort once while [Jupiter] is in Leo.

15.35.s:
godāvaryyāṃ bhavetpuṇyaṃ vasato varṣasaṃkhyayā ..
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti gomatīsevanāddvijāḥ ..7.4.35.30..
15.35.d:
गोदावर्य्यां भवेत्पुण्यं वसतो वर्षसंख्यया ..
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति गोमतीसेवनाद्द्विजाः ..7.4.35.30..
15.35.m: Whatever merit would accrue from dwelling at the Godāvarī for a number of years, / that fruit one completely attains from serving the Gomatī, O twice-born.

15.35.s:
gomatyāṃ śraddhayā snānaṃ pūrṇe siṃhasthite gurau ..
sahasraguṇitaṃ tatsyāddvāravatyāṃ dinedine .. 31 ..
15.35.d:
गोमत्यां श्रद्धया स्नानं पूर्णे सिंहस्थिते गुरौ ..
सहस्रगुणितं तत्स्याद्द्वारवत्यां दिनेदिने .. 31 ..
15.35.m: A ritual ablution performed with faith in the Gomatī when Jupiter is fully situated in Leo / is multiplied a thousandfold day after day in Dvāravatī.

15.35.s:
gacchagaccha mahābhāga dvārakāmiti yo vadet ..
tasyāvalokanādeva mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 32..
15.35.d:
गच्छगच्छ महाभाग द्वारकामिति यो वदेत् ..
तस्यावलोकनादेव मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 32..
15.35.m: Whoever says, ‘Go, go, O fortunate one, to Dvārakā!’ / is freed from all sins merely by the sight of that [person].

15.35.s:
dvāraketi ca yo brūyāddvārakābhimukho naraḥ ..
kṛpayā kṛṣṇadevasya muktibhāgī bhaveddhruvam . 33 ..
15.35.d:
द्वारकेति च यो ब्रूयाद्द्वारकाभिमुखो नरः ..
कृपया कृष्णदेवस्य मुक्तिभागी भवेद्ध्रुवम् . 33 ..
15.35.m: And the person who, facing Dvārakā, says ‘Dvārakā’, / by the grace of Lord Kṛṣṇa surely becomes a sharer in liberation.

15.35.s:
dvārakāṃ gomatīṃ puṇyāṃ rukmiṇīṃ kṛṣṇameva ca..
smaraṃti ye'nvahaṃ bhaktyā dvārakāphalabhāginaḥ .. 34 ..
15.35.d:
द्वारकां गोमतीं पुण्यां रुक्मिणीं कृष्णमेव च..
स्मरंति येऽन्वहं भक्त्या द्वारकाफलभागिनः .. 34 ..
15.35.m: Those who remember holy Dvārakā, the Gomatī, Rukmiṇī, and Kṛṣṇa / day after day with devotion share in the fruit of Dvārakā.

15.35.s:
sahasrayojanasthānāṃ yeṣāṃ syāditi mānasam..
dvāravatyāṃ gamiṣyāmo drakṣyāmo dvārakeśvaram .. 35 ..
15.35.d:
सहस्रयोजनस्थानां येषां स्यादिति मानसम्..
द्वारवत्यां गमिष्यामो द्रक्ष्यामो द्वारकेश्वरम् .. 35 ..
15.35.m: Those staying thousands of yojanas away whose mind is thus: / ‘We will go to Dvāravatī; we will see Dvārakeśvara’—

15.35.s:
sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyaṃte dhanyāste lokapāvanāḥ ..
kiṃ vācyaṃ dvārakāyātrāṃ ye prakurvaṃti mānavāḥ ..
kiṃ punardvārakānāthaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paśyaṃti ye narāḥ .. 36 ..
15.35.d:
सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यंते धन्यास्ते लोकपावनाः ..
किं वाच्यं द्वारकायात्रां ये प्रकुर्वंति मानवाः ..
किं पुनर्द्वारकानाथं कृष्णं पश्यंति ये नराः .. 36 ..
15.35.m: they are completely freed from all sins; blessed are they, purifiers of the worlds! / What need be said of human beings who undertake the pilgrimage to Dvārakā? / How much more of those people who see Kṛṣṇa, the Lord of Dvārakā?

15.35.s:
mitradhrugbrahmahā goghnaḥ paradārāpahārakaḥ ..
mātṛhā pitṛhā caiva brahmasvāpaharastathā .. 37 ..
15.35.d:
मित्रध्रुग्ब्रह्महा गोघ्नः परदारापहारकः ..
मातृहा पितृहा चैव ब्रह्मस्वापहरस्तथा .. 37 ..
15.35.m: A betrayer of friends, a slayer of a brahmin, a slayer of a cow, an abductor of another's wife, / a slayer of a mother, a slayer of a father, and also a stealer of brahmin property—

15.35.s:
ete cānye ca pāpiṣṭhā mahāpāpayutāśca ye ..
sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyaṃte kṛṣṇadevasya darśanāt ..38 ..
15.35.d:
एते चान्ये च पापिष्ठा महापापयुताश्च ये ..
सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यंते कृष्णदेवस्य दर्शनात् ..38 ..
15.35.m: these and other most sinful people who are joined with great sins / are completely freed from all sins by the darśana of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

15.35.s:
kiṃ vedaiḥ śraddhayā hīnairvyākhyānairapi kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
hemabhārasahasraiḥ kiṃ kurukṣetre ravigrahe .. 39 ..
15.35.d:
किं वेदैः श्रद्धया हीनैर्व्याख्यानैरपि कृत्स्नशः ..
हेमभारसहस्रैः किं कुरुक्षेत्रे रविग्रहे .. 39 ..
15.35.m: What of the Vedas devoid of faith, or even commentaries in their entirety? / What of thousands of bhāras of gold at Kurukṣetra during a solar eclipse?

15.35.s:
gajāśvarathadānaiḥ kiṃ kiṃ maṃdirapratiṣṭhayā ..
teṣāṃ pūjādinā samyagiṣṭā pūrtādibhiśca kim .. 7.4.35.40 ..
15.35.d:
गजाश्वरथदानैः किं किं मंदिरप्रतिष्ठया ..
तेषां पूजादिना सम्यगिष्टा पूर्तादिभिश्च किम् .. 7.4.35.40 ..
15.35.m: What of gifts of elephants, horses, and chariots? What of consecrating a temple, / proper worship of them day by day, and what of sacrificial rites, charitable works, and the like?

15.35.s:
rājasūyāśvamedhādyaiḥ sarvayajñaiśca kiṃ bhavet ..
sevanaiḥ kṣetratīrthānāṃ tapobhirvividhaistu kim .. 41 ..
15.35.d:
राजसूयाश्वमेधाद्यैः सर्वयज्ञैश्च किं भवेत् ..
सेवनैः क्षेत्रतीर्थानां तपोभिर्विविधैस्तु किम् .. 41 ..
15.35.m: What would come from the royal consecration, horse sacrifice, and all [other] sacrifices? / What of serving sacred fields and sacred fords, or diverse austerities?

15.35.s:
kiṃ mokṣasādhanaiḥ kleśairdhyānayogasamādhibhiḥ ..
dvārakeśvarakṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ yasya jāyate.. 42..
15.35.d:
किं मोक्षसाधनैः क्लेशैर्ध्यानयोगसमाधिभिः ..
द्वारकेश्वरकृष्णस्य दर्शनं यस्य जायते.. 42..
15.35.m: What of the toilsome means of liberation through meditation, yoga, and absorption / for one who obtains the darśana of Kṛṣṇa, the Lord of Dvārakā?

15.35.s:
māhātmyaṃ dvārakāyāstu athavā yaḥ śṛṇoti ca ..
viśeṣeṇa tu vaiśākhyāṃ jayaṃtyāścaiva jāgare.. 43..
15.35.d:
माहात्म्यं द्वारकायास्तु अथवा यः शृणोति च ..
विशेषेण तु वैशाख्यां जयंत्याश्चैव जागरे.. 43..
15.35.m: Or whoever hears the māhātmya of Dvārakā, / especially on the full moon of Vaiśākha and during the night vigil of Jayantī,

15.35.s:
māghyāṃ ca phālgune caitre jyeṣṭhe caiva viśeṣataḥ..
adyāpi dvārakā puṇyā kalāvapi viśeṣataḥ..44..
15.35.d:
माघ्यां च फाल्गुने चैत्रे ज्येष्ठे चैव विशेषतः..
अद्यापि द्वारका पुण्या कलावपि विशेषतः..44..
15.35.m: and on the full moon of Māgha, in Phālguna, Caitra, and especially in Jyeṣṭha— / even today Dvārakā is holy, especially in the Kali age.

15.35.s:
yasyāṃ satraṃ prapāṃ kṛtvā prāsādaṃ maṃcameva ca..
yatīnāṃ śaraṇaṃ kṛtvā tīre maṃḍapameva ca..45..
15.35.d:
यस्यां सत्रं प्रपां कृत्वा प्रासादं मंचमेव च..
यतीनां शरणं कृत्वा तीरे मंडपमेव च..45..
15.35.m: In which, having established a feeding house, a water booth, a palace or a pavilion, / having built a refuge for ascetics, or indeed a shed on the bank,

15.35.s:
vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ jīrṇoddhāramathāpi vā..
mūrtiṃ viṣṇoḥ pratiṣṭhāpya dattvā vā bhogasādhanam .. 46..
15.35.d:
वापीकूपतडागानां जीर्णोद्धारमथापि वा..
मूर्तिं विष्णोः प्रतिष्ठाप्य दत्त्वा वा भोगसाधनम् .. 46..
15.35.m: or having restored step-wells, wells, and tanks, / or having installed an image of Viṣṇu, or having donated the means of enjoyment,

15.35.s:
śrūyatāṃ tatphalaṃ viprāḥ sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ vadāmyaham ..
saṃprāpya vāṃchitānkāmānkṛṣṇānugrahabhājanam..47..
15.35.d:
श्रूयतां तत्फलं विप्राः सर्वोत्कृष्टं वदाम्यहम् ..
संप्राप्य वांछितान्कामान्कृष्णानुग्रहभाजनम्..47..
15.35.m: hear its fruit, O brahmins; I will declare the supreme one: / having attained his desired wishes, a recipient of Kṛṣṇa's grace,

15.35.s:
tejomayeṣu lokeṣu bhuktvā bhogānanukramāt ..
prāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ vai naro devanamaskṛtam .. 48 ..
15.35.d:
तेजोमयेषु लोकेषु भुक्त्वा भोगाननुक्रमात् ..
प्राप्नोति विष्णुलोकं वै नरो देवनमस्कृतम् .. 48 ..
15.35.m: having enjoyed pleasures in luminous worlds in due order, / a man certainly attains the world of Viṣṇu, revered by the gods.

15.35.s:
sthāpayeddvārakāyāṃ vai mūrtiṃ dāruśilāmayīm..
trailokyaṃ sthāpitaṃ tena viṣṇoḥ sāyujyatāmiyāt..49..
15.35.d:
स्थापयेद्द्वारकायां वै मूर्तिं दारुशिलामयीम्..
त्रैलोक्यं स्थापितं तेन विष्णोः सायुज्यतामियात्..49..
15.35.m: If one installs an image made of wood or stone in Dvārakā, / the three worlds have been established by him; he goes to communion with Viṣṇu.

15.35.s:
praroho nāsti pāpasya puṇyasya vṛddhiruttamā ..
dvārakāyāṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ vailakṣaṇyamidaṃ prabho ..
kṣetrebhyaḥ sarvatīrthebhya āścaryyaṃ kathayaṃti te .. 7.4.35.50 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakānāmamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 35 ..
15.35.d:
प्ररोहो नास्ति पापस्य पुण्यस्य वृद्धिरुत्तमा ..
द्वारकायां कथं जातं वैलक्षण्यमिदं प्रभो ..
क्षेत्रेभ्यः सर्वतीर्थेभ्य आश्चर्य्यं कथयंति ते .. 7.4.35.50 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये द्वारकानाममाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चविंशोऽध्यायः .. 35 ..
15.35.m:
There is no sprouting of sin, [and] the growth of merit is supreme; / how has this uniqueness arisen in Dvārakā, O Lord? / They describe it as a wonder beyond all sacred fields and sacred fords.
Thus ends the thirty-fifth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Name of Dvārakā,' in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [part] of the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

15.36.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
prahlādasya vacaḥ śrutvā sthitastatra sabhāsthale ..
papracchātyutsukamanā balistatkṣetravaibhavam ..1..
15.36.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
प्रह्लादस्य वचः श्रुत्वा स्थितस्तत्र सभास्थले ..
पप्रच्छात्युत्सुकमना बलिस्तत्क्षेत्रवैभवम् ..1..
15.36.m: Sūta said: / Having heard Prahlāda's words while standing there in the assembly hall, / Bali, his mind eager, asked about the glory of that sacred field.

15.36.s:
prahlādastadvacaḥ śrutvā bhaktibhāvapuraskṛtam ..
abhinandya ca taṃ premṇā pravaktumupacakrame ..2..
15.36.d:
प्रह्लादस्तद्वचः श्रुत्वा भक्तिभावपुरस्कृतम् ..
अभिनन्द्य च तं प्रेम्णा प्रवक्तुमुपचक्रमे ..2..
15.36.m: Prahlāda, hearing his words preceded by devotional sentiment, / commended him with affection and began to speak.

15.36.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca.. ..
ekaikasminpade datte purīṃ dvāravatīṃ prati ..
puṇyaṃ kratusahasrāṇāṃ phalaṃ bhavati dehinām ..3..
15.36.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच.. ..
एकैकस्मिन्पदे दत्ते पुरीं द्वारवतीं प्रति ..
पुण्यं क्रतुसहस्राणां फलं भवति देहिनाम् ..3..
15.36.m: Prahlāda said: / At every single step taken toward the city of Dvāravatī, / there arises for embodied souls the meritorious fruit of a thousand sacrifices.

15.36.s:
ye'pīcchaṃti manovṛttyā gamanaṃ dvārakāṃ prati ..
teṣāṃ pralīyate pāpaṃ pūrvajanmāyutārjitam ..4..
15.36.d:
येऽपीच्छंति मनोवृत्त्या गमनं द्वारकां प्रति ..
तेषां प्रलीयते पापं पूर्वजन्मायुतार्जितम् ..4..
15.36.m: Even those who wish in their mental disposition to go toward Dvārakā, / their sin accumulated over ten thousand previous lives dissolves away.

15.36.s:
atyugrāṇyapi pāpāni tāvattiṣṭhaṃti vigrahe ..
yāvanna gacchate jaṃtuḥ kalau dvāravatīṃ prati ..5..
15.36.d:
अत्युग्राण्यपि पापानि तावत्तिष्ठंति विग्रहे ..
यावन्न गच्छते जंतुः कलौ द्वारवतीं प्रति ..5..
15.36.m: Even the most terrible sins remain in the body only so long / as a living being does not go toward Dvāravatī in the Kali [age].

15.36.s:
lobhenā'pyuparodhena daṃbhena kapaṭena vā ..
cakratīrthe tu yo gacchenna punarviśate bhuvi ..6.
15.36.d:
लोभेनाऽप्युपरोधेन दंभेन कपटेन वा ..
चक्रतीर्थे तु यो गच्छेन्न पुनर्विशते भुवि ..6.
15.36.m: Even if through greed, constraint, deceit, or hypocrisy / one goes to Cakratīrtha, he does not enter the earth again.

15.36.s:
hīnavarṇo'pi pāpātmā mṛtaḥ kṛṣṇupurīṃ prati ..
kali kālakṛtairdoṣairatyugrairapi mānavaḥ ..
bhaktyā kṛṣṇamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā na lipyati kadācana ..7..
15.36.d:
हीनवर्णोऽपि पापात्मा मृतः कृष्णुपुरीं प्रति ..
कलि कालकृतैर्दोषैरत्युग्रैरपि मानवः ..
भक्त्या कृष्णमुखं दृष्ट्वा न लिप्यति कदाचन ..7..
15.36.m: Even a low-caste person, even an evil-minded one who dies [heading] toward Kṛṣṇa's city, / a person [burdened] even with the most terrible faults caused by the Kali age, / having beheld Kṛṣṇa's face with devotion, is never tainted.

15.36.s:
tāvadvirājate kāśī hyavaṃtī mathurāpurī ..
yāvanna paśyate jaṃtuḥ purīṃ kṛṣṇena pālitām.. 8 ..
15.36.d:
तावद्विराजते काशी ह्यवंती मथुरापुरी ..
यावन्न पश्यते जंतुः पुरीं कृष्णेन पालिताम्.. 8 ..
15.36.m: Kāśī, Avantī, and the city of Mathurā shine only so long / as a creature does not behold the city protected by Kṛṣṇa.

15.36.s:
yeṣāṃ kṛṣṇālaye prāṇā gatā dānavanāyaka ..
na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi .. 9 ..
15.36.d:
येषां कृष्णालये प्राणा गता दानवनायक ..
न तेषां पुनरावृत्तिः कल्पकोटिशतैरपि .. 9 ..
15.36.m: Those whose vital breaths have departed in Kṛṣṇa's abode, O chief of Dānavas, / have no return even in hundreds of millions of aeons.

15.36.s:
durlabho dvārakāvāso durlabhaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam ..
durlabhaṃ gomatīsnānaṃ rukmiṇīdarśanaṃ kalau .. 7.4.36.10 ..
15.36.d:
दुर्लभो द्वारकावासो दुर्लभं कृष्णदर्शनम् ..
दुर्लभं गोमतीस्नानं रुक्मिणीदर्शनं कलौ .. 7.4.36.10 ..
15.36.m: Residence in Dvārakā is rare to obtain; the darśana of Kṛṣṇa is rare to obtain; / ritual ablution in the Gomatī and the darśana of Rukmiṇī are rare to obtain in the Kali [age].

15.36.s:
nityaṃ kṛṣṇapurīṃ ramyāṃ ye smaraṃti gṛhe sthitāḥ ..
na teṣāṃ pātakaṃ kiṃciddehamāśritya tiṣṭhati .. 11 ..
15.36.d:
नित्यं कृष्णपुरीं रम्यां ये स्मरंति गृहे स्थिताः ..
न तेषां पातकं किंचिद्देहमाश्रित्य तिष्ठति .. 11 ..
15.36.m: Those who, dwelling at home, constantly remember the delightful city of Kṛṣṇa, / no sin whatsoever clings to their body.

15.36.s:
keśavārcā gṛhe yasya na tiṣṭhati mahīpate ..
tasyānnaṃ na ca bhoktavyamabhakṣyeṇa samaṃ smṛtam .. 12 ..
15.36.d:
केशवार्चा गृहे यस्य न तिष्ठति महीपते ..
तस्यान्नं न च भोक्तव्यमभक्ष्येण समं स्मृतम् .. 12 ..
15.36.m: In whose house worship of Keśava does not take place, O king, / his food must not be eaten; it is traditionally regarded as equal to uneatable matter.

15.36.s:
noṣṇatvaṃ dvija rāje vai na śītatvaṃ hutāśane ..
vaiṣṇavānāṃ na pāpatvamekādaśyupavāsinām .. 13 ..
15.36.d:
नोष्णत्वं द्विज राजे वै न शीतत्वं हुताशने ..
वैष्णवानां न पापत्वमेकादश्युपवासिनाम् .. 13 ..
15.36.m: There is indeed no heat in the moon, nor coldness in fire; / [similarly,] there is no sinfulness in Vaiṣṇavas who fast on the Ekādaśī.

15.36.s:
nāsti nāsti mahābhāgāḥ kalikālasamaṃ yugam ..
smaraṇātkīrttanādviṣṇoḥ prāpyate paramavyayam .. 14 ..
15.36.d:
नास्ति नास्ति महाभागाः कलिकालसमं युगम् ..
स्मरणात्कीर्त्तनाद्विष्णोः प्राप्यते परमव्ययम् .. 14 ..
15.36.m: There is no yuga, there is no [yuga], O blessed ones, equal to the Kali age: / through the remembrance and chanting of Viṣṇu, the supreme, imperishable [state] is attained.

15.36.s:
satyabhāmāpatiryatra yatra puṇyā ca gomatī ..
narā muktiṃ prayāsyaṃti tatra snātvā kalau yuge .. 15 ..
15.36.d:
सत्यभामापतिर्यत्र यत्र पुण्या च गोमती ..
नरा मुक्तिं प्रयास्यंति तत्र स्नात्वा कलौ युगे .. 15 ..
15.36.m: Where the Lord of Satyabhāmā is, and where the holy Gomatī is, / having bathed there in the Kali yuga, men will attain liberation.

15.36.s:
mādhave śuklapakṣe tu trispṛśāṃ dvādaśīṃ yadi ..
labhate dvārakāyāṃ tu nāsti dhanyatarastataḥ .. 16 ..
15.36.d:
माधवे शुक्लपक्षे तु त्रिस्पृशां द्वादशीं यदि ..
लभते द्वारकायां तु नास्ति धन्यतरस्ततः .. 16 ..
15.36.m: If in the bright fortnight of the month of Mādhava one encounters / a Trispṛśā Dvādaśī in Dvārakā, there is none more fortunate than he.

15.36.s:
trispṛśāṃ dvādaśīṃ prāpya gatvā kṛṣṇapurīṃ naraḥ ..
yaḥ karoti harerbhaktyā so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet.. 17 ..
15.36.d:
त्रिस्पृशां द्वादशीं प्राप्य गत्वा कृष्णपुरीं नरः ..
यः करोति हरेर्भक्त्या सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत्.. 17 ..
15.36.m: Encountering a Trispṛśā Dvādaśī, a man who has gone to Kṛṣṇa's city / and performs [worship] with devotion to Hari obtains the fruit of a horse-sacrifice.

15.36.s:
naṃdāyāṃ tu jayāyāṃ vai bhadrā caiva bhavedyadi ..
upavāsārcane gīte durllabhā kṛṣṇasannidhau ..18..
15.36.d:
नंदायां तु जयायां वै भद्रा चैव भवेद्यदि ..
उपवासार्चने गीते दुर्ल्लभा कृष्णसन्निधौ ..18..
15.36.m: If on Nandā or Jayā there is indeed Bhadrā, / fasting, worship, and song in the presence of Kṛṣṇa are rare to attain.

15.36.s:
udayaikādaśī svalpā aṃte caiva trayodaśī ..
saṃpūrṇā dvādaśī madhye trispṛśā ca hareḥ priyā .. 19 ..
15.36.d:
उदयैकादशी स्वल्पा अंते चैव त्रयोदशी ..
संपूर्णा द्वादशी मध्ये त्रिस्पृशा च हरेः प्रिया .. 19 ..
15.36.m: A brief Ekādaśī at sunrise, and Trayodaśī at the end, / and a complete Dvādaśī in the middle is Trispṛśā, dear to Hari.

15.36.s:
ekena copavāsena upavāsā'yutaṃ phalam ..
jāgare śatasāhasraṃ nṛtye koṭiguṇaṃ kalau .. 7.4.36.20 ..
15.36.d:
एकेन चोपवासेन उपवासाऽयुतं फलम् ..
जागरे शतसाहस्रं नृत्ये कोटिगुणं कलौ .. 7.4.36.20 ..
15.36.m: By a single fast, the fruit of ten thousand fasts is obtained; / in keeping vigil, a hundred thousandfold; in dancing, a crore-fold in the Kali [age].

15.36.s:
tatphalaṃ labhate marttyo dvārakāyāṃ dinedine ..
gṛheṣu vasatāmetatkiṃ punaḥ kṛṣṇasaṃnidhau .. .. 21 ..
15.36.d:
तत्फलं लभते मर्त्त्यो द्वारकायां दिनेदिने ..
गृहेषु वसतामेतत्किं पुनः कृष्णसंनिधौ .. .. 21 ..
15.36.m: A mortal obtains that fruit day by day in Dvārakā; / this is [the fruit] for those dwelling in their homes, how much more in the presence of Kṛṣṇa!

15.36.s:
vāṅmanaḥkāyajairdoṣairhatā ye pāpabuddhayaḥ ..
dvāravatyāṃ vimucyaṃte dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇamukhaṃ śubham .. 22 ..
15.36.d:
वाङ्मनःकायजैर्दोषैर्हता ये पापबुद्धयः ..
द्वारवत्यां विमुच्यंते दृष्ट्वा कृष्णमुखं शुभम् .. 22 ..
15.36.m: Those evil-minded ones afflicted by faults born of speech, mind, and body, / are liberated in Dvāravatī upon beholding the auspicious face of Kṛṣṇa.

15.36.s: daityeśvara narāḥ ślāghyā dvāravatyāṃ gatāśca ye .. 23 ..
15.36.d: दैत्येश्वर नराः श्लाघ्या द्वारवत्यां गताश्च ये .. 23 ..
15.36.m: O lord of the Daityas, those men are praiseworthy who have gone to Dvāravatī.

15.36.s:
durllabhānīha tīrthāni durlabhāḥ parvatottamāḥ ..
durllabhā vaiṣṇavā loke dvārakāvasatiḥ kalau .. 24 ..
15.36.d:
दुर्ल्लभानीह तीर्थानि दुर्लभाः पर्वतोत्तमाः ..
दुर्ल्लभा वैष्णवा लोके द्वारकावसतिः कलौ .. 24 ..
15.36.m: Rare to find in this world are sacred fords, rare to find are supreme mountains, / rare to find are Vaiṣṇavas in the world, [and rare to find is] residence in Dvārakā in the Kali [age].

15.36.s:
gavāṃ koṭisahasrāṇi ratnako ṭiśatāni ca ..
dattvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau .. 25 ..
15.36.d:
गवां कोटिसहस्राणि रत्नको टिशतानि च ..
दत्त्वा यत्फलमाप्नोति तत्फलं कृष्णसन्निधौ .. 25 ..
15.36.m: The fruit one obtains by giving thousands of crores of cows / and hundreds of crores of jewels, that [very] fruit [is obtained] in the presence of Kṛṣṇa.

15.36.s:
yasyāḥ sīmāṃ praviṣṭasya brahmahatyādipātakam ..
naśyate darśanādeva tāṃ purīṃ ko na sevate .. 26 ..
15.36.d:
यस्याः सीमां प्रविष्टस्य ब्रह्महत्यादिपातकम् ..
नश्यते दर्शनादेव तां पुरीं को न सेवते .. 26 ..
15.36.m: For one who has crossed its boundary, sins such as the slaying of a brahmin / are destroyed simply by beholding it—who would not resort to that city?

15.36.s:
cakrāṃkitā śilā yatra gomatyudadhisaṃgame ..
yacchati pūjitā mokṣaṃ tāṃ purīṃ ko na sevate .. 27 ..
15.36.d:
चक्रांकिता शिला यत्र गोमत्युदधिसंगमे ..
यच्छति पूजिता मोक्षं तां पुरीं को न सेवते .. 27 ..
15.36.m: Where at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean the stone marked with a discus, / when worshipped, bestows liberation—who would not resort to that city?

15.36.s:
siṃhasthe ca gurau viprā godāvaryyāṃ tu yatphalam..
tatphalaṃ snānamātreṇa gomatyāṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau .. 28 ..
15.36.d:
सिंहस्थे च गुरौ विप्रा गोदावर्य्यां तु यत्फलम्..
तत्फलं स्नानमात्रेण गोमत्यां कृष्णसन्निधौ .. 28 ..
15.36.m: The fruit [attained] at the Godāvarī when Jupiter is in Leo, O brahmins, / that [very] fruit is attained merely by bathing in the Gomatī in the presence of Kṛṣṇa.

15.36.s:
dvārakā'vasthitaṃ toyaṃ ṣaṇmāsaṃ pibate naraḥ ..
tasya cakrāṃkito deho bhavate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 29 ..
15.36.d:
द्वारकाऽवस्थितं तोयं षण्मासं पिबते नरः ..
तस्य चक्रांकितो देहो भवते नात्र संशयः .. 29 ..
15.36.m: If a man drinks water situated in Dvārakā for six months, / his body becomes marked with a discus; there is no doubt in this.

15.36.s:
manvantarasahasrāṇi kāśīvāsena yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ dvārakāyāṃ ca vasataḥ paṃcabhirddinaiḥ .. 7.4.36.30 ..
15.36.d:
मन्वन्तरसहस्राणि काशीवासेन यत्फलम् ..
तत्फलं द्वारकायां च वसतः पंचभिर्द्दिनैः .. 7.4.36.30 ..
15.36.m: The fruit that [comes] from living in Kāśī for thousands of manvantaras, / that fruit [is gained] by one dwelling in Dvārakā for five days.

15.36.s:
tāvanmṛtaprajā nārī durbhagā daityapuṃgava ..
yāvanna paśyate bhaktyā kalau kṛṣṇapriyāṃ purīm .. 31 ..
15.36.d:
तावन्मृतप्रजा नारी दुर्भगा दैत्यपुंगव ..
यावन्न पश्यते भक्त्या कलौ कृष्णप्रियां पुरीम् .. 31 ..
15.36.m: A woman has dead offspring and misfortune, O bull among the Daityas, / only so long as she does not behold with devotion Kṛṣṇa's beloved city in the Kali [age].

15.36.s:
rukmiṇīṃ satyabhāmāṃ ca devīṃ jāṃbavatīṃ tathā ..
mitraviṃdāṃ ca kāliṃdīṃ bhadrāṃ nāgnajitīṃ tathā .. 32 ..
15.36.d:
रुक्मिणीं सत्यभामां च देवीं जांबवतीं तथा ..
मित्रविंदां च कालिंदीं भद्रां नाग्नजितीं तथा .. 32 ..
15.36.m: Rukmiṇī, Satyabhāmā, and Queen Jāmbavatī, / Mitravindā, Kālindī, Bhadrā, and Nāgnajitī,

15.36.s:
saṃpūjya lakṣmaṇāṃ tatra vaiṣṇavīḥ kṛṣṇavallabhāḥ ..
etāḥ saṃpūjya vidhivacchreṣṭhaputraśca labhyate .. 33 ..
15.36.d:
संपूज्य लक्ष्मणां तत्र वैष्णवीः कृष्णवल्लभाः ..
एताः संपूज्य विधिवच्छ्रेष्ठपुत्रश्च लभ्यते .. 33 ..
15.36.m: having worshipped Lakṣmaṇā there—the Vaiṣṇava queens beloved of Kṛṣṇa— / having worshipped these according to rule, an excellent son is obtained.

15.36.s:
tāvadbhavabhayaṃ puṃsāṃ gṛhabhaṃgaśca mūrkhatā ..
yāvanna paśyate bhaktyā kalau kṛṣṇapurīṃ naraḥ .. 34 ..
15.36.d:
तावद्भवभयं पुंसां गृहभंगश्च मूर्खता ..
यावन्न पश्यते भक्त्या कलौ कृष्णपुरीं नरः .. 34 ..
15.36.m: There is fear of worldly existence, ruin of household, and foolishness for men only so long / as a person does not behold Kṛṣṇa's city with devotion in the Kali [age].

15.36.s:
na sarvatra mahāpuṇyaṃ saṃgame saritāṃpateḥ ..
jāhnavīsaṃgamānmuktirgomatīnīrasaṃgamāt ..
saṃparke gomatīnīrapūto'haṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau .. 35 ..
15.36.d:
न सर्वत्र महापुण्यं संगमे सरितांपतेः ..
जाह्नवीसंगमान्मुक्तिर्गोमतीनीरसंगमात् ..
संपर्के गोमतीनीरपूतोऽहं कृष्णसन्निधौ .. 35 ..
15.36.m: Not everywhere is there great merit at a confluence with the lord of rivers; / from confluence with the Jāhnavī comes liberation, [and] from confluence with the waters of the Gomatī; / by contact with the waters of the Gomatī, I am purified in the presence of Kṛṣṇa.

15.36.s:
gomatīnīrasaṃpṛktaṃ ye māṃ paśyaṃti mānavāḥ ..
na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttirityāha saritāṃpatiḥ .. 36 ..
15.36.d:
गोमतीनीरसंपृक्तं ये मां पश्यंति मानवाः ..
न तेषां पुनरावृत्तिरित्याह सरितांपतिः .. 36 ..
15.36.m: "Those mortals who behold me mingled with the water of the Gomatī / do not return again," so said the lord of rivers.

15.36.s:
dvārakāṃ gacchamānasya vipattiśca bhavedyadi ..
na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi .. 37 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakādarśanagomatīsaritsnānavidhimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 36..
15.36.d:
द्वारकां गच्छमानस्य विपत्तिश्च भवेद्यदि ..
न तस्य पुनरावृत्तिः कल्पकोटिशतैरपि .. 37 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये द्वारकादर्शनगोमतीसरित्स्नानविधिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः .. 36..
15.36.m:
If misfortune should overtake one going to Dvārakā, / he does not return again, even in hundreds of millions of kalpas.
Thus ends the thirty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Rule and Māhātmya of the Darśana of Dvārakā and the Bath in the Gomatī River,' in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [part] in the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [division] in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

15.37.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti śvapaco jāgaranniśi ..
japedapi kalau nityaṃ kṛṣṇarūpī bhaveddhi saḥ .. 1 ..
15.37.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
कृष्णकृष्णेति कृष्णेति श्वपचो जागरन्निशि ..
जपेदपि कलौ नित्यं कृष्णरूपी भवेद्धि सः .. 1 ..
15.37.m: The glorious Prahlāda said: / If even a dog-eater, staying awake at night in the Kali age, / should constantly recite, "Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa," he verily takes on Kṛṣṇa's form.

15.37.s:
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti kalau vadatyaharniśam ..
nityaṃ yajñāyutaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthakoṭisamudbhavam .. 2 ..
15.37.d:
कृष्णकृष्णेति कृष्णेति कलौ वदत्यहर्निशम् ..
नित्यं यज्ञायुतं पुण्यं तीर्थकोटिसमुद्भवम् .. 2 ..
15.37.m: One who says "Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa" day and night in the Kali age / constantly obtains the merit of ten thousand sacrifices, arising from ten million sacred fords.

15.37.s:
saṃpūrṇaikādaśī bhūtvā dvādaśyāṃ varddhate yadi ..
unmīlinīti vikhyātā tithīnāmuttamā tithiḥ ..3..
15.37.d:
संपूर्णैकादशी भूत्वा द्वादश्यां वर्द्धते यदि ..
उन्मीलिनीति विख्याता तिथीनामुत्तमा तिथिः ..3..
15.37.m: When a full Ekādaśī extends into Dvādaśī, / it is known as Unmīlinī, the best of lunar days.

15.37.s:
vaṃjulīvāsare ye vai rātrau kurvaṃti jāgaram..
yajñāyutāyutaṃ puṇyaṃ muhūrtārddhena jāyate..4..
15.37.d:
वंजुलीवासरे ये वै रात्रौ कुर्वंति जागरम्..
यज्ञायुतायुतं पुण्यं मुहूर्तार्द्धेन जायते..4..
15.37.m: Those who keep a vigil at night on the day of Vañjulī / obtain the merit of ten thousand myriad sacrifices in half a muhūrta.

15.37.s:
saṃpūrṇā dvādaśī bhūtvā varddhate cāpare dine ..
trayodaśyāṃ muniśreṣṭhā vaṃjulī durllabhā kalau .. 5 ..
15.37.d:
संपूर्णा द्वादशी भूत्वा वर्द्धते चापरे दिने ..
त्रयोदश्यां मुनिश्रेष्ठा वंजुली दुर्ल्लभा कलौ .. 5 ..
15.37.m: When a full Dvādaśī extends into the next day, / the Trayodaśī, O best of sages, that Vañjulī is rare to obtain in the Kali age.

15.37.s:
unmīlinīmanuprāpya ye prakurvaṃti jāgaram ..
nimiṣārddhena tatpuṇyaṃ gavāṃ koṭiphalapradam .. 6..
15.37.d:
उन्मीलिनीमनुप्राप्य ये प्रकुर्वंति जागरम् ..
निमिषार्द्धेन तत्पुण्यं गवां कोटिफलप्रदम् .. 6..
15.37.m: Those who keep a vigil on reaching an Unmīlinī / obtain in half a twinkling of an eye that merit which grants the fruit of ten million cows.

15.37.s:
saṃpūrṇaikādaśī bhūtvā pratya'haṃ varddhate yadi ..
darśaśca paurṇamāsī ca pakṣavṛddhistathocyate ..7..
15.37.d:
संपूर्णैकादशी भूत्वा प्रत्यऽहं वर्द्धते यदि ..
दर्शश्च पौर्णमासी च पक्षवृद्धिस्तथोच्यते ..7..
15.37.m: When a full Ekādaśī extends into the next day, / and likewise the new moon and full moon, that is called Pakṣavṛddhi.

15.37.s:
pakṣavṛddhikarīṃ prāpya ye prakurvaṃti jāgaram ..
nimiṣārddhārddhamātreṇa gavāṃ koṭiphalapradam .. 8 ..
15.37.d:
पक्षवृद्धिकरीं प्राप्य ये प्रकुर्वंति जागरम् ..
निमिषार्द्धार्द्धमात्रेण गवां कोटिफलप्रदम् .. 8 ..
15.37.m: Those who keep a vigil on reaching the [tithi] that causes the Pakṣavṛddhi, / obtain in the measure of a quarter of a twinkling of an eye the fruit of ten million cows.

15.37.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
cakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā mucyate sarva kilbiṣaiḥ ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ dāhapralayavarjitam .. 9 ..
15.37.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
चक्रतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा मुच्यते सर्व किल्बिषैः ..
स याति परमं स्थानं दाहप्रलयवर्जितम् .. 9 ..
15.37.m: The glorious Prahlāda said: / Having bathed at the Cakra-tīrtha, a man is freed from all sins; / he goes to the supreme abode, free from burning and dissolution.

15.37.s:
cakraṃ prakṣālitaṃ yatra kṛṣṇena svayameva hi ..
tena vai cakratīrthaṃ hi puṇyaṃ ca paramaṃ hareḥ ..
bhavaṃti tatra pāṣāṇāścakrāṃkā muktidāyakāḥ .. 7.4.37.10 ..
15.37.d:
चक्रं प्रक्षालितं यत्र कृष्णेन स्वयमेव हि ..
तेन वै चक्रतीर्थं हि पुण्यं च परमं हरेः ..
भवंति तत्र पाषाणाश्चक्रांका मुक्तिदायकाः .. 7.4.37.10 ..
15.37.m: Where the discus was washed by Kṛṣṇa himself, / on that account indeed it is the Cakra-tīrtha, Hari's supreme and holy [ford]. / The stones there, marked with discuses, bestow liberation.

15.37.s:
tatraiva yadi labhyaṃte cakrairdvādaśabhiḥ saha ..
dvādaśātmā sa vijñeyo mokṣadaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. .. 11 ..
15.37.d:
तत्रैव यदि लभ्यंते चक्रैर्द्वादशभिः सह ..
द्वादशात्मा स विज्ञेयो मोक्षदः परिकीर्तितः .. .. 11 ..
15.37.m: If [a stone] is found right there with twelve discuses, / it is to be known as Dvādaśātmā, celebrated as the bestower of liberation.

15.37.s:
ekacakreṇa pāṣāṇo dvāravatyāṃ suśobhanaḥ ..
sudarśanābhidheyosau mokṣaikaphaladāyakaḥ ..12..
15.37.d:
एकचक्रेण पाषाणो द्वारवत्यां सुशोभनः ..
सुदर्शनाभिधेयोसौ मोक्षैकफलदायकः ..12..
15.37.m: A beautiful stone with a single discus in Dvāravatī / is named Sudarśana; it bestows the singular fruit of liberation.

15.37.s:
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau dvau tau bhuktimuktiphalapradau ..
tribhiścaivācyutaṃ devaṃ sadendrapadadāyakam .. 13 ..
15.37.d:
लक्ष्मीनारायणौ द्वौ तौ भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदौ ..
त्रिभिश्चैवाच्युतं देवं सदेन्द्रपददायकम् .. 13 ..
15.37.m: One with two [discuses] is Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa, bestowing the fruit of enjoyment and liberation. / With three, it is the god Acyuta, ever bestowing the rank of Indra.

15.37.s:
bhūtido vighnahaṃtā ca catuścakro janārddanaḥ ..
pañcabhirvāsudevastu janmamṛtyubhayāpahaḥ .. 14 ..
15.37.d:
भूतिदो विघ्नहंता च चतुश्चक्रो जनार्द्दनः ..
पञ्चभिर्वासुदेवस्तु जन्ममृत्युभयापहः .. 14 ..
15.37.m: With four discuses, Janārdana grants prosperity and destroys obstacles. / With five, Vāsudeva takes away the fear of birth and death.

15.37.s:
pradyumnaḥ ṣaḍbhirevāsau lakṣmīṃ kāṃtiṃ dadāti ca ..
saptabhirbaladevastu gotrakīrtivivarddhanaḥ .. 15 ..
15.37.d:
प्रद्युम्नः षड्भिरेवासौ लक्ष्मीं कांतिं ददाति च ..
सप्तभिर्बलदेवस्तु गोत्रकीर्तिविवर्द्धनः .. 15 ..
15.37.m: With six, Pradyumna gives fortune and beauty. / With seven, Baladeva increases lineage and fame.

15.37.s:
vāṃchitaṃ cāṣṭabhirbhaktyā dadāti puruṣottamaḥ ..
sarvaṃ dadyānnavavyūho durllabho yaḥ surottamaiḥ .. 16 ..
15.37.d:
वांछितं चाष्टभिर्भक्त्या ददाति पुरुषोत्तमः ..
सर्वं दद्यान्नवव्यूहो दुर्ल्लभो यः सुरोत्तमैः .. 16 ..
15.37.m: With eight, Puruṣottama grants desires through devotion. / The ninefold form (Navavyūha), hard to attain even for the best of gods, bestows everything.

15.37.s:
rājyaprado daśabhistu daśāvatāra eva ca ..
ekādaśabhiraiśvaryyamaniruddhaḥ prayacchati .. 17 ..
15.37.d:
राज्यप्रदो दशभिस्तु दशावतार एव च ..
एकादशभिरैश्वर्य्यमनिरुद्धः प्रयच्छति .. 17 ..
15.37.m: With ten, Daśāvatāra bestows kingship. / With eleven, Aniruddha gives sovereignty.

15.37.s:
nirvāṇaṃ dvādaśātmā tu cakrairdvādaśabhiḥ smṛtam ..
ata ūrdhvamanaṃto'sau saukhyamokṣapradāyakaḥ .. 18 ..
15.37.d:
निर्वाणं द्वादशात्मा तु चक्रैर्द्वादशभिः स्मृतम् ..
अत ऊर्ध्वमनंतोऽसौ सौख्यमोक्षप्रदायकः .. 18 ..
15.37.m: With twelve discuses it is remembered as Dvādaśātmā, [bestowing] nirvāṇa; / beyond this is Ananta, the bestower of happiness and liberation.

15.37.s:
ye kecittatra pāṣāṇāḥ kṛṣṇacakreṇa mudritāḥ..
teṣāṃ sparśanamātreṇa mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 19 ..
15.37.d:
ये केचित्तत्र पाषाणाः कृष्णचक्रेण मुद्रिताः..
तेषां स्पर्शनमात्रेण मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः .. 19 ..
15.37.m: Whatever stones there are that are stamped with Kṛṣṇa's discus— / by merely touching them one is freed from all sins.

15.37.s:
brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ manovākkāyakarmajam ..
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti cakrāṃkitaprapūjanāt ..7.4.37.20..
15.37.d:
ब्रह्महत्यादिकं पापं मनोवाक्कायकर्मजम् ..
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति चक्रांकितप्रपूजनात् ..7.4.37.20..
15.37.m: Sin such as the slaying of a brahmin, born of the actions of mind, speech, and body— / all that dissolves away by worshiping the discus-marked [stone].

15.37.s:
mlecchadeśe śubhe vā'pi cakrāṃko yatra tiṣṭhati ..
yojanāni daśa dve ca mama kṣetraṃ ca sundari .. 21 ..
15.37.d:
म्लेच्छदेशे शुभे वाऽपि चक्रांको यत्र तिष्ठति ..
योजनानि दश द्वे च मम क्षेत्रं च सुन्दरि .. 21 ..
15.37.m: Whether in an impure barbarian land or an auspicious one, wherever the discus-marked [stone] resides, / for twelve yojanas around, O fair one, is my sacred field.

15.37.s:
mṛtyukāle ca saṃprāpte hṛdaye yastu dhārayet ..
cakrākaṃ pāpadalanaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 22 ..
15.37.d:
मृत्युकाले च संप्राप्ते हृदये यस्तु धारयेत् ..
चक्राकं पापदलनं स याति परमां गतिम् .. 22 ..
15.37.m: And when the time of death arrives, whoever holds upon his chest / the discus-marked [stone] which destroys sins, he goes to the supreme state.

15.37.s:
gomatīsaṃgame snātvā bhṛgutīrthe tathaiva ca ..
na māturvasate kukṣau yadyapi syātsa pātakī .. .. 23 ..
15.37.d:
गोमतीसंगमे स्नात्वा भृगुतीर्थे तथैव च ..
न मातुर्वसते कुक्षौ यद्यपि स्यात्स पातकी .. .. 23 ..
15.37.m: Having bathed at the confluence of the Gomatī and likewise at the Bhṛgu-tīrtha, / he does not dwell in a mother's womb, even if he be a sinner.

15.37.s:
tāmasaṃ rājasaṃ vāpi yatkṛtaṃ viṣṇupūjanam ..
tatsāttvikatvamabhyeti nimnagāṃbho yathārṇave .. 24 ..
15.37.d:
तामसं राजसं वापि यत्कृतं विष्णुपूजनम् ..
तत्सात्त्विकत्वमभ्येति निम्नगांभो यथार्णवे .. 24 ..
15.37.m: Whatever worship of Viṣṇu is performed, be it tāmasic or rājasic, / it attains sattva, just as river water [becomes ocean water] in the ocean.

15.37.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakākṣetrasthasudarśanapramukhānantāntacakracihnāṃkita pāṣāṇamāhātmyavarṇanapūrvakatatpūjanaphalādikathanaṃnāma saptatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ..37.. .
15.37.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये द्वारकाक्षेत्रस्थसुदर्शनप्रमुखानन्तान्तचक्रचिह्नांकित पाषाणमाहात्म्यवर्णनपूर्वकतत्पूजनफलादिकथनंनाम सप्तत्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः ..37.. .
15.37.m: Thus ends the thirty-seventh chapter, named 'Narration of the Fruits of Worshiping Stones Marked with Discus Marks Beginning with Sudarśana and Ending with Ananta Located in the Dvārakā Field,' in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [part] in the Prabhāsakhaṇḍe, the seventh [division] in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

15.38.s:
..śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
dvārakāyāśca māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu pautra mayoditam ..
śṛṇvato gadataścāpi muktiḥ kṛṣṇādbhaveddhruvam .. 1 ..
15.38.d:
..श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
द्वारकायाश्च माहात्म्यं शृणु पौत्र मयोदितम् ..
शृण्वतो गदतश्चापि मुक्तिः कृष्णाद्भवेद्ध्रुवम् .. 1 ..
15.38.m: The glorious Prahlāda said: / O grandson, hear the māhātmya of Dvārakā spoken by me. / For one who hears and one who recites, liberation through Kṛṣṇa surely comes to pass.

15.38.s:
putreṇa lokāñjayati pautreṇānantyamaśnute ..
atha putrasya pautreṇa nākamevādhirohati..2..
15.38.d:
पुत्रेण लोकाञ्जयति पौत्रेणानन्त्यमश्नुते ..
अथ पुत्रस्य पौत्रेण नाकमेवाधिरोहति..2..
