15.38.m: Through a son one conquers worlds; through a grandson one enjoys eternity; / then through a great-grandson one ascends even to heaven.

15.38.s:
yasya putraḥ śucirdakṣaḥ pūrve vayasi dhārmikaḥ ..
viṣṇubhaktiṃ ca kurute taṃ putraṃ kavayo viduḥ .. 3 ..
15.38.d:
यस्य पुत्रः शुचिर्दक्षः पूर्वे वयसि धार्मिकः ..
विष्णुभक्तिं च कुरुते तं पुत्रं कवयो विदुः .. 3 ..
15.38.m: Whose son is pure, capable, righteous in his early age, / and practices devotion to Viṣṇu—the wise recognize him as a [true] son.

15.38.s:
hemaśṛṃgaṃ raupyakhuraṃ savatsaṃ kāṃsyadohanam..
savastraṃ kapilānāṃ tu sahasraṃ ca dinedine .. 4 ..
15.38.d:
हेमशृंगं रौप्यखुरं सवत्सं कांस्यदोहनम्..
सवस्त्रं कपिलानां तु सहस्रं च दिनेदिने .. 4 ..
15.38.m: Having gold-tipped horns, silver hooves, accompanied by a calf, a bronze milking vessel, / along with garments—a thousand Kapila cows day after day—

15.38.s:
dattvā yatphalamāpnoti brāhmaṇe vedapārage ..
tatphalaṃ snānamātreṇa gomatyāṃ madhubhiddine .. 5 ..
15.38.d:
दत्त्वा यत्फलमाप्नोति ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे ..
तत्फलं स्नानमात्रेण गोमत्यां मधुभिद्दिने .. 5 ..
15.38.m: the fruit one attains by giving [such cows] to a brahmin who has mastered the Vedas, / that fruit is obtained merely by bathing in the Gomatī on the day of the Slayer of Madhu.

15.38.s:
yastvekaṃ bhojayedvipraṃ dvārakāyāṃ ca saṃsthitam ..
subhikṣe bho dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ phalaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet..6..
15.38.d:
यस्त्वेकं भोजयेद्विप्रं द्वारकायां च संस्थितम् ..
सुभिक्षे भो द्विजश्रेष्ठाः फलं लक्षगुणं भवेत्..6..
15.38.m: If one feeds even a single vipra dwelling in Dvārakā / in times of plenty, O best of twice-born, the fruit is multiplied a hundred thousand times.

15.38.s:
phalaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ proktaṃ durbhikṣe kṛṣṇasannidhau..
evaṃ dharmānusāreṇa dayādbhikṣāṃ tu bhikṣuke .. 7 ..
15.38.d:
फलं लक्षगुणं प्रोक्तं दुर्भिक्षे कृष्णसन्निधौ..
एवं धर्मानुसारेण दयाद्भिक्षां तु भिक्षुके .. 7 ..
15.38.m: The fruit is declared to be multiplied a hundred thousand times in famine in the presence of Kṛṣṇa. / In this way, according to dharma, one should give alms to an ascetic.

15.38.s:
api naḥ sa kule kaścidbhaviṣyati narottamaḥ ..
yo yatīno kalau prāpte pitṝnuddiśya dāsyati .. 8 ..
15.38.d:
अपि नः स कुले कश्चिद्भविष्यति नरोत्तमः ..
यो यतीनो कलौ प्राप्ते पितॄनुद्दिश्य दास्यति .. 8 ..
15.38.m: Will there be someone in our family, a best of men, / who, when the Kali age arrives, will give to ascetics with the ancestors in mind,

15.38.s:
dvārakāyāṃ viśe ṣeṇa satkṛtya kṛṣṇasannidhau ..
annadānaṃ yatīnāṃ tu kaupīnācchādanāni ca .. 9 ..
15.38.d:
द्वारकायां विशे षेण सत्कृत्य कृष्णसन्निधौ ..
अन्नदानं यतीनां तु कौपीनाच्छादनानि च .. 9 ..
15.38.m: especially in Dvārakā, having honored them in the presence of Kṛṣṇa, / gifts of food to ascetics and loincloths and garments?

15.38.s:
nātmanaḥ kratubhiḥ sviṣṭairnāsti tīrthaiḥ prayojanam..
yatra vā tatra vā kāryyaṃ yatīnāṃ prīṇanaṃ sadā .. 7.4.38.10 ..
15.38.d:
नात्मनः क्रतुभिः स्विष्टैर्नास्ति तीर्थैः प्रयोजनम्..
यत्र वा तत्र वा कार्य्यं यतीनां प्रीणनं सदा .. 7.4.38.10 ..
15.38.m: There is no need for one's own well-offered sacrifices, nor is there any need for sacred fords; / everywhere and anywhere, the pleasing of ascetics is always to be done.

15.38.s:
śvapacādayo'pi te dhanyā ye gatā dvārakāṃ purīm ..
prāpya bhāgavatānye vai pitṝnuddiśya putrakāḥ .. .. 11 ..
15.38.d:
श्वपचादयोऽपि ते धन्या ये गता द्वारकां पुरीम् ..
प्राप्य भागवतान्ये वै पितॄनुद्दिश्य पुत्रकाः .. .. 11 ..
15.38.m: Even those dog-eaters and others are blessed who have gone to the city of Dvārakā; / having reached the devotees of Bhagavān, those sons, on behalf of their ancestors,

15.38.s: bhaktyā saṃpūjayiṣyaṃti vastrairdānaiśca bhūribhiḥ .. 12 ..
15.38.d: भक्त्या संपूजयिष्यंति वस्त्रैर्दानैश्च भूरिभिः .. 12 ..
15.38.m: will worship them with devotion, with clothes and abundant gifts.

15.38.s:
gayāpiṃḍena nāsmākaṃ tṛptirbhavati tādṛśī ..
yādṛśī viṣṇubhaktānāṃ satkāreṇopa jāyate .. 13 ..
15.38.d:
गयापिंडेन नास्माकं तृप्तिर्भवति तादृशी ..
यादृशी विष्णुभक्तानां सत्कारेणोप जायते .. 13 ..
15.38.m: We do not experience such satisfaction from a funerary ball offered at Gayā / as that which arises from the hospitable honoring of Viṣṇu's devotees.

15.38.s:
vaiśākhe ye kariṣyaṃti dvādaśīṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau ..
kṛṣṇaṃ saṃpūjayantaśca rātrau kurvaṃti jāgaram ..14..
15.38.d:
वैशाखे ये करिष्यंति द्वादशीं कृष्णसन्निधौ ..
कृष्णं संपूजयन्तश्च रात्रौ कुर्वंति जागरम् ..14..
15.38.m: Those who observe the twelfth day in Vaiśākha in the presence of Kṛṣṇa, / and, worshiping Kṛṣṇa, keep vigil at night, 14

15.38.s:
māhātmyaṃ paṭhanīyaṃ tu dvārakāsaṃbhavaṃ śubham ..
kṛṣṇasya bālacaritaṃ bālakṛṣṇādidarśanam .. 15 ..
15.38.d:
माहात्म्यं पठनीयं तु द्वारकासंभवं शुभम् ..
कृष्णस्य बालचरितं बालकृष्णादिदर्शनम् .. 15 ..
15.38.m: the auspicious māhātmya arising from Dvārakā is certainly to be recited [by them]— / Kṛṣṇa's childhood exploits, the darśana of the child Kṛṣṇa and the rest, 15

15.38.s:
krīḍanaṃ gokulasyaiva krīḍā gopījanasya ca ..
kṛṣṇāvatārakarmāṇi śrotavyāni punaḥpunaḥ .. 16 ..
15.38.d:
क्रीडनं गोकुलस्यैव क्रीडा गोपीजनस्य च ..
कृष्णावतारकर्माणि श्रोतव्यानि पुनःपुनः .. 16 ..
15.38.m: the play of Gokula itself, and the dalliance with the cowherd women; / the deeds of Kṛṣṇa's incarnations are to be heard again and again. 16

15.38.s:
rukmaśṛṃgīṃ raupyakhurīṃ muktālāṃgūlabhūṣitām..
savatsāṃ brāhmaṇe dattvā homārthaṃ cāhitāgnaye .. 17 ..
15.38.d:
रुक्मशृंगीं रौप्यखुरीं मुक्तालांगूलभूषिताम्..
सवत्सां ब्राह्मणे दत्त्वा होमार्थं चाहिताग्नये .. 17 ..
15.38.m: Having given a cow with golden horns, silver hooves, adorned with a pearl tail, / together with her calf, to a brahmin who maintains the sacred fires for the sake of oblation, 17

15.38.s:
nimiṣasparśanāṃśena phalaṃ kṛṣṇasya jāgare ..
yatkiṃcitkurute pāpaṃ koṭijanmasu mānavaḥ ..
kṛṣṇasya jāgare rātrau dahate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 18 ..
15.38.d:
निमिषस्पर्शनांशेन फलं कृष्णस्य जागरे ..
यत्किंचित्कुरुते पापं कोटिजन्मसु मानवः ..
कृष्णस्य जागरे रात्रौ दहते नात्र संशयः .. 18 ..
15.38.m: [even] a fraction of touching for a moment during Kṛṣṇa's vigil [equals] that fruit. / Whatever sin a man commits across ten million lifetimes / burns away during the night vigil of Kṛṣṇa, of this there is no doubt. 18

15.38.s:
paṭhedbhāgavataṃ rātrau purāṇaṃ dayitaṃ hareḥ ..
yāvatsūryyakṛtā''loko yāvaccandrakṛtā niśā .. 19 ..
15.38.d:
पठेद्भागवतं रात्रौ पुराणं दयितं हरेः ..
यावत्सूर्य्यकृता'ऽलोको यावच्चन्द्रकृता निशा .. 19 ..
15.38.m: One should recite at night the Bhāgavata Purāṇa, beloved of Hari. / As long as the day is illuminated by the sun, as long as the night is illuminated by the moon, 19

15.38.s:
yāvatsasāgarā pṛthvī yāvacca kulaparvatāḥ ..
tāvatkālaṃ vasetsvarge nānyathā mama bhāṣitam .. 7.4.38.20 ..
15.38.d:
यावत्ससागरा पृथ्वी यावच्च कुलपर्वताः ..
तावत्कालं वसेत्स्वर्गे नान्यथा मम भाषितम् .. 7.4.38.20 ..
15.38.m: as long as the earth has oceans, and as long as the principal mountain ranges endure, / for that length of time he shall dwell in heaven; my word is not otherwise. 7.4.38.20

15.38.s:
āsphoṭayaṃti pitaraḥ praharṣaṃti pitāmahāḥ ..
evaṃ taṃ svasutaṃ dṛṣṭvā śṛṇvānaṃ kṛṣṇasaṃbhavam .. 21 ..
15.38.d:
आस्फोटयंति पितरः प्रहर्षंति पितामहाः ..
एवं तं स्वसुतं दृष्ट्वा शृण्वानं कृष्णसंभवम् .. 21 ..
15.38.m: The ancestors clap their hands, the grandfathers rejoice, / seeing their descendant thus listening to the origin of Kṛṣṇa. 21

15.38.s:
dvārakāyāśca māhātmyaṃ yatra no jāgare paṭhet ..
tanmlecchasadṛśaṃ sthānamapavitraṃ parityajet .. 22 ..
15.38.d:
द्वारकायाश्च माहात्म्यं यत्र नो जागरे पठेत् ..
तन्म्लेच्छसदृशं स्थानमपवित्रं परित्यजेत् .. 22 ..
15.38.m: Where the māhātmya of Dvārakā is not recited during the vigil, / that place is like a land of barbarians, impure; one should abandon it. 22

15.38.s:
śāligrāmaśilā naiva yatra bhāgavatā na hi ..
tyajettīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ puṇyamāyatanaṃ tyajet .. 23 ..
15.38.d:
शालिग्रामशिला नैव यत्र भागवता न हि ..
त्यजेत्तीर्थं महापुण्यं पुण्यमायतनं त्यजेत् .. 23 ..
15.38.m: Where there is no Śāligrāma stone, where there are indeed no devotees of Bhagavān, / one should abandon that sacred ford though highly meritorious, one should abandon that holy temple. 23

15.38.s: tyajedguhyaṃ tathā'raṇyaṃ yatra na dvādaśīvratam .. 24 ..
15.38.d: त्यजेद्गुह्यं तथाऽरण्यं यत्र न द्वादशीव्रतम् .. 24 ..
15.38.m: Likewise, one should abandon a secret forest where the vow of the twelfth day is not observed. 24

15.38.s:
sudeśo'pi bhavenniṃdyo yatra no vaiṣṇavā vratam..
kudeśo'pi bhavetpuṇyo yatra bhāgavatāḥ kalau .. 25 ..
15.38.d:
सुदेशोऽपि भवेन्निंद्यो यत्र नो वैष्णवा व्रतम्..
कुदेशोऽपि भवेत्पुण्यो यत्र भागवताः कलौ .. 25 ..
15.38.m: Even a good region would become contemptible where Vaiṣṇavas perform no vow; / even a bad region would become holy where there are devotees of Bhagavān in the Kali age. 25

15.38.s:
saṃkīrṇayonayaḥ pūtā ye bhaktā madhusūdane ..
mlecchatulyāḥ kulīnāste ye na bhaktā janārdane.. 26 ..
15.38.d:
संकीर्णयोनयः पूता ये भक्ता मधुसूदने ..
म्लेच्छतुल्याः कुलीनास्ते ये न भक्ता जनार्दने.. 26 ..
15.38.m: Those of mixed origins who are devoted to Madhusūdana are purified; / those of noble birth who are not devoted to Janārdana are equal to barbarians. 26

15.38.s:
rathārūḍhaṃ prakurvaṃti ye kṛṣṇaṃ madhumādhave ..
muktiṃ prayāṃti te sarve kulakoṭisamanvitāḥ .. 27 ..
15.38.d:
रथारूढं प्रकुर्वंति ये कृष्णं मधुमाधवे ..
मुक्तिं प्रयांति ते सर्वे कुलकोटिसमन्विताः .. 27 ..
15.38.m: Those who mount Kṛṣṇa upon a chariot in the spring months of Madhu and Mādhava, / they all attain liberation, accompanied by ten million ancestors of their lineage. 27

15.38.s:
devakīnandanasyārthe rathaṃ kārāpayanti ye ..
kalpāṃtaṃ viṣṇuloke te vasanti pitṛbhiḥ saha .. 28 ..
15.38.d:
देवकीनन्दनस्यार्थे रथं कारापयन्ति ये ..
कल्पांतं विष्णुलोके ते वसन्ति पितृभिः सह .. 28 ..
15.38.m: Those who cause a chariot to be made for the son of Devakī, / they dwell in the world of Viṣṇu until the end of the kalpa along with their ancestors. 28

15.38.s:
dvārakāyāstu māhātmyaṃ śrāvayedyaḥ kalau nṛṇām..
bhāvamutpādayedyo vai labhetkratuśataṃphalam .. 29 ..
15.38.d:
द्वारकायास्तु माहात्म्यं श्रावयेद्यः कलौ नृणाम्..
भावमुत्पादयेद्यो वै लभेत्क्रतुशतंफलम् .. 29 ..
15.38.m: He who recites the māhātmya of Dvārakā to men in the Kali age, / he who truly awakens devotion, obtains the fruit of a hundred sacrifices. 29

15.38.s:
yo nārcayati pāpiṣṭho devamanyatra gacchati ..
koṭijanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ harate rukmiṇīpatiḥ .. 7.4.38.30 ..
15.38.d:
यो नार्चयति पापिष्ठो देवमन्यत्र गच्छति ..
कोटिजन्मार्जितं पुण्यं हरते रुक्मिणीपतिः .. 7.4.38.30 ..
15.38.m: That worst of sinners who does not worship the god and goes elsewhere— / the husband of Rukmiṇī takes away the merit earned across ten million births. 7.4.38.30

15.38.s:
śaṃkhoddhārasamudbhūtāṃ nityaṃ dehe bibhartti hi ..
mṛttikāṃ daityarājendra śṛṇu vakṣyāmi yatphalam .. 31 ..
15.38.d:
शंखोद्धारसमुद्भूतां नित्यं देहे बिभर्त्ति हि ..
मृत्तिकां दैत्यराजेन्द्र शृणु वक्ष्यामि यत्फलम् .. 31 ..
15.38.m: He who constantly wears upon his body the clay / originating from Śaṅkhoddhāra—O king of Daityas, listen to the fruit of that, which I shall declare: 31

15.38.s:
yo dadāti yatīnāṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ prayacchati ..
svarṇabhāraśataṃ puṇḍraṃ nityaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 32 ..
15.38.d:
यो ददाति यतीनां च वैष्णवानां प्रयच्छति ..
स्वर्णभारशतं पुण्ड्रं नित्यं प्राप्नोति मानवः .. 32 ..
15.38.m: He who gives it to ascetics and offers it to Vaiṣṇavas, / that man constantly attains the sectarian mark worth a hundred weights of gold. 32

15.38.s:
gṛhe yasya sadā tiṣṭhecchaṃkhoddhārasya mṛttikā ..
nitya kriyākṛtaṃpuṇyaṃ labhetkoṭiguṇaṃ bale .. 33 ..
15.38.d:
गृहे यस्य सदा तिष्ठेच्छंखोद्धारस्य मृत्तिका ..
नित्य क्रियाकृतंपुण्यं लभेत्कोटिगुणं बले .. 33 ..
15.38.m: In whose house the clay of Śaṅkhoddhāra constantly remains, / O Bali, he obtains ten million times the merit produced by daily rites. 33

15.38.s:
yasya puṇḍraṃ lalāṭe tu gopīcaṃdanasaṃjñakam ..
na jahāti gṛhaṃ tasya lakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇapriyā dvijāḥ .. 34 ..
15.38.d:
यस्य पुण्ड्रं ललाटे तु गोपीचंदनसंज्ञकम् ..
न जहाति गृहं तस्य लक्ष्मीः कृष्णप्रिया द्विजाः .. 34 ..
15.38.m: Upon whose forehead is the mark known as gopīcandana, / Lakṣmī, beloved of Kṛṣṇa, never abandons his house, O brahmins. 34

15.38.s:
na graho bādhate tasya norago na ca rākṣasaḥ ..
piśācā na ca kūṣmāṃḍā na ca pretā na jaṃbhakāḥ .. 35 ..
15.38.d:
न ग्रहो बाधते तस्य नोरगो न च राक्षसः ..
पिशाचा न च कूष्मांडा न च प्रेता न जंभकाः .. 35 ..
15.38.m: No planet torments him, nor serpent, nor rākṣasa, / no piśācas, nor kūṣmāṇḍas, nor pretas, nor jambhakas. 35

15.38.s:
nāgnicaurabhayaṃ tasya darīṇāṃ caiva bandhanam ..
vidyudulkābhayaṃ caiva na cotpātasamudbhavam .. 36 ..
15.38.d:
नाग्निचौरभयं तस्य दरीणां चैव बन्धनम् ..
विद्युदुल्काभयं चैव न चोत्पातसमुद्भवम् .. 36 ..
15.38.m: He has no fear of fire or thieves, nor imprisonment in caves, / nor fear of lightning and meteors, nor that arising from portents. 36

15.38.s:
nāriṣṭaṃ nāpaśakunaṃ durnimittādikaṃ ca yat ..
satkṛte viṣṇubhakte ca śāligrāmaśilārcane .. 37 ..
15.38.d:
नारिष्टं नापशकुनं दुर्निमित्तादिकं च यत् ..
सत्कृते विष्णुभक्ते च शालिग्रामशिलार्चने .. 37 ..
15.38.m: No misfortune, no ill omen, whatever inauspicious signs there may be, [afflicts him], / when the devotee of Viṣṇu is honored, and worship of the Śāligrāma stone is performed, 37

15.38.s:
pīte pādodake viprā naivedyasyāpi bhakṣaṇe ..
tulasīsannidhau viṣṇorvilayāvasare kṛte .. 38 ..
15.38.d:
पीते पादोदके विप्रा नैवेद्यस्यापि भक्षणे ..
तुलसीसन्निधौ विष्णोर्विलयावसरे कृते .. 38 ..
15.38.m: when the water of [the Lord's] feet has been drunk, O brahmins, and the food offering eaten, / [and] when departure is made in the presence of Viṣṇu's tulasī plant. 38

15.38.s:
purā devena kathitaṃ śṛṇu pātraṃ vadāmyaham ..
priyā bhāgavatā yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ dāso'smyahaṃ sadā .. 39..
15.38.d:
पुरा देवेन कथितं शृणु पात्रं वदाम्यहम् ..
प्रिया भागवता येषां तेषां दासोऽस्म्यहं सदा .. 39..
15.38.m: Formerly it was spoken by the God; hear, I shall declare the worthy recipient: / 'To those to whom the devotees of Bhagavān are dear, I am always their servant. 39

15.38.s:
vihāya mathurāṃ kāśīmavantīṃ sarvapāpahām ..
māyāṃ kāṃcīmayodhyāṃ ca saṃprāpte ca kalau yuge .. .. 7.4.38.40 ..
15.38.d:
विहाय मथुरां काशीमवन्तीं सर्वपापहाम् ..
मायां कांचीमयोध्यां च संप्राप्ते च कलौ युगे .. .. 7.4.38.40 ..
15.38.m: Abandoning Mathurā, Kāśī, and Avantī which destroys all sin, / Māyā, Kāñcī, and Ayodhyā, when the Kali age has arrived, 7.4.38.40

15.38.s:
vasāmyahaṃ dvārakāyāṃ sarvasenāsamāvṛtaḥ ..
tīrthavratairyajñadānai rudrādyairmunicāraṇaiḥ .. 41 ..
15.38.d:
वसाम्यहं द्वारकायां सर्वसेनासमावृतः ..
तीर्थव्रतैर्यज्ञदानै रुद्राद्यैर्मुनिचारणैः .. 41 ..
15.38.m: surrounded by all armies, I dwell in Dvārakā / along with Rudra and others, sages, and cāraṇas, through sacred fords, vows, sacrifices, and gifts. 41

15.38.s:
śraddhātyāgena bhaktyā vā yastoṣayitumicchati ..
gatvā dvāravatīṃ ramyāṃ draṣṭavyo'haṃ kalau yuge .. 42 ..
15.38.d:
श्रद्धात्यागेन भक्त्या वा यस्तोषयितुमिच्छति ..
गत्वा द्वारवतीं रम्यां द्रष्टव्योऽहं कलौ युगे .. 42 ..
15.38.m: Whoever desires to please me with faith, renunciation, or devotion, / must go to delightful Dvāravatī and behold me in the Kali age. 42

15.38.s:
trailokye yāni tīrthāni mayā śuddhāni bhūriśaḥ ...
vinyastāni ca gomatyāṃ cakratīrthe'tipāvane .. 43 ..
15.38.d:
त्रैलोक्ये यानि तीर्थानि मया शुद्धानि भूरिशः ...
विन्यस्तानि च गोमत्यां चक्रतीर्थेऽतिपावने .. 43 ..
15.38.m: Whatever sacred fords are in the three worlds have in abundance / been purified and deposited by me in the Gomatī and at the extremely sacred Cakratīrtha. 43

15.38.s:
dinenaikena gomatyāṃ cakratīrthe kalau yuge ..
trailokyasaṃbhavaistīrthaiḥ snāto bhavati mānavaḥ .. 44 ..
15.38.d:
दिनेनैकेन गोमत्यां चक्रतीर्थे कलौ युगे ..
त्रैलोक्यसंभवैस्तीर्थैः स्नातो भवति मानवः .. 44 ..
15.38.m: In a single day in the Gomatī, at Cakratīrtha in the Kali age, / a mortal becomes one who has bathed in the sacred fords belonging to the three worlds. 44

15.38.s:
koṭipāpavinirmukto matsamaṃ vasate naraḥ ..
mama loke na saṃdehaḥ kulakoṭisamanvitaḥ .. 45 ..
15.38.d:
कोटिपापविनिर्मुक्तो मत्समं वसते नरः ..
मम लोके न संदेहः कुलकोटिसमन्वितः .. 45 ..
15.38.m: Freed from ten million sins, a man dwells equal to me / in my world without doubt, accompanied by ten million members of his lineage. 45

15.38.s:
nāparādhakṛtaiḥ pāpairliptaḥ syādu tkaṭaiḥ kṛtaiḥ ..
śatajanmāyutānīha lakṣmīrna cyavate gṛhāt .. 46 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye gomatītīragata dvārakācakratīrthayorjāgarādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ-nāmāṣṭātriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 38 ..
15.38.d:
नापराधकृतैः पापैर्लिप्तः स्यादु त्कटैः कृतैः ..
शतजन्मायुतानीह लक्ष्मीर्न च्यवते गृहात् .. 46 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये गोमतीतीरगत द्वारकाचक्रतीर्थयोर्जागरादिमाहात्म्यवर्णनं-नामाष्टात्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 38 ..
15.38.m:
He would not be stained by sins committed through severe transgressions, / and for ten thousand hundreds of births Lakṣmī does not fall away from his home.' 46
Thus ends the thirty-eighth chapter named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of the Vigil and Other Rites at Dvārakā and Cakratīrtha on the Banks of the Gomatī' in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [subdivision] of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the great Purāṇa of Skanda consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 38
